Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This missile pod launches a volley of four, fire and forget, guided missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座导弹吊舱齐射四枚发射后不管的制导导弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An AMS System, completely autonomous with Ammo and Tracking Systems. It's not the most ammo-efficient, but you can wire this on pretty much any 'Mech with enough Capacity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套AMS系统，完全自主，含弹药与追踪系统。它并不是最省弹药的，但只要容量够，你几乎能把它接到任何机甲上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These Flare Launchers are an Automatic Anti-Missile-System firing a cloud of small explosive warheads with chaff at any incoming missile trying to destroy it or disorient its guidance.5 SALVOS VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些闪光弹发射器是一种自动反导弹系统，向任何试图来袭的导弹发射一团带箔条的小型爆炸弹头，以摧毁它或扰乱其制导。5次齐射 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the weapon used by infantry for centuries, the Mech Mortar fires a small shell in a high arc that falls onto the target. Though the Mech Mortar was created by the Terran Hegemony, by 2835 the Succession Wars had relegated it to history. With the reintroduction of the Anti-Missile System, engineers revived the Mech Mortar concept. The munitions used by the mortars, though often possessing limited guidance packages, weren't destroyed by AMS systems in tests. Mortar shells also proved very adaptable, accepting several types of payloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲迫击炮以步兵使用数百年的武器为基础，发射一枚小型炮弹，沿高弧线落到目标上。虽然机甲迫击炮由地球霸权创造，但到2835年，继承战争已把它送进历史。随着反导弹系统重新引入，工程师们复活了机甲迫击炮的概念。迫击炮使用的弹药虽然通常只具备有限的制导组件，但在测试中不会被AMS系统摧毁。迫击炮弹还被证明适应性极强，可搭载多种弹头。
加特林机枪发射 1 发子弹
加特林机枪发射 2 发子弹
加特林机枪发射 3 发子弹
加特林机枪发射 4 发子弹
加特林机枪发射 5 发子弹
加特林机枪发射 6 发子弹

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Facing Raiders or just have Pest Problems? Need something to make some Noise or scare of the Wildlife? Look no further, our Patented 'Minigun' offers you Solution at Great Prices!.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 面对劫掠者，还是只是有鼠害问题？需要点东西来制造噪音或吓走野生动物？不用再找了，我们获得专利的"迷你枪"以优惠价格为你提供解决方案！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not quite as potent as the air-to-air Arrow missiles introduced by the Lyrans and the Wolves, this much smaller air-to-air missile version had its debut with the allied aerospace forces of the Duchy of Tamarind and Duchess Alys Rousset-Marik's resistance movement. Built smaller and leaner, these so-called light air-to-air (LAA) missiles can be carried by smaller fighters and create far less drag during atmospheric operations. With a little creativity, a decent MechTech crew can bolt these onto a 'Mech to be used as an air defense measure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它不如莱兰人与狼族推出的空对空箭矢导弹那般强力，这种小得多的空对空导弹版本首次亮相于塔马林德公国及其女公爵阿莉丝·鲁塞-马里克抵抗运动的盟军航空部队。这些所谓的轻型空对空（LAA）导弹造得更小更精简，可由更小的战机携带，在大气层作战中产生的阻力也小得多。只要有点创意，一支像样的机修班组就能把它们固定在机甲上，用作防空手段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Anti-Personnel Pod (A-Pod) is a piece of equipment designed specifically for 'Mechs. When detonated, effectively fill an area 15 meters in diameter with deadly shrapnel. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反人员炸弹（A-Pod）是一种专为机甲设计的设备。引爆后可在直径15米的范围内布满致命破片。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M-Pod is based on the A-Pod and B-Pod, but uses larger explosives and a more directional blast to damage hard targets. Designed by engineers in the Solaris games, the M-Pod is essentially a modified canister of LB-X autocannon ammunition. When activated it sprays targets with a mixture of shrapnel and 'Mech sized shotgun pellets. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M-Pod 以 A-Pod 和 B-Pod 为基础，但装填了更大的炸药，并采用更具方向性的爆炸来摧毁坚固目标。M-Pod 由 Solaris 竞技赛的工程师设计，本质上是一个经过改装的 LB-X 自动炮弹药罐。启动后，它会向目标喷射出一片由弹片和机甲尺寸霰弹组成的弹雨。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Replacing the Warhead with a selection of disposable Active and Passive Sensors Allows this to deploy Sensor in a Area as a Early Warning.5 Salvos VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把战斗部换成一组一次性主动与被动传感器，使它能在一片区域内布设传感器作为早期预警。5轮齐射 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rocket Launchers are cheap, unguided, one-shot missile launchers. Developed by the Marian Hegemony, they often replace more sophisticated equipment that the Periphery nation cannot afford or is unable to repair. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火箭发射器廉价、无制导、一次性使用。由马里安霸权开发，常用来替代外围区势力负担不起或无力维修的更精密装备。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rocket Launchers are cheap, unguided, one-shot missile launchers. Someone took these warheads and replaced their payload with Inferno Gel. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火箭发射器是廉价、无制导的一次性导弹发射器。有人把这些弹头里的装药换成了燃烧胶。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt Missile was developed for the arenas of Solaris. Unlike most missile systems, the Thunderbolt was a single missile that smashed into its target. Though it was effective in the arenas, it didn't see widespread use in the field because the single missile was very vulnerable to Anti-Missile Systems. The missile launcher, though small, was awkward to mount and would only fit on the left or right torso of a 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆导弹是为索拉里斯的竞技场开发的。与大多数导弹系统不同，雷霆是一枚撞向目标的单一导弹。虽然它在竞技场中有效，却未在战场上广泛使用，因为这枚单独导弹极易被反导系统拦截。其发射器虽小却难以安装，只能装在机甲的左或右躯干上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor (cFF) is a special type of armor used by vehicles and BattleMechs. Utilizing a weave of ferro-steel, ferro-titanium, and diamond weave fibers which boosts the tensile strength of the plating, it provides more protection per ton than standard armor, but takes up more space on the 'Mech or vehicle. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族铁纤维装甲（cFF）是车辆和战斗机甲使用的一种特殊装甲。它采用铁钢、铁钛与金刚石纤维交织而成的编织结构，提升了装甲板的抗拉强度，每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲，但在机甲或车辆上占用的空间更大。已启用 CASE

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by the Scientist caste of Clan Snow Raven, Ferro-Lamellor armor is based on the Ferro-Carbide armor used in the Raven's WarShips. Scaled down for use on 'Mechs, AeroSpace Fighters, and tanks, the experimental Ferro-Lamellor armor offers improved protection, beyond even that of the Ferro-Fibrous armor. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁层压装甲由雪鸦部族的科学家种姓研制，其基础是鸦族战舰上使用的铁碳化物装甲。这种实验性装甲经缩小后可用于机甲、空天战机与坦克，提供的防护甚至优于铁纤维装甲。 已启用CASE

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hardened Armor is a thicker armor type that uses multiple overlapping plates to provide additional protection against enemy fire. Though capable of diverting more damage than standard armor, the increased number of armor plates and their lack of flexibility makes any unit employing it more difficult to pilot, and can affect the speed as well. In fact, Hardened Armor is so heavy that it cannot be mounted on hovercraft, VTOLs, or WiGE vehicles. Reduces incoming Critical Hits. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 硬化装甲是一种更厚的装甲类型，使用多层重叠装甲板提供额外的抗敌火力防护。虽然能比标准装甲转移更多伤害，但装甲板数量的增加及其缺乏柔韧性使任何使用它的单位都更难驾驶，也可能影响速度。事实上，硬化装甲重到无法安装于气垫船、VTOL或WiGE车辆上。减少受到的致命一击。已启用CASE

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultra Light LAM Aluminium Armor was conceived during the Star League, attempting to create an Armor that is Durable and Lightweight enough to allow Flight Systems
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超轻型LAM铝制装甲构思于星盟时代，旨在制造一种既耐用又足够轻便以支持飞行系统的装甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Age of War, Primitive Armor was introduced on the Mackie, the original BattleMech. This armor was less capable than the armor used in Star League and Succession War designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始装甲开发于战争时代，并首次应用于最初的战斗机甲‘麦基’上. 这种装甲的性能低于星盟和继承战争时期设计所用的装甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Standard BattleMech armor is composed of several layers providing various degrees of protection and support. The first layer is extremely strong titanium alloyed with steel, the result of crystal alignment and radiation treatment, which is also very brittle. The second layer is a ceramic, cubic boron nitride, which combined with a web of artificial diamond fibers acts as a backstop to the steel layer. These two layers rest atop a titanium alloy honeycomb structure which provides support, and a layer of self-sealing polymer sealant which allows for space and underwater operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 标准战斗机甲装甲由多层结构组成，提供不同程度的保护和支撑. 第一层是极其坚固的钛钢合金，经过晶体取向和辐射处理，但同时也非常脆. 第二层是陶瓷立方氮化硼，与人造金刚石纤维网结合，作为钢层的背衬. 这两层置于钛合金蜂窝结构之上，该结构提供支撑，并覆盖一层自密封聚合物密封剂，以实现太空和水下作战能力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While otherwise identical to standard BattleMech Armor, Clan Armor incorporates C.A.S.E. technology. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 除集成 C.A.S.E. 技术外，氏族装甲在其他方面与标准战斗机甲装甲完全相同。CASE 已启用

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Spec Standard Cockpit, fully equipped with Advanced sensors and Targeting systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族规格标准驾驶舱，配备先进传感器和瞄准系统.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Industrial Cockpit is functionally similar to the modern BattleMech cockpit, but due to the bulkier components, it weighs five tons instead of three.  It lacks an ejection seat and the sensors are even worse than that of a standard IndustrialMech's
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业座舱在功能上与现代战斗机甲座舱相似，但由于部件更笨重，重量为五吨而非三吨。它没有弹射座椅，传感器甚至比标准工业机甲的还要差。
默认工业驾驶舱: 降低枪炮技能
默认工业驾驶舱: 降低驾驶技能
默认工业驾驶舱: 无法弹射

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default Industrial Cockpit: Increased Ability Resolve Cost
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认工业驾驶舱: 增加技能的决心消耗

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Industrial Cockpit is functionally similar to the modern BattleMech cockpit, but due to the bulkier components, it weighs five tons instead of three. This advanced version includes an ejection seat and slightly better systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业驾驶舱在功能上类似于现代战斗机甲驾驶舱，但由于采用了更笨重的组件，其重量达到5吨，而非3吨. 这个高级版本配备了弹射座椅，并拥有略微改进的系统.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default Advanced Industrial Cockpit: Decreased Piloting
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认高级工业驾驶舱: 降低驾驶技能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default Advanced Industrial Cockpit: Increased Ability Resolve Cost
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认高级工业驾驶舱: 增加技能的决心消耗

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A BattleMech’s cockpit is sealed, pressurized and fitted with a lifesupport system. A limited supply of air and water is contained within the ’Mech. If air or water exists outside of the 'Mech, fresh oxygen can be supplied for an unlimited time through the filtration system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲的驾驶舱是密封、加压并配备生命维持系统的。机内储存有限量的空气和水。若机甲外部存在空气或水，可通过过滤系统无限期供应新鲜氧气。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A StarLeague Defense Forces Standard Spec cockpit, complete with ballistic armored cooling suit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟防卫军(SLDF)标准规格驾驶舱，配备防弹冷却服
星盟防卫军标准驾驶舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the Armored Cowl design, Solaris Arm's upgrades this cockpit with a hardened cage and an IFF Jammer; enabling it to take heavier hits with ease.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款驾驶舱以装甲罩设计为基础，Solaris Arm为其加装了强化笼架与敌我识别干扰器，使其能够轻松承受更重的打击。
防止机甲战士受到 [AMT] 点伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reduces effectiveness of stealthed and ECM shielded units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降低隐身与 ECM 护盾单位的效能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris Arms Hardened Cage Cockpit Mod
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯兵工厂 Hardened Cage Cockpit Mod

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock Cockpit and Life Support, which can be upgraded for improved performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱与生命维持系统，可通过升级提升性能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The regenerative cooling system of an engine uses waste heat to generate power and is part of the Mech' cooling system. The engines integral heat sinks (a.k.a free heat sinks) are not common Mech' heat sinks and use up less volume.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 引擎的再生冷却系统利用废热发电，是机甲冷却系统的一部分。引擎内置散热器（又称免费散热器）不同于普通机甲散热器，占用体积更小。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default Clan FCS. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认的部族 FCS。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以跟踪单位、生成射击解算并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The FCS of a Industrial Battlemech. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业战斗机的火控系统。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。
默认工业火控: 精度降低

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The FCS of a Primitive Battlemech. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始战斗机甲的 FCS。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以跟踪单位、生成射击解算并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default SLDF FCS. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认SLDF火控系统。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Society FCS Package attuned to the BattleMech's internals, it's great efficiency leads to improved Heat Regulation. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套社会党火控系统组件与战斗机甲的内部结构相调谐，其出色的效率带来了更佳的热量调节效果。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器输入的海量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A default Mech FCS. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认的机甲 FCS。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传入的大量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gyros counteract the massive amounts of momentum generated from 'Mech engines and allow for precision maneuvering and recovery from stability-impacting attacks. All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock Gyro, which can be upgraded for improved performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪抵消机甲引擎产生的巨大动量，使机甲能精确机动并从影响稳定性的攻击中恢复。所有机甲都配备标准陀螺仪，可通过升级提升性能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hatchet is a melee attack weapon equipped on BattleMechs. While most 'Mechs are equipped with ranged weaponry, melee weaponry is also both feasible and useful due to increased damage potential (over a punch) and a lack of heat buildup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斧是装备在战斗机甲上的近战武器。虽然大多数机甲装备的是远程武器，但近战武器同样可行且有用，因为它相比拳击具有更高的伤害潜力，且不会积热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While initially little more than bulked out hatchets that traded a cutting edge for crushing ability when they first appeared in the Solaris Games, has the weapon evolved into the heavier and distinctive definitive model. Despite finally reaching a production grade standard, the unwieldy and unbalanced nature of the mace compared to the hatchet or sword has made them rarely seen in general military 'Mech designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钉锤最初在索拉里斯竞技大赛中登场时，不过是加粗的斧头——以切割刃换取粉碎力；如今这种武器已演化为更厚重、更具辨识度的定型款式。尽管最终达到了量产级标准，但相比斧或剑，钉锤笨重失衡的特性使其在常规军用机甲设计中极为罕见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sword is a melee attack weapon developed in 3058 by the Draconis Combine as an 'honorable' alternative to the 'crude' Lyran Hatchet, the Sword inflicts almost as much damage as a Hatchet and offers a better hit probability due to its exceptional balance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剑是德拉科尼斯联合体于 3058 年开发的近战武器，作为"粗野"的莱兰斧的"体面"替代品。剑造成的伤害几乎与斧相当，且因配重出色而拥有更高的命中率。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487 and improved by the Clans after their Exodus, Clan Endo-Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. Using zero-G manufacturing techniques that uniformly mix high-density steel with lower-density titanium and aluminum, the process produces a metal twice as strong per unit of weight as standard skeleton materials, thus halving the weight of the chassis, but at an increase in overall bulk. Reserves 7 Endo-Steel slots to halve your internal structure weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族内骨架由地球霸权于2487年研制，并在部族大逃亡后由部族改良，专为战斗机甲骨架而设计。它采用零重力制造工艺，把高密度钢与低密度钛铝均匀混合，产出的金属单位重量强度是标准骨架材料的两倍，从而把底盘重量减半，但整体体积有所增大。 保留 7 个内骨架槽位，使内部结构重量减半。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chassis of IndustrialMechs is similar to that BattleMechs but uses heavier, less efficient materials and bulkier myomer bundles. The resulting chassis is twice as heavy as a comparable BattleMechs and less resistant to weapons fire, though more suited to physical labor and cheaper to produce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业机甲的结构与机甲类似，但使用了更重、效率更低的材料以及体积更大的肌纤维束. 由此制成的结构重量是同级机甲的整整两倍，对武器火力的耐受性也更差，不过更适合体力劳动，生产成本也更低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Land Air Mech's require a specialized internal Structure that houses their Bulky and Heavy Conversation Gear, this makes them incompatible with any other Structure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陆地空战机甲需要一种特化的内部结构来容纳其笨重庞大的变形机构，这使它们与任何其他结构都不兼容。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Internal Structure of a BattleMech forms the skeletal structure of the 'Mech to which all components are mounted. The Standard Internal Structure of a 'Mech weighs 10% of its max tonnage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲的内部结构构成机甲的骨架，所有部件都安装在它上面。机甲的标准内部结构重量为其最大吨位的 10%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced internal structure for Superheavy BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为超重型战斗机甲强化的内部结构。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides a [AMT] bonus to actions that generate Resolve.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为产生决心的行动提供 [AMT] 加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unlike most mechs, the majority of combat vehicles are crewed by more than one individual. Three or four has been the standard for centuries, with the primary roles being Commander, Driver, and Gunner. There may also be loaders, communications operators, engineers and additional gunners. They are generally grouped together into a single so called fighting compartment. Weapons fire that penetrates this compartment can wound or kill the entire crew.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与大多数机甲不同，绝大部分战斗车辆由不止一人操控. 几个世纪以来，三到四人一直是标准编制，主要角色包括车长、机师和炮手. 还可能设有装填手、通讯操作员、工程师以及额外的炮手. 他们通常集中在一个所谓的战斗舱室内. 一旦敌方火力击穿该舱室，便可能导致全体车组人员受伤或阵亡.
定点射击可靠性提高一倍
提供 +1 先攻权和若干增益。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vehicular Direct Neural Interface was a special type of cybernetic implant developed for the Manei Domini. The system worked in principle similar to the Clans' Enhanced Imaging system, allowing MechWarriors, aerospace fighter pilots, battle armor troopers and even combat vehicle and Small Craft crews to become one with their machines. Unlike the EI system, however, VDNI was able to ward off the short-term negative effects of the technology by employing improved circuit breakers and forcing users to regularly ingest a special chemical agent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车辆直接神经接口是为布雷克之手研发的一种特殊赛博植入体。该系统原理上类似氏族的增强成像系统，让机师、航空战机飞行员、战斗装甲兵乃至战斗车辆与小型艇乘员能与自己的机器融为一体。不过与EI系统不同，VDNI通过采用改良断路器并迫使用户定期摄入一种特殊化学剂，得以抵御该技术的短期负面影响。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位通过移动行动额外获得 1 层闪避（不超过上限）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While single pilot VTOL exist, many have a crew of two, with the second handling various tasks not directly related to flying the craft allowing the pilot to focus on maneuvers and not crashing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然存在单人驾驶的VTOL，但许多VTOL配备两名机组人员，第二名负责处理与飞行不直接相关的各种任务，让机师能专注于机动操作并避免坠毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fuel Cell engines are primarily used in civilian applications like rail systems, personal transport, and IndustrialMechs. Fuel Cell engines generate electrical power that is then used by the vehicle to operate its propulsion system. A Fuel Cell engine has several advantages over the typical Internal Combustion Engine. While they require an oxidizer to operate, they are readily able to accept a stored oxidizer along with their fuel, making it a good choice for submarines, satellites, and naval applications. As most fuel cells run on hydrogen and oxygen, they have no exhaust other than water vapor so Fuel Cells are also used as generators for buildings and other large structures. Cannot use Additional Cooling Kits, Exchanger or Banks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 燃料电池引擎主要用于民用领域，如铁路系统、个人交通工具和工业机甲. 燃料电池引擎产生电能，供车辆驱动其推进系统. 与典型的内燃机相比，燃料电池引擎具有多项优势. 虽然它们需要氧化剂才能运行，但它们能够轻松接受储存的氧化剂和燃料，因此是潜艇、卫星和海军应用的理想选择. 由于大多数燃料电池以氢和氧为燃料，除水蒸气外无其他排放物，因此燃料电池也用作建筑物和其他大型结构的发电机. 无法使用附加冷却套件、换热器或蓄热器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For all intents and purposes identical to a modern internal combustion engine, the I.C.E. in BattleTech is used mainly for conventional vehicles and IndustrialMechs. Its power output is less than a fusion engine of similar mass, meaning an I.C.E. needs to be heavier in order to have the same engine rating of a fusion engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从实际功能上来看，BattleTech中的内燃机与现代内燃机别无二致，主要用于常规车辆和工业机甲. 其输出功率低于同等质量的核聚变引擎，这意味着要达到与核聚变引擎相同的额定功率，内燃机必须做得更重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic Combat Vehicle FCS. A Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基本型战斗车辆火控系统. 火控系统负责协调并分析传感器收集的海量信息，以追踪目标单位、生成射击方案并命中目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic Combat Vehicle FCS. A Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基本型战斗车辆火控系统. 火控系统负责协调并分析传感器收集的海量信息，以追踪目标单位、生成射击方案并命中目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hover vehicles use a forced cushion of air to skim just above the surface below it. Hover vehicles are renowned for their ability to skirmish and harass opposing forces with their speed and ability to cross bodies of water that other vehicles may have difficulty with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 气垫车辆利用强制气垫紧贴地表悬浮行驶. 这类车辆以高机动性著称，既能快速袭扰敌军，又能跨越其他车辆难以通行的水域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hover vehicles use a forced cushion of air to skim just above the surface below it. Hover vehicles are renowned for their ability to skirmish and harass opposing forces with their speed and ability to cross bodies of water that other vehicles may have difficulty with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 气垫车辆利用强制气垫紧贴地表悬浮行驶. 这类车辆以高机动性著称，既能快速袭扰敌军，又能跨越其他车辆难以通行的水域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tracks are arguably the default motive system for military ground vehicles. While wheels and hoverskirts have their advantages in certain settings they falter in others. Tracks keep rolling along with little regard for the surface they grind their way across.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 履带堪称军用地面车辆的标志性驱动系统. 虽然轮式和气垫式在某些环境下各有优势，但在其他地形上却难免捉襟见肘. 履带则能一往无前地碾过几乎任何表面，无惧地形阻碍.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tracks are arguably the default motive system for military ground vehicles. While wheels and hoverskirts have their advantages in certain settings they falter in others. Tracks keep rolling along with little regard for the surface they grind their way across.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 履带堪称军用地面车辆的标志性驱动系统. 虽然轮式和气垫式在某些环境下各有优势，但在其他地形上却难免捉襟见肘. 履带则能一往无前地碾过几乎任何表面，无惧地形阻碍.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Most combat vehicles have three or more sets of wheels per side equipped with rugged run-flat pneumatic tires. Materials have improved but wheels themselves have changed little in thousands of years. There's a reason why ''reinventing the wheel'' is a saying saying to describe things that are a waste of effort. For at least 6000 years the wheel has been the first choice when humans want to make something mobile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大多数战斗车辆每侧装有三组或更多车轮，配以坚固的防爆充气轮胎。材料不断改进，但车轮本身数千年来几乎未变。"重新发明轮子"之所以成为形容白费力气之事的俗语，自有其道理。至少六千年来，轮子一直是人类想让某物动起来时的首选。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Most combat vehicles have three or more sets of wheels per side equipped with rugged run-flat pneumatic tires. Materials have improved but wheels themselves have changed little in thousands of years. There's a reason why ''reinventing the wheel'' is a saying saying to describe things that are a waste of effort. For at least 6000 years the wheel has been the first choice when humans want to make something mobile.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A VTOL (Vertical Takeoff and Landing) craft is one that uses thrust to take off or land vertically, usually with the assistance of propellers and/or rotors. The most common VTOL craft is a helicopter, though traditional-looking airplanes can use vertical thrust to achieve the same result, often at a higher rate of speed. VTOLs often excel in situations where traditional aircraft would not have the space to take off or land, such as on aircraft carriers or in restrictive terrain such as mountains.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTOL（垂直起降）飞行器是依靠推力垂直起飞或降落的车辆，通常借助螺旋桨和/或旋翼。最常见的 VTOL 飞行器是直升机，不过外形传统的飞机也能利用垂直推力实现同样的效果，而且速度往往更快。在传统飞机没有足够空间起降的场合——比如航空母舰上，或是山区等受限地形中——VTOL 往往能大显身手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Environmental Sealing is a series of filters, air tanks, hermetic seals, and scrubbers that allow a unit to operate in hostile environments like the vacuum of space, under water, or toxic waste dumps. All BattleMechs, AeroSpace and Conventional Fighters, DropShips, and submarine vehicles include environmental sealing as part of their construction. This sealing takes up no additional weight or space as it's built into the unit. Other units, like IndustrialMechs and combat vehicles, can be equipped with environmental sealing at a cost of 10% of the unit's weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 环境密封是一系列过滤器、气罐、气密密封与洗涤器，使单位能在真空、水下或有毒废料场等恶劣环境中运作。所有战斗机甲、航空与常规战机、空投艇以及潜航车辆都在建造中内置环境密封。这种密封内建于单位之中，不占用额外重量或空间。其他单位，如工业机甲与战斗车辆，可以加装环境密封，代价为单位重量的10%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The latest innovation in BattleMech technology is the Upper Leg Actuator Replacement, a cutting-edge component that replaces both the hip and upper leg actuators with a more compact design. Developed by our engineering team, this new actuator provides increased space and weight savings, allowing for more flexibility in mech design. However, there is a trade-off: while it provides excellent mobility, it comes at the cost of reduced stability. The unique design makes it more challenging to maintain balance and stand firmly on uneven terrain, which can impact the mech's stability during combat. Pilots will need to adapt their tactics accordingly and be mindful of the terrain they engage in.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲技术的最新创新是大腿驱动器替换件——一种前沿部件，以更紧凑的设计替换髋关节驱动器与大腿驱动器。这一新型驱动器由我们的工程团队开发，可提供更多空间并节省重量，让机甲设计获得更大的灵活性。不过它也有取舍：虽然带来出色的机动性，代价却是稳定性下降。其独特设计使机甲更难保持平衡、在不平坦地形上站稳，从而可能影响机甲在战斗中的稳定性。机师需要相应调整战术，并在交战时留意所处地形。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Actuator Enhancement System (AES) is a combination of finely tuned myomer bundles and an enhanced DI computer interface that can improve the workings of a BattleMech's limbs. In many ways similar to the acuity enhancing servos and mechanisms tied into enhanced targeting computers, AES components serve to stabilize subtle variances in gross 'Mech movements, which can lead to greater weapon precision or improved balance adjustments. However, the systems are heavy and bulky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驱动器增强系统（AES）是精密调校的人造肌束与增强型 DI 计算机接口的结合，能改善战斗机甲肢体的运作。它在许多方面类似与增强型瞄准计算机相连的灵敏度增益伺服与机构：AES 组件用于稳定机甲整体动作中的细微偏差，从而带来更高的武器精度或更好的平衡调整。然而这些系统又重又笨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Anti-Penetrative Ablation Armor was developed by the Draconis Combine to specifically defeat Armor Piercing Ammunition and Tandem-Charge Warheads. This was accomplished by adding a second layer of \"ribbed\" steel below the standard armor plate. Though effective against armor piercing ammunition of all types, the ribbed steel has no effect on standard autocannon ammunition, energy weapons, or physical attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抗穿透烧蚀装甲由龙脉联合体研制，专门用于克制穿甲弹药与串联装药弹头。实现方式是在标准装甲板下增加一层“带肋”钢。虽然对各种穿甲弹药都有效，但这层带肋钢对标准自动炮弹药、能量武器或物理攻击毫无作用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ballistic-Reinforced Armor was created as a response to autocannon and missile weapons. The armor is a combination of Hardened and Reactive Armor that reduces damage taken from both ballistic and missile weapons. The armor is also known as ''reinforced'' armor, but many techs use the term ''hardened light'' to describe it. A thinner version of hardened armor is backed by cable mesh that warps and traps missile and ballistic ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹道强化装甲是为应对自动炮与导弹武器而造。它是硬化装甲与反应装甲的结合，可减少来自弹道与导弹武器的伤害。这种装甲又称“强化”装甲，但许多技师用“硬化轻型”来形容它。较薄的硬化装甲由缆网支撑，缆网会扭曲并困住导弹与弹道弹药。
承受更少手持武器伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ferro-Fibrous armor (FF) is a special type of armor used by vehicles and BattleMechs. Utilizing a weave of ferro-steel, ferro-titanium, and diamond weave fibers which boosts the tensile strength of the plating, it provides more protection per ton than standard armor, but takes up more space on the 'Mech or vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁纤维装甲（FF）是车辆与战斗机甲使用的一种特殊装甲。它由铁钢、铁钛与金刚石编织纤维交织而成，提升了装甲板的抗拉强度，因此每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲，但会占用机甲或车辆上更多的空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor (cFF) is a special type of armor used by vehicles and BattleMechs. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by the Scientist caste of Clan Snow Raven, Ferro-Lamellor armor is based on the Ferro-Carbide armor used in the Raven's WarShips. Scaled down for use on 'Mechs, AeroSpace Fighters, and tanks, the experimental Ferro-Lamellor armor offers improved protection, beyond even that of the Ferro-Fibrous armor. CASE Enabled

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hardened Armor is a thicker armor type that uses multiple overlapping plates to provide additional protection against enemy fire. Though capable of diverting more damage than standard armor, the increased number of armor plates and their lack of flexibility makes any unit employing it more difficult to pilot, and can affect the speed as well. In fact, Hardened Armor is so heavy that it cannot be mounted on hovercraft, VTOLs, or WiGE vehicles. Reduces incoming Critical Hits.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heat-Dissipating Armor is a derivative of the Fire-Resistant Armor used by Clan battlesuits. Created by the Capellan Confederation, it reduces the effects of fire and incendiary weapons on a BattleMech's heat exchange system while intact. Unlike some specialty armors, it is effective against most weapons, but the increased bulk of the armor (from additional insulation and modified sealants) results in less overall protection per ton.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 散热装甲是氏族战斗服所用防火装甲的衍生型。它由卡佩兰联邦创造，在完好时能降低火焰与燃烧武器对战斗机甲热交换系统的影响。与某些特种装甲不同，它对大多数武器都有效，但装甲体积的增加（源于额外绝缘与改良密封剂）导致每吨总体防护更低。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor (cFF) is a special type of armor used by vehicles and BattleMechs. A derivative of the Ferro Fibrous Research, initially discarded for its increased bulk does it offer superior protection for the same tons. CASE Enabled

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Impact Resistant Armor was originally developed by Lyran Commonwealth engineers for use on Solaris VII and other gladiatorial combat worlds. The armor consists of a flexible sealant that covers interlocking rings, covered by a thick flexible outer shell similar to tank treads. These rings flex when hit by a 'Mech sized melee weapon, reducing the damage. Despite being effective against physical weapons, the armor's flexibility means it is more likely to fail against armor-piercing ammunition and in hostile environments. Reserves 6 slots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抗冲击装甲最初由莱兰联邦的工程师开发，用于 Solaris VII 及其他角斗战斗世界。这种装甲由覆盖互锁环的柔性密封剂构成，外层再包覆类似坦克履带的厚实柔性外壳。被机甲级别的近战武器击中时，这些环会弯曲变形，从而减轻伤害。尽管对物理武器效果显著，但装甲的柔韧性也意味着它在面对穿甲弹药以及恶劣环境时更容易失效。占用 6 个槽位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Advances in Clan Ferro-Fibrous Armor technology allow this Ultra Light Armor to save weight for a LAM's protection and even provides the ability to upgrade to Clan Case II Systems. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族铁纤装甲技术的进步让这种超轻装甲能为LAM的防护节省重量，甚至还能升级到氏族CASE II系统。已启用CASE

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Aphrodite Thunderbolt-Streak TTS started as a custom modification for gladiators needing to make every thunderbolt count. This module allow thunderbolts to mimic streak behaviour.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿芙洛狄忒雷电-锁定式TTS最初是为那些需要让每一发雷电导弹都发挥作用的角斗士量身定制的改装件. 该模块允许雷电导弹模仿锁定式导弹的行为.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Apollo' Fire Control System was created by the Draconis Combine in order to overcome the inaccuracies of MRM launchers without requiring an upgraded (and more expensive) ammunition. Apollo is an unofficial nickname for the system. Functioning much like a Targeting Computer, the fire control system makes it more likely that the launcher will achieve a missile lock, though the dumb-fire MRMs are still more prone to miss the target than other missiles.Cannot be used with other Missile TTS and enables using Apollo MRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "阿波罗"火控系统由龙尼斯联合体创造，用以在不需升级（且更昂贵）弹药的情况下克服MRM发射器的不精准。阿波罗是该系统的非官方绰号。它功能上很像瞄准计算机，使发射器更有可能取得导弹锁定，不过无制导的MRM仍比其他导弹更容易脱靶。不能与其他导弹TTS同时使用，并允许使用阿波罗MRM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While being a more regional Fire Control System, the adapted Artemis system greatly enhanced the Garret A99 capabilities, even above some of the other competitors on the market.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然是一种区域性火控系统，但经过适配的阿尔忒弥斯系统极大地增强了Garret A99的能力，甚至超过了市场上其他一些竞争对手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Artemis V Fire Control System is an improved, next generation version of the ubiquitous Artemis IV FCS, able to guide missiles with even greater accuracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔忒弥斯V型火控系统是普及的阿尔忒弥斯IV型火控系统的改进型下一代版本，能以更高的精度制导导弹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed by Clan Hell's Horses to enable the use of heavier weapons on their Battle Armor, the technology proved useful enough to quickly spread to others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这最初由地狱马氏族研发，目的是让他们的战斗装甲能使用更重的武器，该技术后来被证明足够有用，迅速传播到其他氏族。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2575 by the Terran Hegemony, the Laser Insulators were an advanced heat sink first used in the SLDF's Chippewa fighter. The laser bays in the fighter's wings were insulated from its superstructure and core systems with robust, lightweight aerogel blankets. While providing the equivalent of two standard heat sinks at a fraction of the weight, the primary drawback of the system was that it trapped the heat close to the source rather than allowing it to flow through the entire fighter to act as a thermal mass.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光绝缘器由地球霸权于2575年推出，是一种先进散热器，首次用于SLDF的奇皮瓦战机。该战机机翼中的激光舱通过坚韧轻量的气凝胶隔热毯与其上层结构和核心系统隔开。它虽以极小的重量提供相当于两具标准散热器的效果，该系统的主要缺点是它把热量困在热源附近，而不是让它流过整架战机充当热质。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nano-Fluid Damper is still in prototype stage, but could be the next large step in reducing recoil of 'Mech-mounted weapons. Using a special hydraulic fluid containing a mix of high-volume, low-density nano-particles of various advanced polymer materials, the damper is able to reduce the recoil of even the heaviest of ballistic weapons, but at the risk of exploding on damage. The risk of exploding together with its prohibitively high construction cost, means it is still some way away from being adapted for general use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 纳米流体阻尼器仍处于原型阶段，但可能是降低机甲武器后坐力的下一次大跨越。该阻尼器使用一种特殊液压油，其中混合了多种先进聚合物材料制成的大体积、低密度纳米颗粒，能降低哪怕最重型弹道武器的后坐力，但代价是受损时可能爆炸。爆炸风险加上高得令人却步的建造成本，意味着它距离普遍应用还有一段路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PPC Capacitor is an extra component that can be added to any type of Projector Cannon. It enhances a PPC damage capabilities at the cost of higher heat generation. When Destroyed Explodes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PPC电容器是一个可添加至任何型号粒子加农炮的额外组件. 它以更高的热量产生为代价，增强PPC的伤害能力. 被摧毁时会爆炸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat just shortly prior to the infamous Black Out, the Laser Pulse Module was originally designed to be fitted on any Standard or ER Laser, giving it an alternate fire mode which increases the heat output but increases the accuracy along the same lines as a Pulse Laser. Recent iterations on the prototype design have allowed integration into already existing pulse lasers by inducing microdelays into the pulse duration that allow even more vaporised armour to dissipate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光脉冲模块由共和国战略战斗研究所在那场臭名昭著的大停电之前不久研发，最初设计为可加装在任何标准或增程激光器上，为它提供一种替代射击模式：提高热量输出，但按脉冲激光器的路子提升精度。这一原型设计近期的迭代已能通过给脉冲持续时间引入微延迟，整合进现有的脉冲激光器中，让更多汽化的装甲得以消散。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in an effort to match the capabilities of Clan battlesuit armor, Inner Sphere advanced armor first appeared on the Longinus suit in 3057. This armor is still heavier and bulkier than the Clan system, but represents a significant improvement in battle armor weight-to-protection ratios, enabling suit designs to attain up to twenty percent greater protection for the same weight investment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体的高级装甲首次出现在3057年的Longinus套装上，其研发旨在匹敌氏族战斗服装甲的性能. 这种装甲虽然仍比氏族系统更重更占空间，但显著改善了战斗装甲的重量与防护性能比，使装甲设计能在同等重量投入下获得高达百分之二十的额外防护.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite its resilience and self-contained nature, battle armor — like most conventional vehicles — remains particularly susceptible to the lethal effects of fire and incendiary weapons. Recognizing this, Clan Fire Mandrill recently developed an enhanced fire-resistant battlesuit  armor — their Salamander design. The actual technology behind the armor is mostly unknown, but many suspect it combines advanced iridium cermets, highly efficient insulation and a powerful refrigeration system
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管战斗装甲坚固且自成一体，但它——像大多数常规车辆一样——仍然特别容易受到火焰与燃烧武器的致命影响。有鉴于此，火沸氏族最近研发了一种增强型防火战斗服装甲——即他们的火蜥蜴设计。这套装甲背后的实际技术大多不明，但许多人怀疑它结合了先进的衣金属陶瓷、高效绝缘与强大的制冷系统

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laser Reflective Armor dissipates energy weapon attacks more efficiently than other armor types, reducing the amount of damage taken by the 'Mech mounting it. Despite the name, Laser Reflective Armor is effective against all energy weapons, not just lasers. PPCs, Flamers, and Plasma Rifles and Cannons are all less effective against it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反射装甲比其他类型的装甲更高效地消散能量武器的攻击，从而减少装备它的机甲所受的伤害。尽管名为“激光反射”，这种装甲对所有制式能量武器都有效，而不只是激光。粒子炮、火焰喷射器以及等离子步枪与等离子炮对它的效果都大打折扣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laser Reflective Armor dissipates energy weapon attacks more efficiently than other armor types, reducing the amount of damage taken by the 'Mech mounting it. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mimetic Armor was created using Chameleon Light Polarization Shield as a starting point, the technicians created a system that used several embedded cameras to identify the colors in the environment and then shift the armor's color to match. Using this armor allows the Battle Armor to slip into the background like a chameleon or octopus, making targeting more difficult. The computers used to perform the color matching need some time to process the data, so the system is most effective when the unit is standing still or moving very slowly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拟态装甲以变色龙光极化护盾为起点创造，技师们造出一套系统，用多个嵌入式摄像头识别环境中的颜色，然后调整装甲颜色以匹配。使用这种装甲能让战斗装甲像变色龙或章鱼一样融入背景，使瞄准更加困难。用于执行颜色匹配的计算机需要一些时间处理数据，所以该系统在单位静止或移动极慢时最为有效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype stealth armor was conceived in the early 3050s by FedCom engineers. Adapting the capabilities of existing thermal and electronic sneak suits and embedding these features in the battlefield armor, engineers managed to mimic the lost technologies of Star League-era power armor almost exactly.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the armored glove but based more on mechanics and myomers, the basic battle armor manipulator is operated by controls in the battlesuit’s wrists, rather than as an actual glove. With increased strength sufficient to hold a trooper securely to the hull of a moving OmniMech, even if the battlesuit model is especially heavy, this manipulator is ideal for most suit types and functions. However, the larger digits, loss of fine motor control and lack of sufficient tactile feedback make it impossible to handle conventional infantry weapons or operate most equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与装甲手套相似，但更依赖机械与人造肌，基础战斗装甲操纵器靠战斗服腕部的控制装置操作，而非作为真正的手套。它的力量足以把一个士兵稳固地固定在行进中的全向机甲外壳上，即便战斗服型号特别沉重；因此这种操纵器对大多数战斗服类型与用途而言都很理想。不过，更大的手指、精细动作控制能力的丧失以及触觉反馈不足，使它无法操作常规步兵武器或大多数设备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the unique HarJel Compound found on LV-426, which has the capacity to break up and absorb EM and light Waves, does the Black Carapace have self repair functionality with a basic Stealth Functionality.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基于在LV-426上发现的独特HarJel复合物——它能够分解并吸收电磁波与光波——黑色甲壳具备自我修复功能，并带有基础隐形功能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every Battle Armor is Piloted by a single specially trained MechWarrior. Unlike large units like ProtoMechs or BattleMechs, the Battle Armor has only limited control systems instead of a full cockpit and therefore the pilot can not eject.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每一套战斗装甲都由一名受过专门训练的机甲战士驾驶. 与原型机甲或战斗机甲等大型单位不同，战斗装甲只有有限的操控系统而非完整的驾驶舱，因此机师无法弹射.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides a penalty to all attacks against this unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对攻击该单位的所有攻击施加惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit ignores terrain bonuses and penalties as well as landmines this turn but has massively reduced movement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位本回合忽略地形加成与惩罚以及地雷，但移动力大幅降低。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Battle Armor Mechanical Jump Boosters share the advantages and limitations of their larger cousins. They offer a very limited jump capability and they're hard to steer when in flight. However, the Mechanical Jump Boosters used on Battle Armor offers one significant advantage over their 'Mech sized cousins: They allow the armored infantry soldier to replace the normal walking gait with a longer \"bouncing\" gait that allows the battle armored trooper to cover more ground.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remote Sensor Dispensers are small cargo bays with an attached dispenser used to place Remote Sensors. These dispensers are normally mounted on support vehicles, used to secure newly-established landing zones or defensive perimeters. Each RSD can carry up to thirty short-range sensors, typically a mix of thermal, electromagnetic and seismic sensors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程传感器投放器(RSD)是一种小型货舱，配备有用于部署远程传感器的投放装置. 这些投放器通常安装在支援车辆上，用于保障新建立的着陆区或防御警戒范围. 每个RSD最多可携带三十个短程传感器，通常包含热成像、电磁和地震传感器的混合配置.
战斗装甲遥控传感器布撒器

Like the vehicular-scale version, the battlesuit-scale active probe is a complex sensor array far more sophisticated and powerful than the sensors normally used by the battlesuit. Incorporating strong yet portable thermal and radar sensors, the probe allows easier accurate spotting of hidden units and mines at some distance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与车辆级版本一样，战斗服级主动探测器是一套复杂的传感器阵列，远比战斗服通常使用的传感器精密强大。该探测器集成强力而便携的热能与雷达传感器，让人更容易在相当距离上准确标定隐蔽单位与地雷。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 使车辆更难被肉眼发现

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Armor Camouflage System, developed more as a module than an armor type, essentially uses mimetic technology to produce a visual effect similar to a sneak suit — where a central computer and sensors sample the surrounding terrain visually and change the armor’s colors to match.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲伪装系统更多是作为模块而非装甲类型研发的，它本质上使用拟态技术产生类似潜行服的视觉效果——由一台中央计算机与传感器在视觉上采样周围地形，并改变装甲颜色以匹配。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jamming ECM, reduces sensor checks for enemies in field
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干扰型 ECM，降低战场上敌方的传感器检定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Angel ECM Suite is an advanced version of the Guardian ECM Suite operating on a broader spectrum and greatly advances ECM technology on the battlefield. Development of the Angel began in the Draconis Combine shortly after the Battle of Luthien, but despite assistance from ComStar, cost overruns and internal problems within both powers kept it in its experimental stages for a long time and delayed its widespread deployment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天使ECM套件是守护者ECM套件的高级版本，在更宽的频谱上运行，极大地推进了战场上的ECM技术. 天使的开发在天龙联合体于卢西恩战役后不久便开始，但尽管得到了ComStar的协助，成本超支以及双方内部问题使其长期停留在实验阶段，并推迟了其广泛部署.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A micro-scale version of the vehicular Guardian ECM suit, the battlesuit ECM suite module provides stealth technology that is not so much built into the suit's armored \"skin\" as it is an area-effect jamming field. Active rather than passive, the battle armor ECM suite can disrupt sensors and communications to a range of ninety meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为车辆用守卫者ECM套件的微型版本，战斗服ECM套件模块提供隐形技术，与其说内建于战斗服的装甲"皮肤"，不如说是一个区域效果干扰场。它是主动式而非被动式，战斗装甲ECM套件能在九十米范围内干扰传感器与通讯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jamming ECM, reduces sensor checks for enemies in field
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干扰型 ECM，降低战场上敌方的传感器检定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides a [AMT] bonus to actions that generate Resolve.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为产生决心的行动提供 [AMT] 加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extended Life Support system consists of combination of air-recycling and purification subsystems that increases both the quality and the longevity of the sealed environment for the pilot of the unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扩展生命维持系统由空气循环与净化子系统组合而成，能够同时提升机师所在密封环境的质量与持续时长.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: BA Extended Life Support: Increased Resolve Generation
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BA扩展生命维持: 决心生成量增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The portable heat sensor is a common enough device, but its adaptation to battlesuit use amounted to an early effort to enhance the standard sensor packages on said armor designs. Though their use would eventually be phased out by more sophisticated and enhanced sensor suites, some of these thermal packages remain, even finding their way into the industrial sector to enhance the capabilities of some exoskeleton designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 便携式热传感器是一种相当常见的设备，但它改装用于战斗服，是增强这些装甲设计标准传感器套件的早期努力。虽然它们最终会被更精密的增强传感器套件淘汰，其中一些热传感器组件仍留存下来，甚至流入工业领域，用于增强某些外骨骼设计的能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Booster equipment for broad-spectrum detection, improving the sensor strength of the Battle Armor to help root out hidden units that lack sufficient ECM cover.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于宽谱探测的增强设备，提升战斗装甲的传感器强度，帮助挖出缺乏足够ECM掩护的隐蔽单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供敌方单位的详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Battle Armor Jump Jets allow for vast leaps across the battlefield, often straight onto the hide of unsuspecting BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲跳跃推进器可让其在战场上实现大幅跳跃，常常直接落在毫无防备的机甲背上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Max Jump Jet Amount per Walk MP
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每点行走 MP 的最大跳跃推进器数量

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BA跳跃助推器: 跳跃热量生成增加

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BA跳跃助推器: 每MP最大跳跃喷口数

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A special item, available only to humanoid battle armors and only up to those of Heavy weight class or lighter, is the Magnetic Clamps system. This item allows a battle armor to ride on even non-Omni units, without meeting any other manipulator requirements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁力夹具系统是一种特殊装备，仅适用于人形战斗装甲，且仅限重型或以下重量级. 该装备使战斗装甲能够搭载于甚至非万能单位上，无需满足任何其他机械臂要求.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Magnetic Clamps: Allow Battle Armor Mounting
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁力夹具: 允许战斗装甲搭载

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Initially conceived as a spin-off from failed Ice Hellion efforts to create an enhanced BattleMech MASC system, the battle armor-scaled myomer booster offers to increase the speed and strength of a given battlesuit design. However, the system’s greatest drawback is the tremendous amount of heat generated — which not only makes it impossible to employ such enhanced myomer suits in a stealth role, but requires the installation of bulky cooling systems to avoid parboiling the trooper within.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初被设想为冰地狱蜥蜴失败研发工作的衍生品——他们曾试图打造一种增强型战斗机甲MASC系统——战斗装甲尺度的肌纤维助推器旨在提升特定战斗服设计的速度与力量。然而，该系统最大的缺点在于产生巨量热量——这不仅使这种增强肌纤维战斗服无法用于潜行角色，还需要安装笨重的冷却系统，以免把里面的士兵煮了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Partial Wing is a piece of battle armor equipment designed to automatically extend and collapse, providing extra stability and glide surface during flight. The partial wing extends a battlesuit's normal jump range by 30 meters, however bulk and fragility concerns prevents its use in combination with Jump Boosters and requires the existence of an atmosphere to properly function.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部分翼是一种战斗装甲装备，设计为自动展开与收拢，在飞行中提供额外的稳定性与滑翔面。部分翼能将战斗服的正常跳跃距离延长30米，但体积与脆弱性的顾虑使其无法与跳跃助推器同时使用，并且需要存在大气才能正常发挥作用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Power Pack is an externally carried battery to ensure adequate power for the suit during longer engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 动力包是一种外挂电池，用于在较长时间交战中为战斗服提供充足电力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A searchlight mounted on the exterior of the Battle Armor, allowing easier detection and targeting of nearby foes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安装在战斗装甲外部的探照灯，便于探测和瞄准附近的敌人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle armor internal structure represents its framework, joints and control systems — including the weight of the controlling trooper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲的内部结构代表其框架、关节与控制系统——包括操作士兵的重量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uses experimental weight-saving alloys, but makes the unit more vulnerable to critical hits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 采用实验性减重合金，但使该单位更易受到致命一击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Battle armor are armored infantry exoskeletons with a mass between 80 and 2,000 kg, including the mass of the occupant, usually operating in squads of 4 to 6 units. The suits utilize exoskeletal frames and protective armor, which, in combination with varying amounts of Myomer, can augment the strength and/or speed of the wearer. Battle armor's improved resilience, atmospheric containment, and firepower make it more effective than standard infantry in a variety of roles, but much more expensive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲是装甲步兵外骨骼，质量介于 80 至 2,000 公斤之间（含乘员质量），通常以 4 至 6 具为一班行动。装甲服采用外骨骼框架与防护装甲，配合数量不等的人造肌，可增强穿戴者的力量与（或）速度。战斗装甲更强的韧性、气密性与火力使其在多种角色中比标准步兵更有效，但成本也高得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C3i was developed by ComStar from Draconis Combine technology. While expanding its military strength to ward off the Clan Invasion, the ComGuard found their current C3 Master Computer incapable of handling the complexities of senary units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C3i系统由ComStar基于龙马天龙联合体的技术开发而来. 在为抵御氏族入侵而扩充军事实力时，ComGuard发现现有的C3主计算机无法处理六进制单位编组的复杂性.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CASE is short for Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment. In an internal explosion event, CASE prevents the explosion from traveling to adjacent mech compartments. While CASE does not prevent damage to occur in the protected area, it does prevent it from passing through, helping to prevent ammo explosions to reach the center torso of a mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CASE是细胞式弹药存储设备的缩写. 在发生内部爆炸时，CASE能阻止爆炸蔓延到相邻的机甲舱室. 虽然CASE无法防止受保护区域本身受损，但它能阻止爆炸穿透，有助于防止弹药爆炸波及机甲的中心躯干.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CASE II is an experimental version of standard CASE. When an internal explosion occurs, CASE II reduces the damage to the Internal Structure of the installed location, making it take only five points of damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CASE II是标准CASE的实验性版本. 当内部爆炸发生时，CASE II将减少安装部位内部结构所受到的伤害，使其仅承受五点伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan CASE II is functionally similar to the experimental FIS CASE II but only weighs half as much. When an internal explosion occurs, CASE II reduces the damage to the Internal Structure of the installed location to only five points. REQUIRES CLAN ARMOR
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族CASE II在功能上与实验性FIS CASE II相似，但重量只有后者的一半。当发生内部爆炸时，CASE II把对安装位置内部结构的伤害降低到仅5点。需要氏族装甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan CASE II can only be used with Clan Armor!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族CASE II只能与部族装甲搭配使用！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. The Console adds a complete set of controls for a second MechWarrior with added command and control facilities, allowing for better Lance coordination by upgrading initiative.

Star League-vintage Command Consoles are very rare by 3025 because 'Mechs equipped in this way were favoured targets in battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
所有机甲出厂时都配备标准座舱配置，可通过升级来提升性能。控制台为第二名机甲战士增加一整套控制装置以及指挥与控制设施，通过提升主动性让长矛小队的协同更为出色。

到 3025 年，星际联盟时代的指挥控制台已极为罕见，因为以这种方式装备的机甲在战斗中往往是优先打击的目标。

防止机甲战士受到伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yeah Boss, whatever you brought me here, this is art! Next level cybernetics, at the base this is a simple DNI System with a VR pod, but all its failsafes got triple buffered and shunted into back up relays. On top of that, most of the basic Cockpit is gone, and you may not believe it, but the seat basically turns into a Wheelchair!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Torso Cockpit has long been a dream of BattleMech designers. By moving the MechWarrior to a more heavily protected area, an army would be able to keep its more experienced soldiers in the fight a lot longer. The idea remained a dream until the unlocking of the Helm Memory Core provided a jump-start to many technological projects.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Angel ECM Suite is an advanced version of the Guardian ECM Suite operating on a broader spectrum and greatly advances ECM technology on the battlefield. Development of the Angel began in the Draconis Combine shortly after the Battle of Luthien, but despite assistance from ComStar, cost overruns and internal problems within both powers kept it in its experimental stages for a long time and delayed its widespread deployment.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Guardian ECM Suite was introduced in 2597 by Johnston Industries of the Terran Hegemony. Designed to interfere with guided weaponry, targeting computers, and communication systems, the Guardian was typically used to shield allied units from such equipment by emitting a broad-band signal meant to confuse radar, infrared, ultraviolet, magscan and sonar sensors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守护者ECM套件由泰拉霸权的约翰斯顿工业公司于2597年推出. 它旨在干扰制导武器、目标追踪计算机和通信系统，通常通过发射宽频信号来迷惑雷达、红外、紫外、磁扫描和声纳传感器，从而保护友军单位免受此类设备的威胁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Compact Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to a Fusion Engine but uses much denser radiation shielding. The Compact fusion engine is 50% heavier for the same performance, but occupies less space in the center torso and is less likely to receive a critical hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 紧凑聚变引擎在机械结构上与聚变引擎相似，但使用密度高得多的辐射屏蔽。相同性能下紧凑聚变引擎重50%，但在中央躯干占用更少空间，也更不容易受到致命一击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fuel Cell engines are primarily used in civilian applications like rail systems, personal transport, and IndustrialMechs. Fuel Cell engines generate electrical power that is then used by the vehicle to operate its propulsion system. A Fuel Cell engine has several advantages over the typical Internal Combustion Engine. While they require an oxidizer to operate, they are readily able to accept a stored oxidizer along with their fuel, making it a good choice for submarines, satellites, and naval applications. As most fuel cells run on hydrogen and oxygen, they have no exhaust other than water vapor so Fuel Cells are also used as generators for buildings and other large structures. Cannot use Additional Cooling Kits, Exchanger or Banks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 燃料电池引擎主要用于民用领域，如铁路系统、个人交通工具和工业机甲. 燃料电池引擎产生电能，供车辆驱动其推进系统. 与典型的内燃机相比，燃料电池引擎具有多项优势. 虽然它们需要氧化剂才能运行，但它们能够轻松接受储存的氧化剂和燃料，因此是潜艇、卫星和海军应用的理想选择. 由于大多数燃料电池以氢和氧为燃料，除水蒸气外无其他排放物，因此燃料电池也用作建筑物和其他大型结构的发电机. 无法使用附加冷却套件、换热器或蓄热器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For all intents and purposes identical to a modern internal combustion engine, the I.C.E. in BattleTech is used mainly for conventional vehicles and IndustrialMechs. Its power output is less than a fusion engine of similar mass, meaning an I.C.E. needs to be heavier in order to have the same engine rating of a fusion engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从实际功能上来看，BattleTech中的内燃机与现代内燃机别无二致，主要用于常规车辆和工业机甲. 其输出功率低于同等质量的核聚变引擎，这意味着要达到与核聚变引擎相同的额定功率，内燃机必须做得更重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Light Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to an XL Engine, but uses Lostech energy shielding to allow a mech to survive the destruction of a side torso. The Light Fusion engine is 75% the mass for the same performance, but intrudes into the side torso bays of a BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型聚变引擎在机械结构上与XL引擎相似，但使用失落科技能量护盾，使机甲能在侧躯干被摧毁后幸存. 轻型聚变引擎在相同性能下质量为标准型的 75%，但会侵占战斗机甲侧躯干的舱室.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Compared to their Star League and Succession War-era counterparts, Primitive Engines are larger and less efficient; typically, modern engines are 80% the size of these early engines for the same amount of power.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与星际联盟和继承战争时期的同类产品相比，原始引擎体积更大、效率更低; 通常，现代引擎在产生相同功率的情况下，其体积仅为这些早期引擎的 80%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity. This Engine has extra armoring, increasing its weight but making it considerable more durable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的威力运作，燃料为轻氢与氢。 聚变引擎以其引擎等级来定义。对机甲而言，引擎等级是车辆质量与其期望最高步行或巡航速度的乘积。这台引擎带有额外装甲，增加了重量，但显著提升了耐久性。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Land Air Mech (LAM) Engine provides a specialized energy concept that allows the Mech to Change into a Wing in Ground Effect (WiGE) Unit. Unit can Change between LAM and 'Mech Mode. Land Air Mech (LAM) Mode: Mech will Hover above the Battlefield. Mech Walk Speeds Translate into Flight Speed. LAM Turbines provide additional 'Walk' Speed in Flight. When in LAM Mode, Unit can perform Extremely Long Jumps at increased Heat('Afterburner') When in LAM Mode, Unit will not be affected by Terrain/Ground
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陆空机甲（LAM）引擎提供了一种特殊的能量方案，可让机甲变形成地面效应翼（WiGE）单位。 单位可在LAM模式与机甲模式之间切换。 陆空机甲（LAM）模式：机甲将悬浮于战场之上。机甲的行走速度会转化为飞行速度。 LAM涡轮在飞行中提供额外的"行走"速度。 处于LAM模式时，单位可通过提高热量（"加力燃烧"）进行超远距离跳跃 处于LAM模式时，单位不受地形/地面影响

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Battle Armor can make swarm attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套战斗装甲可以进行蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the advanced properties and increased robustness of the Superheavy structure, the posibility arose to create an even lighter engine than thought possible before. Although this allows for larger engine cores to be used with Superheavy 'Mechs, the very high costs, increased side torso exposure and the not inconsiderable chance to start a nuclear chain reaction upon any damage taken are very obvious drawbacks. On top of this the specialized structure of the Ultralight engine also leads to considerably increased heat generation for the whole 'Mech. However, the Republic Institute for Strategic Combat did decide to develop the technology enough that it has been used in a few of their 'Mech designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借超重型结构先进的特性与更高的坚固程度，人们得以造出比以往想象中更轻的引擎。尽管这让超重型机甲可以使用更大的引擎核心，但其极高的成本、增加的侧躯干暴露面积，以及受到任何伤害时都可能引发核链式反应的不可忽视的几率，都是非常明显的缺点。除此之外，超轻引擎的特化结构还会导致整台机甲发热量大幅增加。不过，共和国战略战斗研究所确实决定把这项技术发展到足以在其若干机甲设计中使用的程度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extralight Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to a Fusion Engine but uses much lighter radiation shielding. The XL fusion engine is half the mass for the same performance. The XL fusion engine is twice as large as the standard fusion engine and intrudes into the side torso bays of a BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超轻型聚变引擎在机械结构上与聚变引擎相似，但使用了更轻的辐射屏蔽层. XL聚变引擎在相同性能下质量减半. XL聚变引擎的体积是标准聚变引擎的两倍，并侵入了战斗机甲侧躯干的舱室.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extralight Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to a Fusion Engine but uses much lighter radiation shielding. The XL fusion engine is half the mass for the same performance. The Clan XL fusion engine is 66% larger than the standard fusion engine and intrudes into the side torso bays of a BattleMech.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Need to contain the Power of a Star? Look no Further, we at Quicsell have unlocked the secrets of Star League Extra Light Engine Shielding! Reducing the Weight you Engine Core will need at unbeatable prices!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 需要驾驭恒星之力? 无需再寻寻觅觅，我们Quicsell已经破解了星际联盟超轻型引擎护罩的奥秘! 以无可匹敌的价格，为您引擎核心大幅减重!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit generates an extra EVASIVE charge from movement actions (up to its maximum).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位通过移动行动额外获得 1 层闪避（不超过上限）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The rogue scientists of the Society developed the Nova CEWS after hearing about the C3 Systems used by the Inner Sphere. By combining elements of the Watchdog CEWS with a C3 system, they created a tool that could find enemy forces, hide the unit using it in an ECM bubble, and automatically provide targeting data to other friendly units. In addition, the Nova CEWS didn't require pre-configuration for the C3 capability; It could be programmed on the fly to respond to availability of friendly forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 社会党的叛逆科学家在听闻内层星域使用的 C3 系统后，开发出了 Nova CEWS。他们把看门狗 CEWS 的组件与 C3 系统相结合，创造出一种工具：既能发现敌军，又能让使用它的单位隐藏在 ECM 气泡中，还能自动向其他友军提供瞄准数据。此外，Nova CEWS 的 C3 功能无需预先配置，可以随时编程，以响应友军的可用情况。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Watchdog Composite Electronic Warfare System (CEWS) combines the best of the Clan Active Probe systems and enhanced ECM suites. By performing the functions of both systems in one device, the Watchdog enables Clan OmniMechs to mount additional weapons or armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看门狗复合电子战系统（CEWS）结合了氏族主动探测器系统与增强型ECM套件的最佳之处。通过在一个装置中同时实现两套系统的功能，看门狗让氏族全方位机甲得以加装更多武器或装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apple Churchill 2000 Fire Control System was designed for use on a wide variety of BattleMechs. As more and more designs became LosTech, Apple Interstellar continued to manufacture the Churchill 2000 to an ever expanding market. Originally designed as a more nuanced, control system, it managed to find a market in many light, medium, and even some heavy BattleMechs that fielded Autocannon 2s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Apple Churchill 2000火控系统专为多种战斗机甲设计. 随着越来越多设计方案沦为失落科技，Apple Interstellar继续为日益扩大的市场生产Churchill 2000. 该系统最初作为更精细的控制系统而设计，最终在众多搭载AC/2自动炮的轻型、中型乃至部分重型战斗机甲中找到了市场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它能以物理方式帮助机甲战士瞄准对手。它用后坐力补偿器与陀螺稳定器防止武器因后坐力、移动等因素产生常规漂移，同时计算机会考虑大气与其他条件，给出目标的精确"提前量"。这让武器射击更为精准，尤其对本来就很精准的系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apple Churchill 1000 series fire control systems was developed on Machintosh during the late 2900s. Intended as an upgrade for most light and medium FCS systems that specialized with AC/2 weaponry at long ranges. It managed to find a few niche markets within the Solaris scene as a rather cheap, yet effective, FCS system for mechs that demand effectiveness at long range. Within the majority of the Inner Sphere however, it had received a second line relegation, in favor of the Apple Churchill 2000.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苹果·丘吉尔1000系列火控系统在2900年代末研发于麦金托什。它本意是作为大多数专精于远距离AC/2武器系统的轻型与中型火控系统的升级。它成功在索拉里斯圈子里找到了一些小众市场，成为那些要求远距离效能的机甲所用的一种相当便宜却有效的火控系统。然而在内天体大部分地区，它被降为二线，让位给苹果·丘吉尔2000。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Octagon Accutrack I was commissioned in 3025 as the ongoing mech conflicts found more and more skilled pilots utilizing obstructions in order to reduce oncoming fire. Outfitted with a simple prediction system, it allowed a 'Mech pilot a temporary window to land accurate shots on targets without fear of hitting the cover around the enemy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 八角精准追踪 I 于 3025 年受托研制，当时持续的机甲冲突中，越来越多技术娴熟的飞行员利用障碍物来减少来袭火力。它配备一套简易预测系统，让机甲飞行员获得一个短暂窗口，能对目标完成精准射击而不必担心击中敌人周围的掩体。
火控-突破: 启用突破一击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Octagon Accutrak II was designed with memory in mind. Being one of the few control systems with a dedicated prediction and memory module. Allowing it to calculate the expected position of a mech even as it enters cover; allowing it to continue to make accurate strikes against any target within the sensor's line of sight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 八边形精确追踪II在设计时把“记忆”放在心上。它是少数配备专用预测与记忆模块的控制系统之一，能让它在机甲进入掩体后仍计算出其预期位置，从而继续对传感器视线内的任何目标进行精准打击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sometime during the Clan Invasions, out of use Anti Air platforms equipped 'Mechs armed with the Flak-1A had their systems rewritten with replacement framework. Disabling the Aerospace Asset tracking system allowed the unit's radar to focus more on ground assets.  This greatly improved the spread of the LBX systems commonly utilized on 'Mechs, at the cost of a long refit cycle to re-ready the mech for Anti Air use.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Eagle Eye 400 FCS was originally pitched in combination with the Prototype Gauss Rifle developed by the Lyran Commonwealth at the time. A unique blend of targeting scopes, and high point calculation framework, allowed the pinpoint accurate gauss rifle to counteract the effects of down range turbulence from the safety of a firer's Mech. This helped minimize the training required to field such a highly accurate projectile by a third in tests.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鹰眼400火控系统最初是与当时莱兰联邦研发的原型磁轨炮配套推出的。一种独特的瞄准镜与高点计算框架的结合，让精准的磁轨炮得以在射手机甲的安全位置抵消远距湍流的影响。在测试中，这帮助把操作如此高精度弹丸所需的训练量减少了三分之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Eagle Eye 400X was a rather odd product of the Eagle Eye program. Taking the original's weather monitoring suite, it stripped out some of the down range forecasting effects at long range, in favor of a dedicated computer to balance the electrical throughput on the weapon. This allows the 'Mech to achieve better velocity of the slug, at the cost of accuracy beyond a medium range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鹰眼400X是鹰眼计划一个相当古怪的产物。它取原版的气象监测套件，削掉部分远距离下程预报功能，转而装入一台专用计算机来平衡武器的电力吞吐。这使机甲能让弹丸获得更好的初速，代价是超出中程后的精度。

Urban Legend tells us these systems were once advertised as delivering ''65% more bullet per bullet.''

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Clan's for the Pir-1. This Fire Control System pairs a set of computers, and sensors to smooth out the kinks in the automatic feeding lines of Machine Guns. Using fine micro-switches, this Controller can exchange rounds in an instant, always insuring the weapons are fed. The rest of the weight is taken up by a small windage calculator. Taking calculation strain away from the pilot, and routing it through yet another two computation centers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族为Pir-1研发的。这套火控系统把一组计算机与传感器配对，以消除机枪自动供弹线路中的小毛病。通过精细的微动开关，这个控制器能瞬时换弹，始终确保武器供弹。其余重量则用于一台小型风偏计算器，把计算负担从飞行员身上卸下，改由另外两个计算中心处理。

Coupled with a movement prediction algorithm, it allowed the 'Mech to engage in lightning fast strikes without telegraphing the intent of the Pilot. Closing the Enemies' dodging window by around half.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vehicular Direct Neural Interface was a special type of cybernetic implant developed for the Manei Domini. The system worked in principle similar to the Clans' Enhanced Imaging system, allowing MechWarriors, aerospace fighter pilots, battle armor troopers and even combat vehicle and Small Craft crews to become one with their machines. Unlike the EI system, however, VDNI was able to ward off the short-term negative effects of the technology by employing improved circuit breakers and forcing users to regularly ingest a special chemical agent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车辆直接神经接口是为布雷克之手研发的一种特殊赛博植入体。该系统原理上类似氏族的增强成像系统，让机师、航空战机飞行员、战斗装甲兵乃至战斗车辆与小型艇乘员能与自己的机器融为一体。不过与EI系统不同，VDNI通过采用改良断路器并迫使用户定期摄入一种特殊化学剂，得以抵御该技术的短期负面影响。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Compact Gyro is contructed from denser but more compact material and components, trading a increase in weight for halving the bulk of the device. Intended primarily to reduce the chance of penetrating fire from damaging the vital component by reducing its size, like its fusion engine counterpart, it also has the benefit of freeing up internal space in a 'Mech's normally tightly packed center torso. This Gyro has extra armoring, increasing its weight but making it considerable more durable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 紧凑陀螺仪由密度更高但更紧凑的材料与部件构成，以重量增加换取装置体积减半。它主要用于通过缩小体积来降低穿透火力损毁这一关键部件的概率；与聚变引擎同理，它还带来释放机甲通常拥挤不堪的中央躯干内部空间的额外好处。此陀螺仪带有额外装甲，增加重量但使其耐久性大幅提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OmniMech is a highly configurable type of BattleMech. OmniMechs mount some of their loadout in modular OmniPods. This gives Omnis the ability to replace damaged components and change battlefield role to fulfill mission requirements. Though not solely created for modular weapon loadouts, the OmniMech design greatly aids repair and construction. Once their modular weaponry and equipment is removed, the empty bays provide better access to repair the chassis. Damaged components such as arms and legs can be easily repaired in half the time it takes for common BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 万能机甲是一种高度可配置的战斗机甲类型. 万能机甲将其部分载荷安装在模块化的OmniPod中. 这使得万能机甲能够替换受损部件，并根据任务需求改变战场角色. 虽然并非仅为模块化武器载荷而创造，但万能机甲设计大大有助于维修和建造. 一旦其模块化武器和装备被移除，空置的舱室便能提供更好的通道来修理底盘. 诸如手臂和腿部等受损部件可以轻松修复，所需时间仅为普通战斗机甲的一半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OmniMech is a highly configurable type of BattleMech. OmniMechs mount some of their loadout in modular OmniPods. This gives Omnis the ability to replace damaged components and change battlefield role to fulfill mission requirements. Though not solely created for modular weapon loadouts, the OmniMech design greatly aids repair and construction. Once their modular weaponry and equipment is removed, the empty bays provide better access to repair the chassis. Damaged components such as arms and legs can be easily repaired in half the time it takes for common BattleMechs.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The LWP Gyro, or Large Weapons Platform, is a specially designed gyro for superheavy mechs improving their capabilities for firing very large weapons. While not as potent at reducing the frame vibrations as a Heavy Duty Gyro, the LWP weighs considerable less thus making it a better choice in some cases. One downside is that the Gyro does not work with OmniMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LWP(大型武器平台)陀螺仪，是一种专为超重型机甲设计的特殊陀螺仪，可提升其使用超大型武器进行射击的能力. 虽然其降低机体振动的效果不如重载型陀螺仪，但LWP陀螺仪的重量要轻得多，因此在某些情况下是更好的选择. 其缺点之一是该陀螺仪无法用于万能机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by ComStar, much like the XL Engine, the XL Gyro is constructed from lighter though more bulky material and components, increasing the size of the gyro by half in exchange for halving its weight. Also sharing the same disadvantage, the XL gyro can only weather the same amount of damage as a standard gyro before destruction, its increased bulk increasing the odds that any fire that penetrates the center torso will strike it and cripple the 'Mech. Further, unless a 'Mech mounts a Compact Engine, the XL gyro will take up the small amount of free space in the center torso region, forcing any equipment normally installed there to be moved to other positions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与XL引擎很像，XL陀螺仪由通讯之星研制，采用更轻但更臃肿的材料与部件，把陀螺仪体积增大一半以换取重量减半。它同样具有相同的缺点：XL陀螺仪在报废前只能承受与标准陀螺仪相同的伤害，而其增加的体积提高了任何穿透中央躯干的火力击中它、从而瘫痪机甲的概率。此外，除非机甲装的是紧凑引擎，XL陀螺仪会占满中央躯干区域那点少量自由空间，迫使原本安装在那里的设备挪到其他位置。
陀螺仪-XL: 稳定性阈值提高

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OmniMech is a highly configurable type of BattleMech. OmniMechs mount some of their loadout in modular OmniPods. This gives Omnis the ability to replace damaged components and change battlefield role to fulfill mission requirements. Though not solely created for modular weapon loadouts, the OmniMech design greatly aids repair and construction. Once their modular weaponry and equipment is removed, the empty bays provide better access to repair the chassis. Damaged components such as arms and legs can be easily repaired in half the time it takes for common BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 万能机甲是一种高度可配置的战斗机甲类型. 万能机甲将其部分载荷安装在模块化的OmniPod中. 这使得万能机甲能够替换受损部件，并根据任务需求改变战场角色. 虽然并非仅为模块化武器载荷而创造，但万能机甲设计大大有助于维修和建造. 一旦其模块化武器和装备被移除，空置的舱室便能提供更好的通道来修理底盘. 诸如手臂和腿部等受损部件可以轻松修复，所需时间仅为普通战斗机甲的一半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HarJel is a black gel developed by Clan Diamond Shark. When Destroyed Explodes. Incompatible to Stealth, Reflective, Reactive and Lamellor Armours

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Avalon Institute of Science had developed prototypes of so-called Compact Heat Sinks, with two single-strength compact heat sinks able to fit into the space of a one standard heat sink. Unfortunately much like the Compact Engine and Gyro, the use of denser but more compact materials increases the weight of each compact heat sink by half, generally restricting their use to heavier 'Mechs who have weight to spare.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新阿瓦隆科学院研发出所谓紧凑散热器的原型，两个单倍强度紧凑散热器能装进一个标准散热器的空间。不幸的是，与紧凑引擎和陀螺仪很像，使用密度更高但更紧凑的材料会让每个紧凑散热器的重量增加一半，这通常限制了它们只能用于有富余重量的较重机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Double Heat Sinks provide twice the efficiency of standard Heat Sinks, though with increased bulkiness. Like standard Heat Sinks, their effectiveness can be impacted by the surrounding environment, positively or negatively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双倍散热器的效率是标准散热器的两倍，但体积也更臃肿。与标准散热器一样，其效能会受周围环境影响，或正或负。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Functionally identical to a Clan-tech double heat sink, the lack of liquid and gas in the system reduces the chances of heat-based ammunition cook-off and means that laser heat sinks don't get the decreased performance on warmer worlds that single and double heat sinks have, while at the same time preventing laser heat sinks from taking advantage of immersion in water or colder weather to boost their performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在功能上与氏族科技的双重散热器完全相同，但系统中不含液体和气体，降低了弹药因受热而殉爆的几率，也意味着激光散热器不会像单重和双重散热器那样在较热的行星上性能下降；同时，激光散热器也无法借助浸水或寒冷天气来提升性能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laser Heat Sink (C): Decreased Heat After Move
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光散热器(氏族): 移动后热量减少

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laser Heat Sink (C): Increased Sensor Signature
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光散热器(氏族): 传感器信号特征增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These Prototype Double Heat Sinks were created by House Davion researchers. Unlike the Double Heat Sinks used by the Star League and after the War of 3039 these prototype units were smaller. As an experiment, they worked adequately, but their use of liquid heavy metals instead of the safer (if larger) radiators used in SLDF double heat sinks meant that they have been highly unstable. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些原型双重散热器由达维昂家族的研究人员创造。与星盟使用以及3039年战争之后使用的双重散热器不同，这些原型单位更小。作为实验它们运作得还行，但它们使用液态重金属，而非SLDF双重散热器中更安全（虽然更大）的散热片，这意味着它们极不稳定。易爆！
原型双散热器: 热量生成减少

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heat Sinks actively expel thermal energy generated from firing weaponry or other sources, preventing damage from excessive heat buildup. Their effectiveness can be impacted by the surrounding environment, positively or negatively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 散热器会主动排出武器开火或其他热源产生的热能，防止热量积累过多造成损坏. 它们的效能会受到周围环境的影响，影响可好可坏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Converts an SHS engine to CHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把单重散热器引擎转换为CHS。机甲的冷却系统为机甲内部组件提供散热，并提供兼容的延伸点以在整台机甲上增设散热器。它与引擎的封闭式冷却系统不同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attempting to extend the benefits of prototype heatsinks to the entire Engine Block, Luthien engineers created this experimental \"compact prototype\" cooling system, resulting in highly efficient, less bulky cooling at cost of some weight. While effective, it was prohibitively expensive to manufacture and maintain, and only a few were ever produced. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了把原型散热器的优势推广到整个引擎组，卢西恩的工程师造出了这套实验性"紧凑原型"冷却系统，以增加一些重量为代价，实现了高效且更不占空间的冷却。虽然有效，但制造与维护成本高得令人却步，最终只造出极少数几台。 易爆！
原型双散热器引擎套件

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激进散热器系统大幅改善机甲散热

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Converts an SHS engine to DHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Converts an SHS engine to CDHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把单重散热器引擎转换为CDHS。机甲的冷却系统为机甲内部组件提供散热，并提供兼容的延伸点以在整台机甲上增设散热器。它与引擎的封闭式冷却系统不同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Converts an SHS engine to LHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine. Unlike a normal heat sink which uses radiators and heat-conductive fluids to cool a 'Mech, a laser heat sink uses lasers to excite the hot exhaust gasses to a higher-energy state, converting the infrared energy of the gasses to light which is then shunted out of the 'Mech via a series of highly polished surfaces. Functionally identical to a Clan-tech double heat sink, the lack of liquid and gas in the system reduces the chances of heat-based ammunition cook-off and means that laser heat sinks don't get the decreased performance on warmer worlds that single and double heat sinks have, while at the same time preventing laser heat sinks from taking advantage of immersion in water or colder weather to boost their performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把单重散热器引擎转换为LHS。机甲的冷却系统为机甲内部组件提供散热，并提供兼容的延伸点以在整台机甲上增设散热器。它与引擎的封闭式冷却系统不同。与使用散热片和导热流体来冷却机甲的普通散热器不同，激光散热器用激光把高温废气激发到更高能态，将气体的红外能量转换为光，再通过一系列高度抛光的表面导出机甲。它在功能上与氏族科技双重散热器完全相同，系统中不含液体和气体，降低了弹药因受热而殉爆的几率，也意味着激光散热器不会像单重和双重散热器那样在较热的行星上性能下降；同时，激光散热器也无法借助浸水或寒冷天气来提升性能。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光散热器系统为较小引擎排出更少热量
