Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rule the battlefield with the Doering Electronics High Precision Convergence System (HPCS), a groundbreaking creation from the renowned Doering Electronics. Imbued with cutting-edge neural processors and gyro-stabilizers, the HPCS, guided by the Neural Precision Harmonizer, translates MechWarrior movements into meticulous precision. Its dynamic Tactical Aiming Interface adjusts in real-time, ensuring each shot hits its mark with unparalleled accuracy. Overcoming environmental challenges with Adaptive Ballistic Compensation and dominating low-light conditions with its Nocturnal Targeting Enhancement mode, the HPCS stands as Doering Electronics' pinnacle of precision, transforming chaos into calculated victory on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用多林电子高精度汇聚系统（HPCS）主宰战场——这是著名多林电子公司开创性的造物。HPCS注入尖端神经处理器与陀螺稳定器，并由神经精度协调器引导，把机甲战士的动作转化为缜密的精准。其动态战术瞄准界面实时调整，确保每一发都以无与伦比的精度命中目标。凭借自适应弹道补偿克服环境挑战，并以夜视瞄准增强模式主宰低光条件，HPCS代表着多林电子在精度上的巅峰，把混乱转化为战场上经过计算的胜利。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跳跃推进器将过热的空气引导喷出，以可控的方式推动机甲越过障碍。此外，它们还可用于发动令人胆寒的“自上而下的死亡”攻击。重型跳跃推进器专为 60 至 85 吨的机甲设计。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: BattleMech Mechanical Jump Boosters are intended to provide a simple, heat free jumping ability. Unlike Jump Jets, these Mechanical Jump Boosters are essentially giant hydraulic rams and myomer bundles that act as giant springs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲机械跳跃助推器旨在提供简单、无热量的跳跃能力。与跳跃推进器不同，这些机械跳跃助推器本质上是巨型液压柱和人造肌束，如同巨型弹簧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DFA attacks deal 10% less damage to the attacker.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ferro-Fibrous armor (FF) is a special type of armor used by vehicles and BattleMechs. Utilizing a weave of ferro-steel, ferro-titanium, and diamond weave fibers which boosts the tensile strength of the plating, it provides more protection per ton than standard armor, but takes up more space on the 'Mech or vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铁纤维装甲（FF）是车辆与战斗机甲使用的一种特殊装甲。它由铁钢、铁钛与金刚石编织纤维交织而成，提升了装甲板的抗拉强度，因此每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲，但会占用机甲或车辆上更多的空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor (cFF) is a special type of armor used by vehicles and BattleMechs. Utilizing a weave of ferro-steel, ferro-titanium, and diamond weave fibers which boosts the tensile strength of the plating, it provides more protection per ton than standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族铁纤维装甲(cFF)是车辆和战斗机甲使用的一种特殊装甲. 它利用铁钢、铁钛和金刚石编织纤维的混合编织，增强了装甲板的抗拉强度，每吨提供的防护比标准装甲更多.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Industrial Armor is functionally similar to Standard BattleMech Armor, but has a slightly lower maintenance cost due to its simplicity and ease to acquire in bulk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型工业装甲在功能上类似于标准战斗机甲装甲，但因其结构简单、易于批量获取，维护成本略低。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All incoming Melee damage reduced, extra Melee Damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有来袭近战伤害降低，近战伤害提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Impact Resistant Armor was originally developed by Lyran Commonwealth engineers for use on Solaris VII and other gladiatorial combat worlds. The armor consists of a flexible sealant that covers interlocking rings, covered by a thick flexible outer shell similar to tank treads. These rings flex when hit by a 'Mech sized melee weapon, reducing the damage. Despite being effective against physical weapons, the armor's flexibility means it is more likely to fail against armor-piercing ammunition and in hostile environments. Reserves 6 slots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抗冲击装甲最初由莱兰联邦的工程师开发，用于 Solaris VII 及其他角斗战斗世界。这种装甲由覆盖互锁环的柔性密封剂构成，外层再包覆类似坦克履带的厚实柔性外壳。被机甲级别的近战武器击中时，这些环会弯曲变形，从而减轻伤害。尽管对物理武器效果显著，但装甲的柔韧性也意味着它在面对穿甲弹药以及恶劣环境时更容易失效。占用 6 个槽位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Standard BattleMech armor is composed of several layers providing various degrees of protection and support. The first layer is extremely strong titanium alloyed with steel, the result of crystal alignment and radiation treatment, which is also very brittle. The second layer is a ceramic, cubic boron nitride, which combined with a web of artificial diamond fibers acts as a backstop to the steel layer. These two layers rest atop a titanium alloy honeycomb structure which provides support, and a layer of self-sealing polymer sealant which allows for space and underwater operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 标准战斗机甲装甲由多层结构组成，提供不同程度的保护和支撑. 第一层是极其坚固的钛钢合金，经过晶体取向和辐射处理，但同时也非常脆. 第二层是陶瓷立方氮化硼，与人造金刚石纤维网结合，作为钢层的背衬. 这两层置于钛合金蜂窝结构之上，该结构提供支撑，并覆盖一层自密封聚合物密封剂，以实现太空和水下作战能力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cockpit of the unit, complete with life support, sensors and fire control system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 单位的驾驶舱，含生命维持、传感器与火控系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extralight Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to a Fusion Engine but uses much lighter radiation shielding. The XL fusion engine is half the mass for the same performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超轻型聚变引擎在机械结构上与聚变引擎相似，但使用了更轻的辐射屏蔽层. XL聚变引擎在相同性能下质量减半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extralight Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to a Fusion Engine but uses much lighter radiation shielding. The XL fusion engine is half the mass for the same performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超轻型聚变引擎在机械结构上与聚变引擎相似，但使用了更轻的辐射屏蔽层. XL聚变引擎在相同性能下质量减半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extra-Extralight Fusion Engine is mechanically similar to a Fusion Engine but uses much lighter radiation shielding. The XXL fusion engine is one third the mass for the same performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超超轻型聚变引擎在机械结构上与聚变引擎类似，但使用轻得多的辐射屏蔽层. XXL聚变引擎在相同性能下质量仅为三分之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jump Jets funnel superheated air to propel 'Mechs over obstacles in a controlled manner. Additionally, they may also be used to perform the dreaded 'Death from Above' attack. Standard Jump Jets are specially designed for use on 'Mechs up to 55 tons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跳跃推进器喷射过热空气，以可控方式推动机甲越过障碍。此外，它们还可用于执行令人闻风丧胆的"从天而降"攻击。标准跳跃推进器专为 55 吨及以下的机甲设计。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每点行走 MP 的最大跳跃推进器数量

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跳跃推进器每格的产热量

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The pilot of each individual mech in the squad sits in a small cockpit. Any hits that penetrate the armor may take them out of the fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小队中每台单独机甲的飞行员都坐在一个小型座舱里。任何穿透装甲的命中都可能让他们退出战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供敌方单位的详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reduces effectiveness of stealthed and ECM shielded units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降低隐身与 ECM 护盾单位的效能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beagle Active Probe (BAP) is a suite of enhancement technology that, when attached to general electronic sensors, enables the equipped unit to detect and classify other battlefield units whether they are camouflaged or even shut down, with the exception of conventional infantry. The Clans never 'lost' the technology, but dispensed with the 'Beagle' surname when they polished the concept.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 比格犬主动探测器（BAP）是一套增强技术，接入常规电子传感器后，能让装备单位探测并识别其他战场单位——无论其是否伪装、甚至是否已停机，唯常规步兵除外。氏族从未"遗失"这项技术，只是在完善该概念后不再使用"比格犬"这个名号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C3i was developed by ComStar from Draconis Combine technology. While expanding its military strength to ward off the Clan Invasion, the ComGuard found their current C3 Master Computer incapable of handling the complexities of senary units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C3i系统由ComStar基于龙马天龙联合体的技术开发而来. 在为抵御氏族入侵而扩充军事实力时，ComGuard发现现有的C3主计算机无法处理六进制单位编组的复杂性.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Makes the carrier much harder to detect with stealth
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借隐身使车辆更难被发现

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon Light Polarization Shield was designed to make a 'Mech invisible to the naked eye. By using a primitive mimetic system, the outline of the 'Mech carrying it was broken up, blending into the surrounding terrain making it harder to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙光极化护盾旨在让机甲对肉眼不可见。通过使用一种原始拟态系统，携带它的机甲轮廓被打散，融入周围地形，使其更难被命中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jamming ECM, reduces sensor checks for enemies in field
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干扰型 ECM，降低战场上敌方的传感器检定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Angel ECM Suite is an advanced version of the Guardian ECM Suite operating on a broader spectrum and greatly advances ECM technology on the battlefield. Development of the Angel began in the Draconis Combine shortly after the Battle of Luthien, but despite assistance from ComStar, cost overruns and internal problems within both powers kept it in its experimental stages for a long time and delayed its widespread deployment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天使ECM套件是守护者ECM套件的高级版本，在更宽的频谱上运行，极大地推进了战场上的ECM技术. 天使的开发在天龙联合体于卢西恩战役后不久便开始，但尽管得到了ComStar的协助，成本超支以及双方内部问题使其长期停留在实验阶段，并推迟了其广泛部署.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jamming ECM, reduces sensor checks for enemies in field
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干扰型 ECM，降低战场上敌方的传感器检定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Guardian ECM Suite was introduced in 2597 by Johnston Industries of the Terran Hegemony. Designed to interfere with guided weaponry, targeting computers, and communication systems, the Guardian was typically used to shield allied units from such equipment by emitting a broad-band signal meant to confuse radar, infrared, ultraviolet, magscan and sonar sensors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守护者ECM套件由泰拉霸权的约翰斯顿工业公司于2597年推出. 它旨在干扰制导武器、目标追踪计算机和通信系统，通常通过发射宽频信号来迷惑雷达、红外、紫外、磁扫描和声纳传感器，从而保护友军单位免受此类设备的威胁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Environmental sealing adds airtight, hermetic protection to units that otherwise can't operate in vacuum, toxins, or underwater. The retrofit increases chassis mass and cost, fitting cabins and critical compartments with tight seals, air tanks, filters, and scrubbers. This keeps crews safe and mechanisms moving, but doesn't guarantee air-breathing engines will run submerged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 环境密封为原本无法在真空、毒素或水下作业的单位增加气密防护。这项改装会增加底盘的质量和成本，需要为座舱和关键舱室配备严密的密封、储气罐、过滤器和洗涤装置。这能保证乘员安全、机械正常运转，但无法保证需要吸入空气的引擎在水下也能工作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Much more than the first aid kit you keep in the glove box, the typical paramedic equipment kit consists of much the same emergency trauma gear one might see on a hospital \"crash cart\" - defibrillators, emergency chemical stimulants and tranquilizers, high-pressure preserving sleeves, intubation gear and the like.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它远不止是你放在手套箱里的那只急救包那么简单；典型的医护装备套件所包含的应急创伤器材，与医院“抢救车”上常见的那些大同小异——除颤器、应急化学兴奋剂与镇静剂、高压保存套管、插管器具等等。
防止机甲战士受到 [AMT] 点伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remote Sensor Dispensers are small cargo bays with an attached dispenser used to place Remote Sensors. These dispensers are normally mounted on support vehicles, used to secure newly-established landing zones or defensive perimeters. Each RSD can carry up to thirty short-range sensors, typically a mix of thermal, electromagnetic and seismic sensors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程传感器投放器(RSD)是一种小型货舱，配备有用于部署远程传感器的投放装置. 这些投放器通常安装在支援车辆上，用于保障新建立的着陆区或防御警戒范围. 每个RSD最多可携带三十个短程传感器，通常包含热成像、电磁和地震传感器的混合配置.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Searchlight hardwired into the System Comm and Sensors Array allows to easier detect and highlight nearby Targets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与系统通讯和传感器阵列硬连接的探照灯，可以更容易地探测并标记附近目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seachlight illuminates target, making it easier to hit
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 探照灯照亮目标，使其更容易被击中

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seachlight illuminates target, making it more visible
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 探照灯照亮目标，使其更显眼
定点射击可靠性提高一倍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers greatly enhances the Combat capabilities of any Mech it is installed on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机极大提升任何安装它的机甲的作战能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Federated Suns introduced the Composite Internal Structure. Inspired by the Endo Steel chassis, the FedSuns engineers produced a chassis that was light weight but wasn't as bulky as the Endo Steel skeleton. Though they were successful, the materials used in the Composite Structure were incredibly fragile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联邦太阳国推出了复合内部结构。受内骨架底盘启发，联邦太阳国的工程师造出了重量轻但不似内骨架般臃肿的底盘。虽然他们成功了，但复合结构所用的材料极为脆弱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487, Endo Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. Using zero-G manufacturing techniques that uniformly mix high-density steel with lower-density titanium and aluminum, the process produces a metal twice as strong per unit of weight as standard skeleton materials thus halving the weight of the chassis, but at an increase in overall bulk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 【Endo-Steel】钢内骨结构由泰拉霸权于2487年研发，专为战斗机甲骨架而设计. 利用零重力制造技术，将高密度钢与低密度钛和铝均匀混合，该工艺生产出的金属在单位重量上的强度是标准骨架材料的两倍，从而使底盘重量减半，但整体体积有所增加.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487 and improved by the Clans after their Exodus, Clan Endo-Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. Using zero-G manufacturing techniques that uniformly mix high-density steel with lower-density titanium and aluminum, the process produces a metal twice as strong per unit of weight as standard skeleton materials, thus halving the weight of the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 【Endo-Steel (C)】钢内骨结构由泰拉霸权于2487年研发，并在氏族流亡后由其改进. 氏族钢内骨结构专为战斗机甲骨架而设计. 利用零重力制造技术，将高密度钢与低密度钛和铝均匀混合，该工艺生产出的金属在单位重量上的强度是标准骨架材料的两倍，从而使底盘重量减半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chassis of IndustrialMechs is similar to that BattleMechs but uses heavier, less efficient materials and bulkier myomer bundles. The resulting chassis is twice as heavy as a comparable BattleMechs and less resistant to weapons fire, though more suited to physical labor and cheaper to produce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业机甲的结构与机甲类似，但使用了更重、效率更低的材料以及体积更大的肌纤维束. 由此制成的结构重量是同级机甲的整整两倍，对武器火力的耐受性也更差，不过更适合体力劳动，生产成本也更低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Internal Structure of a BattleMech forms the skeletal structure of the 'Mech to which all components are mounted. The Standard Internal Structure of a 'Mech weighs 10% of its max tonnage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲的内部结构构成机甲的骨架，所有部件都安装在它上面。机甲的标准内部结构重量为其最大吨位的 10%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ultralight Mech has a mass between ten to fifteen metric tons, and are the smallest BattleMechs produced. Due to their small size they are quite a rare sight. Besides their smaller size, they are otherwise very similar to standard BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超轻型机甲的质量介于十到十五公吨之间，是已生产的最小战斗机甲。由于体型小巧，它们相当罕见。除了体型更小之外，它们在其他方面与标准战斗机甲非常相似。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 模块化装甲是康星工程师在研发硬化装甲时创造的权宜之计：研究途中他们偶然撞上一个古老思路——在单位上安装一个特殊框架，即可让某部位承载超出内部框架常规上限的额外装甲防护。 不可与隐身同时使用

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Much more than the first aid kit you keep in the glove box, the typical paramedic equipment kit consists of much the same emergency trauma gear one might see on a hospital \"crash cart\" - defibrillators, emergency chemical stimulants and tranquilizers, high-pressure preserving sleeves, intubation gear and the like.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它远不止是你放在手套箱里的那只急救包那么简单；典型的医护装备套件所包含的应急创伤器材，与医院“抢救车”上常见的那些大同小异——除颤器、应急化学兴奋剂与镇静剂、高压保存套管、插管器具等等。
防止机甲战士受到 [AMT] 点伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部分机翼系统使跳跃推进器的跳跃距离提升 30%

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The partial wing system offers increased jump capability. In addition, its large surface area allows a 'Mech to more efficiently radiate excess heat.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Anti-Battle Armor Pod or B-Pod functions like an Anti-Personnel Pod except that it is designed to blast through the armor of battle suits. It does this by using explosive bomblets instead of shrapnel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反战斗装甲弹舱（B-Pod）功能类似于反人员弹舱，但其设计目的是击穿战斗服的装甲. 它是通过使用爆炸式子炸弹而非破片来实现这一点的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Active Probe (AP) is your most basic battlefield probe system, allowing a battlemech's sensors to filter out and examine a wider array of information.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主动探测器（AP）是你最基本的战场探测系统，让战斗机甲的传感器能过滤并检视更广泛的信息。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beagle Active Probe (BAP) is a suite of enhancement technology that, when attached to general electronic sensors, enables the equipped unit to detect and classify other battlefield units whether they are camouflaged or even shut down, with the exception of conventional infantry. The Clans never 'lost' the technology, but dispensed with the 'Beagle' surname when they polished the concept.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 比格犬主动探测器（BAP）是一套增强技术，接入常规电子传感器后，能让装备单位探测并识别其他战场单位——无论其是否伪装、甚至是否已停机，唯常规步兵除外。氏族从未"遗失"这项技术，只是在完善该概念后不再使用"比格犬"这个名号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mech components are sealed inside small compartments and thick buffering material is added. This extends the time before maintenance is required, and allows extended deployments in even the worst corrosive atmospheres. This also has the positive effect of protecting vital components from the damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲组件被密封在小型隔间内，并添加了厚实的缓冲材料. 这延长了需要维护前的使用时间，并允许在即使是最恶劣的腐蚀性大气环境中进行长期部署. 这同时也具有保护关键组件免受损伤的积极作用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Electric Discharge ProtoMech Armor was developed by Scientist Glenneth of Clan Fire Mandrill in 3066. By 3071 the Mandrills and The Society had perfected the armor. To maximize the damage generated by a ProtoMech's physical attack, Glenneth wove a series of compound capacitors through the armor. These capacitors draw power from the ProtoMech's fusion engine, storing an electrical charge. When a ProtoMech with EDP armor performs a physical attack the capacitors discharge and subject the target to a taser-like effect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 放电原生机甲装甲由火沸沸部族的科学家格伦尼斯于3066年研制，到3071年沸沸部族与“学会”已将其完善。为使原生机甲肉搏攻击产生的伤害最大化，格伦尼斯在装甲中编入了一系列复合电容器。这些电容器从原生机甲的聚变引擎取电，储存电荷；当装备放电装甲的原生机甲进行肉搏攻击时，电容器放电，让目标承受类似电击枪的效果。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An advanced composite armor only useable on ProtoMech units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种仅可用于原型机甲单位的先进复合装甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A ProtoMech's cockpit and control system contains the space for the pilot and associated support systems, including the modified form of the enhanced imaging link used to operate the machine without a gyroscope. Unlike a BattleMech cockpit, the ProtoMech cockpit does not reside in the Proto’s head section, but in the torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型机甲的座舱与控制系统包含飞行员及相关支持系统的空间，其中包括用于在没有陀螺仪的情况下操作机器的改良型增强成像链路。与战斗机甲座舱不同，原型机甲座舱不在机甲的头部，而在躯干。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit can use its movement before or after shooting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位可在射击前或射击后移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit generates an extra EVASIVE charge from movement actions (up to its maximum).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位通过移动行动额外获得 1 层闪避（不超过上限）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed by The Society for their experimental ProtoMechs, the Extended Jump Jet system boosts the thrust output of each jet at the cost of overall weight of the assembly.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The pilot of each ProtoMech sits in a high-tech cacoon of composite armor and neural link equipment. If breached by enemy fire it could become their coffin. Mech pilots talk about the mech becoming an extension of one's body. But for a protomech warrior their suit becomes their body. It's senses are fed directly into theirs. The impulses from their motor cortex are translated into its motions. Any violence done to, or by, the protomech is experienced as if the suit was their real body. Protomech pilots have a reputation for being crazy, but they don't all start that way; If the degenerative effects of Enhanced Imaging implants don't get you, the PTSD will.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每台原型机甲的飞行员都坐在一个由复合装甲与神经链路设备构成的高科技茧里。若被敌方火力击穿，它可能变成他们的棺材。机甲飞行员说机甲成了身体的延伸。但对原型机甲战士而言，他们的战斗服就是他们的身体。它的感官直接输入他们的感官。他们运动皮层的冲动被转译成它的动作。任何加诸原型机甲或由它施加的暴力，都被体验为仿佛这套战斗服是他们真正的身体。原型机甲飞行员以疯狂著称，但他们并非一开始都如此；如果增强成像植入体的退化效应没找上你，创伤后应激障碍也会。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ProtoMech Quad Melee Weapon System (MWS) was first developed in 3064 by The Society. Similar in purpose to the Talons and Claws used in the Solaris VII arenas, the Melee Weapon System is designed to add damage to a ProtoMech's physical attacks. First deployed in 3066 the Melee Weapon System is added to ProtoMechs as a series of claws, tusks, talons, horns, or slashing tail. These modifications are more than cosmetic, inflicting damage on enemy units. Another benefit however is how their appearance can affect enemy troops.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型机甲四足近战武器系统（MWS）于3064年由协会首次研发。其用途与索拉里斯VII竞技场中使用的利爪与钩爪类似，该近战武器系统旨在为原型机甲的物理攻击增加伤害。它于3066年首次部署，以一系列爪、獠牙、利爪、角或鞭状尾的形式加装到原型机甲上。这些改装不只是装饰，而会对敌方单位造成伤害。另一项好处则是它们的外形对敌军士气的影响。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jamming ECM, reduces sensor checks for enemies in field
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干扰型 ECM，降低战场上敌方的传感器检定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jamming ECM, reduces sensor checks for enemies in field
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干扰型 ECM，降低战场上敌方的传感器检定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Guardian ECM Suite was introduced in 2597 by Johnston Industries of the Terran Hegemony. Designed to interfere with guided weaponry, targeting computers, and communication systems, the Guardian was typically used to shield allied units from such equipment by emitting a broad-band signal meant to confuse radar, infrared, ultraviolet, magscan and sonar sensors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守护者ECM套件由泰拉霸权的约翰斯顿工业公司于2597年推出. 它旨在干扰制导武器、目标追踪计算机和通信系统，通常通过发射宽频信号来迷惑雷达、红外、紫外、磁扫描和声纳传感器，从而保护友军单位免受此类设备的威胁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basically still Electronics Counter Measures that scrambles Enemy Targeting and Missile Systems, though less elegant because it simply sends ancient Heavy Metal and Rock over any and all frequencies, even IR and Magnetic...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本质上仍是一种电子对抗措施，能够扰乱敌方瞄准与导弹系统，只是没那么雅致——它只是把老派的重金属和摇滚乐通过所有频率广播出去，连红外和磁力频道都不放过……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Magnetic Clamp System allows a ProtoMech to ride on BattleMechs, in similar fashion to Battle Armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁力夹具系统允许原型机甲以类似战斗装甲的方式搭乘战斗机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Battle Armor can make swarm attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套战斗装甲可以进行蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Magnetic Clamp System: Allow Battle Armor Mounting
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁力夹具系统: 允许战斗装甲搭载

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protomech Myomer Booster is essentialy a Proto-scaled version of MASC
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型机甲肌纤维助推器本质上是MASC的原型机甲尺度版本

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Partial Wing System increases Jump Jet jump distance by 30%
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部分机翼系统使跳跃推进器的跳跃距离提升 30%

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The partial wing system offers increased jump capability. In addition, its large surface area allows a 'Mech to more efficiently radiate excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部分机翼系统提供更强的跳跃能力。此外，其大面积让机甲能更高效地散发多余热量。
原型机甲部分机翼系统

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供敌方单位的详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reduces effectiveness of stealthed and ECM shielded units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降低隐身与 ECM 护盾单位的效能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beagle Active Probe (BAP) is a suite of enhancement technology that, when attached to general electronic sensors, enables the equipped unit to detect and classify other battlefield units whether they are camouflaged or even shut down, with the exception of conventional infantry. The Clans never 'lost' the technology, but dispensed with the 'Beagle' surname when they polished the concept.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 比格犬主动探测器（BAP）是一套增强技术，接入常规电子传感器后，能让装备单位探测并识别其他战场单位——无论其是否伪装、甚至是否已停机，唯常规步兵除外。氏族从未"遗失"这项技术，只是在完善该概念后不再使用"比格犬"这个名号。
定点射击可靠性提高一倍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The quadruped-style ProtoMechs faced numerous minor design hurdles, not the least of which was the unique quirk of the pilot-ProtoMech interface that virtually demanded a human-style gait and mobility. When these issues were worked out—either through intensive training or use of the Society's infamous Feralize treatments — the four-legged ProtoMechs that resulted achieved faster mobility and greater payload capacity than their bipedal equivalents. ProtoQuads could even make use of turret-based weapons similar to the Inner Sphere’s fourlegged battlesuits, and could be built in the standard weight range as well as the Ultraheavy category.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 四足型原型机甲曾面临诸多细小的设计难题，其中尤为突出的是机师与原型机甲接口的独特特性——它几乎要求机甲具备人类式的步态与机动方式。当这些问题——无论是通过强化训练，还是动用学会臭名昭著的“野化”处理——得到解决后，由此诞生的四足原型机甲在机动速度与载荷能力上都超过了同等重量的双足型号。原型四足机甚至可以使用类似内层星域四足战斗服的炮塔式武器，并且既能按标准重量范围建造，也能归入超重型级别。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Internal Structure of a ProtoMech forms the skeletal structure of the 'Mech to which all components are mounted, such as the bones and joints. The Internal Structure of a ProtoMech weighs 10% of its max tonnage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型机甲的内部结构构成机甲的骨架，所有组件都安装在其上，如同骨骼与关节。原型机甲的内部结构重量为其最大吨位的10%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ProtoMechs mass between two to fifteen metric tons and stand anywhere from four to six meters in height, with the cockpit mounted in the upper chest. With their fusion engines, they can move considerably faster than battle armor but are more compact than BattleMechs. It was not until the development of the Enhanced Imaging (EI) system by Clan scientists that the ProtoMech concept became a viable one. The EI control system laid the groundwork needed by Smoke Jaguar scientists for controlling the ProtoMech. The ability to give the pilot direct neural control eliminated the need for a gyroscope and full-sized cockpit. This gave room for the pilot to ride in the torso while still allowing ample space for weapons. The ultimate goal of these machines is for a Point of five, working in unison, to be as effective as a BattleMech, while requiring less than half the amount of construction resources.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型机甲质量为二至十五公吨，高度四至六米，座舱装在胸部上方。凭借聚变引擎，它们能比战斗装甲快得多地移动，又比战斗机甲更紧凑。直到氏族科学家研发出增强成像（EI）系统，原型机甲的概念才变得可行。EI控制系统为烟虎科学家提供了控制原型机甲所需的基础。让飞行员实现直接神经控制的能力，免除了对陀螺仪和全尺寸座舱的需求。这让飞行员能坐在躯干内，同时仍为武器留出充足空间。这些机器的终极目标，是让一个五点编队协同作战时能达到一台战斗机甲的效能，而所需建造资源不到一半。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uniquely designed for bipedal Ultras as a consequence of the design's specialized motive systems, Gliders are low-altitude, limited-flight ProtoMechs that rely on a combination of thrust and glide wings that effectively mimic how LAMs operate in AirMech mode. Their elaborate flight systems, which include an adapted form of ProtoMech partial wing technology, modified jump thrusters, and a specialized musculature, are specifically designed to give them greater mobility in the air. As a result, Gliders have very little ground speed.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The quadruped-style ProtoMechs faced numerous minor design hurdles, not the least of which was the unique quirk of the pilot-ProtoMech interface that virtually demanded a human-style gait and mobility. When these issues were worked out—either through intensive training or use of the Society's infamous Feralize treatments — the four-legged ProtoMechs that resulted achieved faster mobility and greater payload capacity than their bipedal equivalents. ProtoQuads could even make use of turret-based weapons similar to the Inner Sphere’s fourlegged battlesuits, and could be built in the standard weight range as well as the Ultraheavy category.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Federated Suns introduced the Composite Internal Structure. Inspired by the Endo Steel chassis, the FedSuns engineers produced a chassis that was light weight but wasn't as bulky as the Endo Steel skeleton. Though they were successful, the materials used in the Composite Structure were incredibly fragile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联邦太阳国推出了复合内部结构。受内骨架底盘启发，联邦太阳国的工程师造出了重量轻但不似内骨架般臃肿的底盘。虽然他们成功了，但复合结构所用的材料极为脆弱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Lyran attempt to improve Endo-Steel, Endo-Composite uses a mix of standard and Endo-Steel components to produce a chassis that weighs only 75% of the original, at an increase in overall bulk. Add exactly 5 Endo-Composite slots to reduce your internal structure weight to 75%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为莱兰对内层钢的一次改进尝试，内层复合结构混合使用标准与内层钢组件，造出重量仅为原版75%的底盘，代价是整体体积增加。 精确添加5个内层复合结构槽位，可将内部结构重量降至75%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan version of the Endo-Composite armor originally developed by the Lyrans. The big difference is that it requires two extra slots less. Add exactly 3 Endo-Composite (C) slots to reduce your internal structure weight to 75%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是部族版的内骨架复合装甲，最初由莱兰人研制。最大的差别在于它少需要两个槽位。 只需加入 3 个内骨架复合（C）槽位，即可把内部结构重量降到 75%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Endo-Composite internal structure for Superheavy BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为超重型战斗机甲强化的内骨骼复合内部结构。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Endo-Composite internal structure for Superheavy BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为超重型战斗机甲强化的内骨骼复合内部结构。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487, Endo Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. Using zero-G manufacturing techniques that uniformly mix high-density steel with lower-density titanium and aluminum, the process produces a metal twice as strong per unit of weight as standard skeleton materials thus halving the weight of the chassis, but at an increase in overall bulk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 【Endo-Steel】钢内骨结构由泰拉霸权于2487年研发，专为战斗机甲骨架而设计. 利用零重力制造技术，将高密度钢与低密度钛和铝均匀混合，该工艺生产出的金属在单位重量上的强度是标准骨架材料的两倍，从而使底盘重量减半，但整体体积有所增加.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487 and improved by the Clans after their Exodus, Clan Endo-Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. Using zero-G manufacturing techniques that uniformly mix high-density steel with lower-density titanium and aluminum, the process produces a metal twice as strong per unit of weight as standard skeleton materials, thus halving the weight of the chassis, but at an increase in overall bulk. Reserves 7 Endo-Steel slots to halve your internal structure weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部族内骨架由地球霸权于2487年研制，并在部族大逃亡后由部族改良，专为战斗机甲骨架而设计。它采用零重力制造工艺，把高密度钢与低密度钛铝均匀混合，产出的金属单位重量强度是标准骨架材料的两倍，从而把底盘重量减半，但整体体积有所增大。 保留 7 个内骨架槽位，使内部结构重量减半。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Endo-Steel internal structure for Superheavy BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为超重型战斗机甲强化的内骨骼内部结构。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Endo-Steel internal structure for Superheavy BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为超重型战斗机甲强化的内骨骼内部结构。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chassis of IndustrialMechs is similar to that BattleMechs but uses heavier, less efficient materials and bulkier myomer bundles. The resulting chassis is twice as heavy as a comparable BattleMechs and less resistant to weapons fire, though more suited to physical labor and cheaper to produce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业机甲的结构与机甲类似，但使用了更重、效率更低的材料以及体积更大的肌纤维束. 由此制成的结构重量是同级机甲的整整两倍，对武器火力的耐受性也更差，不过更适合体力劳动，生产成本也更低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Word of Blake invention, incorporating advances from Composite and Endo Steel Research have they managed to make a far lighter Conversation Gear for their Celestial LAM's
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是布雷克之言的一项发明：结合了复合结构与内层钢研究的进展，他们为自家的天界LAM造出了轻得多的变形机构

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Star League attempt to use Endo-Steel production processes on LAM Structure, yielding a far lighter Conversation System but at a much Increased Bulk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是星际联盟时期的一次尝试，将钢内骨结构生产工艺应用于陆空机甲结构上，从而大幅减轻了形态转换系统的重量，但代价是体积显著增加.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Environmental sealing adds airtight, hermetic protection to units that otherwise can't operate in vacuum, toxins, or underwater. The retrofit increases chassis mass and cost, fitting cabins and critical compartments with tight seals, air tanks, filters, and scrubbers. This keeps crews safe and mechanisms moving, but doesn't guarantee air-breathing engines will run submerged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 环境密封为原本无法在真空、毒素或水下作业的单位增加气密防护。这项改装会增加底盘的质量和成本，需要为座舱和关键舱室配备严密的密封、储气罐、过滤器和洗涤装置。这能保证乘员安全、机械正常运转，但无法保证需要吸入空气的引擎在水下也能工作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super-cooled myomer (SCM) is a RISC experimental modification to BattleMechs to improve their cooling. Interlacing myomers with special friction-reducing fluids and secondary coolant lines, and sheathing key bundles in an extra layer of thermal insulation, the new musculature all but eliminated waste heat caused by routine movement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 【Super-Cooled Myomer】超级冷却肌纤维（SCM）是RISC对战斗机甲进行的一种实验性改装，旨在改善其散热性能. 通过将肌纤维与特殊的减摩液和次级冷却管路交织在一起，并为关键纤维束包裹一层额外的隔热层，这种新型肌肉组织几乎消除了日常运动所产生的废热.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As part of the experiments that led to Triple Strength Myomer, the NAIS and other research firms went through several prototypes. Though unsuited for combat use, there were several formulations that held promise for Industrial applications. This information, allowed IndustrialMech manufacturers to create Industrial Triple Strength Myomer which was ideally suited for loading, hauling, and other heavy lift tasks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在催生三重肌纤维束（TSM）的实验中，新阿瓦隆科学研究院（NAIS）及其他研究机构经历了多轮原型开发. 虽然这些原型并不适合战斗用途，但其中几种配方在工业应用上展现出巨大潜力. 基于这些信息，工业机甲制造商成功研发出工业型三重肌纤维束，非常适合装卸、拖运及其他重型起重作业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Converts an SHS engine to DHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 将单散热器引擎转换为双散热器引擎。机甲的冷却系统为机甲内部部件提供散热，并提供兼容的扩展接口，以便在机甲各处加装额外散热器。它与引擎的封闭式冷却系统不同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DEPLOYS A UAV UNDER YOUR CONTROL. May be either the default UAV or other compatible units from Beacons you own aboard the Argo. Costs 10,000 C-Bills per use! Press the button, then hold Shift while placing the unit to open the selection menu! Basic UAV carries a BA RL5. It can Sensor ping enemies in a 30 meter radius with a 3 turn cooldown. 20 armor, 10/15 move, 150 meter fly height.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 部署一架由你控制的无人机。可以是默认无人机，或你 aboard 阿尔戈时拥有的信标中其他兼容单位。 每次使用花费10,000 C-Bill！ 按下按钮，然后在放置单位时按住 Shift 以打开选择菜单！ 基础无人机携带一门战斗装甲RL5。它能以30米半径进行传感器探测，冷却3回合。20点装甲，10/15移动，150米飞行高度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently, under the Endosteel you see, is actual bone. I don't know where the bones came from, maybe some massive beast from Hunter's Paradise I guess? They then decided to coat them in several layers of Endosteel, and then formed an edge that can cut effortlessly through, well... everything we've tried. I just really hope we never drop one, or it could cut the Argo in half. On a totally unrelated topic, have you seen my request for Mechtech bonuses?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 显然，你看到的这层内层钢下面其实是真正的骨头。我不知道这些骨头从哪来的，大概是猎人天堂上某种巨兽吧？他们随后决定给它覆上几层内层钢，再磨出一个刃口，能毫无费力地切开……我们试过的一切。我真希望我们永远别把它掉在地上，否则它能把阿戈号劈成两半。说个完全无关的话题，你看到我关于机修技师奖金的申请了吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Makes the carrier much harder to detect with stealth
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借隐身使车辆更难被发现

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Two years after introducing their BattleMech Stealth Armor, the Capellan Confederation began experimenting with stealth armor for combat vehicles. In 3067 the armor reached the experimental stage. By 3084 advances in armor production for the Inner Sphere would allow this class of Stealth armor to enter limited mass-production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在推出他们的战斗机甲潜行装甲两年后，卡佩拉联邦开始着手研究用于战斗车辆的潜行装甲. 到3067年，这种装甲已经进入实验阶段. 到了3084年，内天体装甲生产技术的进步使这一类型的潜行装甲得以进入有限规模的量产阶段.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Vehicle Stealth Armor: Decreased Visual Signature
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车辆潜行装甲: 视觉特征降低
车辆潜行装甲: 潜行

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The supercharger allows a 'Mech to exceed its normal engine output, increasing walk and run distance at the cost of higher heat generation. Activatable: EXPLODES ON FAILURE! Some superstitious believe it causes the common cold.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增压器可让机甲超出正常引擎输出，以更高热量为代价提升行走与奔跑距离。 可激活：失效时爆炸！ 有些迷信的人相信它会导致感冒。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Cargo Container carried by transport vehicles. It's usually not incredibly valuable but its content can still has some value or be actual equipment or weapons in rare cases.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CASE is short for Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment. In an internal explosion event, CASE prevents the explosion from traveling to adjacent mech compartments. While CASE does not prevent damage to occur in the protected area, it does prevent it from passing through, helping to prevent ammo explosions to reach the center torso of a mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CASE是细胞式弹药存储设备的缩写. 在发生内部爆炸时，CASE能阻止爆炸蔓延到相邻的机甲舱室. 虽然CASE无法防止受保护区域本身受损，但它能阻止爆炸穿透，有助于防止弹药爆炸波及机甲的中心躯干.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For all intents and purposes identical to a modern internal combustion engine, the I.C.E. in BattleTech is used mainly for conventional vehicles and IndustrialMechs. Its power output is less than a fusion engine of similar mass, meaning an I.C.E. needs to be heavier in order to have the same engine rating of a fusion engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从实际功能上来看，BattleTech中的内燃机与现代内燃机别无二致，主要用于常规车辆和工业机甲. 其输出功率低于同等质量的核聚变引擎，这意味着要达到与核聚变引擎相同的额定功率，内燃机必须做得更重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While conventional armor isn't plagued by the heat problems mechs face, they still need cooling for engines and weapons. The components and technology are essentially identical.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然常规装甲不受机甲所面临的热量问题困扰，它们仍需为引擎与武器散热。部件与技术本质相同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This vehicle Infantry Compartment has Firing Ports, allowing carried Battle Armors fire their weapons from inside the vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该车辆的步兵舱设有射击孔，允许运载的战斗装甲从车内向外开火射击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a series of cranes and hoists that allow the lifting of units, be they mech, tank, or turret. Airlifted units can take actions while lifted but cannot move in any way while lifted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一系列起重机与吊钩系统，能够吊起单位，无论是机甲、坦克还是炮台. 被吊运的单位可以采取行动，但在吊运期间无法以任何方式移动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: VTOL Lift Hoist: Allow Airlift Enemies
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTOL升降吊机: 允许空运敌方单位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: VTOL Lift Hoist: Enable Override Global Capacity
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTOL升降吊机: 启用全局容量覆盖

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: VTOL Lift Hoist: Set External Lift Capacity
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTOL升降吊机: 设置外部吊运容量

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A weaponized Microwave dish used for Deep Space Communication. Don't stand in front of the array. It melts more than chocolate bars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一件用于深空通讯的武器化微波天线。别站在阵列前面。它熔化的可不止巧克力棒。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Microwave Blaster Aura: Decreased Enemies Cooling
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 微波爆能炮光环: 降低敌方散热效率

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crates and crates of small arms munitions, fuel, chemicals and other war materiel. There's always a buyer for such things.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一箱又一箱的轻武器弹药、燃料、化学品和其他战争物资。这种东西总有买家。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Munitions: Increased Receive Critical Hit Chance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药: 受到暴击的几率增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This vehicle has an open cargo area. It can be externally mounted by Battle Armor, even if they have to sit on crates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种车辆拥有开放式货舱区。战斗装甲可以外挂在它上面，哪怕得坐在箱子上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A VTOL Chin Turret is a small turret mounted underneath the nose of a VTOL. It is identical to a standard vehicle turret except that it does not enable firing directly to the rear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTOL下颌炮塔是安装在VTOL机鼻下方的小型炮塔. 它与标准车辆炮塔相同，只是无法直接向后射击.
定点射击可靠性提高一倍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit generates an extra EVASIVE charge from movement actions (up to its maximum).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位通过移动行动额外获得 1 层闪避（不超过上限）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Handheld Light AC 5 with 1 ton of Ammo and a Half Ton of Armor
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持轻型自动炮5，配1吨弹药和半吨装甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Hand Held Rotary AC2. Theres a inscription on it 'This is my rifle. There are many like it, but this one is mine. My rifle is my best friend. It is my life. I must master it as I must master my life. My rifle, without me, is useless. Without my rifle, I am useless.'
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具手持式旋转自动炮2。上面刻着一句话："这是我的步枪。像它这样的有很多，但这一支是我的。我的步枪是我最好的朋友。它是我的生命。我必须像掌控我的生命一样掌控它。没有我，我的步枪毫无用处。没有我的步枪，我毫无用处。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Hand Held Jury rigged Rotary AC2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具手持临时拼装的旋转AC2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Made to order by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the 'Avenger' is anything but shoddy. Built around a Mydron Rotary AC5 with specialized Shock Absorbers and 3 tons of caseless ammo storage, it howls Victory and Vengeance through the Arena. Has 120 Shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由瓦伊宁工程与打捞队定制打造，"复仇者"绝不是什么劣货。它围绕一门迈德隆旋转AC5建造，配以专用减震器和3吨无壳弹药储存，在竞技场里高呼着胜利与复仇。 < 有120发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ever felt your BOOM just is not enough? Look no further, Berrymore Munitions in cooperation with Kali Yama brings you the Biggest Stick you could wish for!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 总觉得你的"轰"还不够响？不用再找了，贝里莫尔弹药与卡利·亚马联手，为你献上你梦寐以求的最大棒锤！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Battle Rifle fires a single Highly Damaging Shot. 1 Recoil, +1 Accuracy, and 5% Jam Chance,
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗步枪发射单发高伤害射击。1后坐力，+1精度，5%卡壳几率，

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recovered from an SLDF research Facility. Seemingly similar to an AC10 in Caliber and Damage, this weapon was designed along the lines of advanced Infantry Assault Weapons with a Select Fire Switch. Firing Modes: Single Shot, Burst Fire, Full Auto.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从一处SLDF研究设施中回收。口径与伤害似乎与AC10相近，这件武器沿先进步兵突击武器的路线设计，带有一个射击选择开关。 < 射击模式：单发、点射、全自动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Bazooka' is typical Periphery Junk, Boss. This is barely more then a Anti-Armor Thunderbolt in a Tube with a Trigger. Looks just like a old Terran Missile Launcher too
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "巴祖卡"是典型的外缘破烂，老大。它不过是把一具反装甲雷霆塞进一根带扳机的管子里。看着还像一具古老的类地导弹发射器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leave it to some Periphery Junkhead to take a perfectly fine LBX and Redneck it into a 'Sawed Off Shotgun' and scribble stuff all over, where do they get this stuff... 'Klaatu barada nihikturhun'..... Internal Ammo 10 Shots
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只能交给某个外缘蠢货，把一具好好的LBX乡下改装成"截短霰弹枪"，还在上面到处乱涂，他们到底从哪儿弄来这些东西……'克拉图 巴拉达 尼赫克图尔'…… < 内部弹药 10发

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This rare Industrial Chainsaw is usually found on Superheavy Forster Mechs designed to cut down trees too large for any normal equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这条稀有的工业链锯通常出现在超重型福斯特机甲上，用于伐倒任何常规设备都处理不了的巨树。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Agricultural mechs use arm-mounted Chainsaws to fell trees and harvest timber. This particular model was rebuild to look more like a Sword and is even for Solaris a rare sight that Rip and Tears the competition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 农业机甲使用臂载链锯伐树采木。这一特定型号被改装得更像一把剑，即便在索拉里斯也属罕见之物，能把对手撕成碎片。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chain Whip was made to entangle enemy 'Mechs. Tested in the Word of Blake assault on Solaris, the first iteration used pure myomers and wasn't effective. The Blakists made it work by adding additional armor alloy chains to reinforce the myomers. This version of the Chain Whip worked well. Despite its limited damage, the Blakists found it useful for immobilizing enemy forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 锁链鞭是为缠住敌方机甲而造的。它在布雷克之言对索拉里斯的进攻中接受了测试，最初的版本使用纯肌纤维，效果不佳。布雷克派加入额外的装甲合金链来加固肌纤维，使它运作起来。这一版本的锁链鞭效果很好。尽管伤害有限，布雷克派发现它用于瘫痪敌军很有用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This appears to be a regular LBX AC/5, torn straight out of the housing of an unfortunate mech. Someone welded some ammo packs to it, hooked up a feed, and cut off the barrel to compensate for the weight. This was some angry engineering, boss. Internal Ammo 10 Shots
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来是一具普通的LBX AC/5，从一台倒霉机甲的壳子里直接扯出来的。有人在上面焊了些弹药包，接上供弹，并砍短炮管以补偿重量。这是充满怒火的工程，老大。 < 内部弹药 10发

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Combat Shotgun: Increased Punch Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗霰弹枪: 提高拳击伤害

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Combat Shotgun: Increased Punch Stability Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗霰弹枪: 提高拳击稳定性伤害

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BattleMech Flail is a physical attack weapon developed in the arenas of Solaris VII. Though more controllable than the Wrecking Ball that inspired it, the Flail is still tricky to use. MechWarriors have been known to inflict damage on their own 'Mechs from the swinging Flail head.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连枷是索拉里斯VII竞技场中发展出的肉搏攻击武器。虽然它比启发了它的破拆球更易控制，却依然难以掌握。已知有机甲战士被摆动的连枷头伤到自己的机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Heavy Flamer with a ton of Ammo in a 'Handy' package for all 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具重型火焰喷射器配一吨弹药，装在适合所有机甲的"顺手"套件里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Solaris Weapon, some psycho thought it was a good idea to make a mech fist which, when it sucker punches other mechs, will fire a flamer at pinpoint range! Its not very effective but the Liao guys talk about 'Burning Fist' move from an old antique game.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一件典型的 Solaris 武器：某个疯子觉得造一只机甲拳头是个好主意——当它偷袭其他机甲时，会在贴脸的距离上喷出火焰喷射器的火舌！它其实并不怎么有效，但 Liao 那帮人总爱提起某款老古董游戏里的“燃烧之拳”招式。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Heavy Flamer with a ton of Sticky Ammo in a 'Handy' package for all 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一门重型火焰喷射器，配一吨黏性弹药，"便捷"封装，适用于所有机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This mech is covered in burning napalm, which is keeping it hot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲被燃烧的凝固汽油覆盖，持续处于过热状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hand Held TriFlamer (Sticky): Decreased Target Cooling
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式三焰喷枪(粘性): 降低目标散热能力

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hand Held TriFlamer (Sticky): Increased Target Heat Generated
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式三焰喷枪(粘性): 增加目标的热量生成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Heavy Flamer with a ton of Sticky Ammo in a 'Handy' package for all 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一门重型火焰喷射器，配一吨黏性弹药，"便捷"封装，适用于所有机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This mech is covered in burning napalm, which is keeping it hot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲被燃烧的凝固汽油覆盖，持续处于过热状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hand Held Flamer (Sticky): Decreased Target Cooling
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式火焰喷射器(粘性): 降低目标散热能力

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hand Held Flamer (Sticky): Increased Target Heat Generated
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式火焰喷射器(粘性): 增加目标的热量生成
手持式火焰喷射器(粘性)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A SLDF Gauss Rifle made to be carried by a BattleMech. Employing a rather creative solution of a expandable energy pack per shot to power the Weapon directly, circumventing the need for a Fusion Engine and saving a bit of weight, at cost of a slow charge up time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款由SLDF(星际联盟防卫军)设计、供战斗机甲搭载的高斯步枪. 它采用了一种颇具创意的解决方案，每次射击使用一个可扩展的能量包直接为武器供电，从而绕过了对核聚变引擎的需求并节省了部分重量，代价是充能时间较长.
反人员磁轨炮组 发射1支步枪

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Handheld battery of 3 Anti-Personel Gauss Rifles. 40 Shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一组手持式3门反人员磁轨炮。 < 40发。
手持式反步兵高斯步枪(氏族)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built from several pieces of light Gauss Rifles and King David Rifles, this rifle is capable of penetrating armor exceptionally well, but suffers drastic damage loss at range.10 rounds.. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这把步枪由几件轻型磁轨炮与大卫王步枪的部件拼成，能异常出色地穿透装甲，但在远距离会急剧损失伤害。10发。。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BattleMech Taser uses a specially modified metal harpoon that sends a massive electrical pulse down a wire connected to the firing unit. This electrical pulse is designed to overload the target's electrical system and hopefully cause the target unit to shut down. This allows the Taser carrying unit to capture the target rather than destroying it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲电击枪使用一根特别改装的金属鱼叉，沿一条连接发射单位的导线传送巨大的电脉冲。这种电脉冲旨在使目标的电力系统过载，并有望让目标单位停机。这使携带电击枪的单位能够俘获目标而非摧毁它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mech's Systems have been scrambled.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲的系统已被干扰瘫痪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And the Lord spake, saying, 'First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin. Then, shalt thou count to three. No more. No less. Three shalt be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shall be three. Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then, lobbest thou thy Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch towards thy foe, who, being naughty in My sight, shall snuff it.'
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主说：“首先，你要取出圣销钉。然后你要数到三。不多。不少。你要数的数目是三，数的数目就是三。四你不能数，二你也不能数，除非你接着数到三。五就不行。一旦数到三这个数目，即第三个数，你就要把你的安条克圣手榴弹掷向你的敌人，他在我眼中行恶，必就此气绝。”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Construction and engineering 'Mechs use Arc Welders to join metal parts. In an emergency these high-temperature electric arcs can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons, Arc Welders suffer a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 建筑与工程机甲使用弧焊机连接金属部件。紧急情况下，这些高温电弧可在近战中对机甲使用。与所有工业武器一样，弧焊机带有少量固有的命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Buzzsaw is a circular saw used during construction and manufacturing by IndustrialMechs. It saw some limited use in Solaris arenas for an easy way to deal direct physical damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Buzzsaw 是一种圆盘锯，工业机甲在建筑与制造作业中会用到它。它在 Solaris 竞技场中也有有限的应用，作为一种直接造成物理伤害的简便手段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Agricultural 'Mechs use arm-mounted Chainsaws to fell trees and harvest timber. In an emergency these giant saws can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons, Chainsaws suffer a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 农业机甲使用手臂安装的链锯伐树和采伐木材。紧急情况下，这些巨型锯子也可用于机甲近战。与所有工业武器一样，链锯有轻微的固有命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Agricultural 'Mechs use rotary Cultivators to plow soil, breaking up rocks and tree stumps as they go. In an emergency, the rotating blades of these can be used for melee combat. Like all industrial weapons, the Cultivator suffers a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 农业机甲使用旋转耕耘机翻耕土壤，一路打碎石块与树桩。紧急情况下，这些旋转刀片可用于近战。与所有工业武器一样，耕耘机带有少量固有的命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common tool used for urban construction and industrial demolitions, the dual saw is a more powerful variation on the chainsaw that typically uses twin high-speed ferro-carbide circular blades or a scissoring set of oblong vibro-blades instead of a monoblade, chain-fed cutter. Designed with hard objects in mind, such as industrial steels and pavement, the dual saw—by its very design—happens to be fairly effective against armored units as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双锯是城市建筑与工业拆除中常用的工具，是链锯的更强力变体，通常采用双高速碳化铁圆锯片，或一副剪刀式的长方形振动刀片，而非单片链式刀具。它是为硬物（如工业钢材与路面）设计的，而正因这种设计，双锯对付装甲单位也相当有效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Dual Saw: Improved Physical Weapon Hit Chance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式双锯: 提高物理武器命中率

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Dual Saw: Increased Bonus Flat Physical Weapon Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式双锯: 提高物理武器固定伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Dual Saw: Increased Bonus Flat Physical Weapon Stability Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式双锯: 提高物理武器固定稳定性伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Dual Saw: Increased Physical Weapon Extra Hits
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式双锯: 物理武器增加额外攻击判定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Dual Saw: Is Physical Weapon
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式双锯: 是物理武器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Dual Saw: Use STANDARD Hit Table
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式双锯: 使用标准命中表

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hydraulic-assisted impact hammer scaled for IndustrialMech frames. Delivers measured, repeatable strike force suitable for foundation work, demolition, and deep rock fracturing. Built to run shift after shift without maintenance windows.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一种按工业机甲骨架比例设计、带液压助力的冲击锤。可输出精确可控、可重复的打击力，适用于地基施工、拆除作业以及深层岩石破碎。其设计可承受连续轮班作业，无需安排维护间歇。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mining and construction 'Mechs use Jackhammers to break apart rock or concrete. In an emergency, these powered hammers can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons the Jackhammer suffers a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 采矿与建筑机甲使用风镐击碎岩石或混凝土。紧急情况下，这些动力锤可在近战中对机甲使用。与所有工业武器一样，风镐带有少量固有的命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Construction and engineering 'Mechs use Laser Cutter to take junk apart. In an emergency these pinpoint beams can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons, Laser Cutters suffer a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 建筑与工程机甲用激光切割器拆解废料。紧急情况下，这些精准光束可在近战中对机甲使用。与所有工业武器一样，激光切割器带有少量固有的命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mining 'Mechs use arm-mounted Drills to excavate tunnels and extract ore. In an emergency, these heavy-duty drills can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons the Mining Drill suffers a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 采矿机甲使用安装在手臂上的钻头挖掘隧道、开采矿石。紧急情况下，这些重型钻头也能用来近战攻击机甲。与所有工业武器一样，采矿钻头在命中判定上带有轻微的固有惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Construction and engineering 'Mechs use Plasma Torches to cut and weld metal. In an emergency these high-temperature jets can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons, Plasma Cutters suffer a small inherent penalty to hit. Not affected by PPC Capacitors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 建筑与工程机甲使用等离子炬切割和焊接金属。紧急情况下，这些高温射流可在近战中对机甲使用。与所有工业武器一样，等离子切割机带有少量固有的命中惩罚。不受PPC电容器影响。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Sprayer is simply a hose and pump system that sprays liquids at a target. Only useable on IndustrialMechs, it has limited useage in combat beyond being a very short range crowd control system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 喷洒器不过是一套软管加泵送系统，用于向目标喷射液体。它只能安装在工业机甲上，在战斗中用途有限，仅能充当超近距离的人群控制手段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech sized Hydraulic Hammer, was this version, in best of Solaris' fashion, molded like a large Fist. Someone painted a large HAMMERTIME! graffiti on this model
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台机甲尺寸的液压锤——按索拉里斯的风格，此版本被塑成一只巨大的拳头。有人在这个型号上涂了巨大的“大锤时间！”涂鸦

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hammerfist: Increased Punch Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式锤击拳: 提高拳击伤害

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hammerfist: Increased Punch Extra Hits
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式锤击拳: 拳击增加额外攻击判定

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held Hammerfist: Increased Punch Stability Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式锤击拳: 提高拳击稳定性伤害

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BattleMech Lance is a special melee weapon designed to pierce armor plating. Unlike the medieval weapon of the same name, the Lance is a long, thin spike that juts out from a 'Mech's arm; it is not a large spear-like weapon carried in the hand. In combat the Lance pierces the armor plating of an enemy unit, possibly damaging or destroying internal systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲长矛是一种专为刺穿装甲板而设计的特殊近战武器。与中世纪的同名武器不同，它是一根从机甲臂部伸出的细长尖刺，而非手持的大矛。战斗中，长矛刺穿敌方单位的装甲板，可能损伤或摧毁内部系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This clan-made masterpiece of a Laser Rifle debuted on Solaris VII. Combining Clan advances to laser technology with an SLDF Laser Rifle, this weapon is able to outmatch many opponents in the arena as well as the battlefield. 12 rounds. Alternative firing modes allows either a stronger shot or extreme range, with increased ammo consumption.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这把氏族制造的激光步枪杰作在索拉里斯VII首次亮相。它把氏族的激光技术进步与一具SLDF激光步枪结合，使这件武器在竞技场和战场上都能胜过许多对手。 < 12发。 < 替代射击模式可发射更强的一击或获得极远射程，但消耗更多弹药。
手持化学激光步枪(氏族)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan grade Chemical Laser Rifle! Similar to the old SLDF designs but they linked 2 Chemical Medium laser together. 20 rounds. Alternative firing mode allows a stronger shot with double ammo consumption
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具氏族级化学激光步枪！与旧SLDF设计相似，但他们把2门化学中型激光器连在了一起。 < 20发。 < 替代射击模式可发射更强的一击，但消耗双倍弹药

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Word of Blake for the Waneta Spectral LAM, this Clan-Grade ER Large Laser was fitted with unique and somewhat dangerous cooling equipment. Despite these innovations necessitating a reduced power output, it is still a formidable weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是布雷克之言为瓦内塔幽灵LAM制造的氏族级增程大型激光器，装有独特且略显危险的冷却设备。尽管这些创新导致输出功率降低，它仍是一种强大的武器。
手持大型增程激光步枪(氏族)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Laser Pistol? Ive only read about these in old tech manuals. You See how they Wired a Chemical Laser to be fired just like your typical SideArm? This is Genius! 30 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一把激光手枪？我只在旧技术手册里读到过。你看他们怎么把化学激光器接到能像普通随身武器那样开火？这简直是天才！ < 30发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is an Amazing Relic, a Large Laser Rifle! Just look at this boss, designed to be carried by Mech's into Combat without requiring to rewire anything. These SLDF BlackHeart guys have been crafty! 16 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件惊人的遗物：一具大型激光步枪！看看这个，老大，它专为机甲携带入战而设计，无需重新布线任何东西。这些SLDF黑心家伙可真够聪明的！ < 16发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amazing, at first this looks like junk, but if you look closer, it's an old SLDF Wasp Laser Rifle Prototype; I've got no idea where they dug this thing up or even made it work at all! 20 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太惊人了，乍看像是废品，但仔细看，这是一具旧的SLDF黄蜂激光步枪原型；我完全不知道他们从哪儿挖出这东西，甚至不知道他们怎么让它还能用的！ < 20发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Laser Drill used to drill into a planets surface by superheating and bombarding the crust, was adapted to work as a 'Mech weapon, able to cut deep into a Chassis and tear it apart it apart.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种用于钻入行星地表的激光钻，通过过热并轰击地壳来工作，后来被改造成机甲武器，能深深切入底盘并将其撕裂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Weapon Fires an accurate 5 Shot Salvo
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 武器发射一轮精准的5发齐射

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Handheld package combines 2 Clan LRM5 Launchers able to fire a salvo accurately or in Tandem Salvo with a higher chance to cluster. 60 Rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个手持套件把2具氏族LRM5发射器结合在一起，能精准地发射一轮齐射，或以更高的集束几率进行串联齐射。 < 60发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HotLoaded LRM have no Minimum Range, -1 Accuracy, 15% Jam Chance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 热装填LRM无最小射程，-1 精度，15% 卡壳概率.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Long Range Missiles were developed by the Federated Commonwealth in response to the superior performance of Clan weaponry. These new LRMs use a more sophisticated arming mechanism to increase their viability at close range. The result has been a much smaller blind spot compared to traditional LRMs while still retaining the same long-range functionality. This is packaged with half a ton of ammo in an unarmored handheld package, intended for firing and ejecting before getting into brawling range. 60 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增强型远程导弹由联邦共同体研发，以应对氏族武器更优越的性能。这些新型LRM采用更精密的解锁机制，以提升其在近距离的可用性。结果是相比传统LRM小得多的盲区，同时保留相同的远程功能。它以半吨弹药的形式封装在一个无装甲的手持套件中，意在进入肉搏距离之前发射并抛弃。 < 60发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A single Streak LRM5 Launcher System. 60 Rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 单具连发LRM5发射器系统。 60发。
MML 发射 LRM（远程导弹）
MML 发射 SRM（近程导弹）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A HandHeld MML3 Launcher System. Internal Ammo: LRM:30. SRM:30. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套手持式MML3发射器系统。 < 内部弹药：LRM:30。SRM:30。 < 战斗中左键点击命中率可在LRM与SRM之间切换。
MML 发射 LRM（远程导弹）
MML 发射 SRM（近程导弹）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A HandHeld MML5 Launcher System. Internal Ammo: LRM:50. SRM:50. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持MML5发射器系统。 内置弹药：LRM：50。SRM：50。 战斗中左键点击命中率可在LRM与SRM之间切换。
MML 发射 LRM（远程导弹）
MML 发射 SRM（近程导弹）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A HandHeld MML7 Launcher System. Internal Ammo: LRM:70. SRM:70. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套手持式MML7发射器系统。 < 内部弹药：LRM:70。SRM:70。 < 战斗中左键点击命中率可在LRM与SRM之间切换。
MML 发射 LRM（远程导弹）
MML 发射 SRM（近程导弹）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A HandHeld MML9 Launcher System. Internal Ammo: LRM:90. SRM:90. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套手持式MML9发射器系统。 < 内部弹药：LRM:90。SRM:90。 < 战斗中左键点击命中率可在LRM与SRM之间切换。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And Saint Attila raised the hand grenade up on high, saying, 'O Lord, bless this Thy hand grenade that, with it, Thou mayest blow Thine enemies to tiny bits in Thy mercy.' And the Lord did grin, and the people did feast upon the lambs and sloths and carp and anchovies and orangutans and breakfast cereals and fruit bats and large chunks......
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 圣阿提拉高举着手榴弹说：'主啊，请赐福这枚手榴弹，好让你以慈悲把敌人炸成碎片。'主笑了，人们便享用羔羊、树懒、鲤鱼、凤尾鱼、猩猩、早餐麦片、果蝠和大块……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medium-Range Missile Launcher was designed by scientists at Luthien Armor Works. MRMs are dead-fire missiles that are fired more like lasers than missiles. In order to pack as many missiles as possible into one salvo, scientists removed guidance systems and made the whole package smaller. Though this was seen as a step backwards in technological development, the inexpensive and deadly MRMs have spread throughout the Draconis Combine and to many mercenary units. 100 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中程导弹发射器由卢西恩装甲厂的科学家设计。MRM是一种无制导导弹，发射方式更像激光而非导弹。为了把尽可能多的导弹塞进一轮齐射，科学家们拆掉了制导系统，让整个组件更小。虽然这被视为技术发展上的一次倒退，但廉价而致命的MRM已遍布龙尼斯联合体和许多雇佣兵部队。 < 100发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yeah, Boss I don't know where you got this from, but this ain't periphery Junk, this Rifle was Purpose Built with the best Technologies available. 10 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是啊老大，我不知道你这是从哪儿弄来的，但这可不是外缘的破烂货，这支步枪是用现有最好的技术专门打造的。 < 10发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Construction and engineering mechs use Plasma Torches to cut and weld metal. This Specific Torch was actually redesigned for Military use to act like an energy Lance. Not affected by PPC Cap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 建筑与工程机甲用等离子炬切割和焊接金属。这一特定型号的等离子炬实际上为军用重新设计，用作能量长矛。不受PPC上限影响。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Disabled FI removes Minimum Range but has a 25% Chance to Permajam. Mitigated by Jam Reduction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 禁用FI可移除最小射程，但有 25% 概率永久卡壳，受卡壳减免影响.
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Light PPC is a lighter version of the Particle Projector Cannon. Researched by the Draconis Combine, it does less damage and comes in at less than half the weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型PPC是粒子加农炮的轻量化版本. 由天龙联合体研发，其伤害较低，重量不到原版的一半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held HandHeld Light PPC: Anti Air Factor
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式轻型PPC: 防空系数

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hand Held HandHeld Light PPC: Increased Target ECM Jamming
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 手持式轻型PPC: 增加目标的ECM干扰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medium Rifle is the middleweight of the 'Rifle' family. The precursor to the modern Autocannon, the Rifle was based on the main guns used by tanks on pre-spaceflight Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中型步枪是"步枪"家族中的中量级选手。作为现代自动炮的前身，步枪基于前太空时代地球上坦克使用的主炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a nightmare. It's actually just the guts of a rocket technical with some 'Mech-sized handles welded on. Please don't ask me to reload it for you.1 SHOT! VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一场噩梦。它实际上只是一台火箭皮卡的内部结构，焊上了几个机甲尺寸的把手。请别叫我帮你给它装弹。单发！ 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A single Streak SRM4 Launcher System. 52 Rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 单具连发SRM4发射器系统。 52发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a handheld Streak SRM-6 launcher protected by one ton of armour. 90 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一个手持式连发SRM-6发射器，由一吨装甲保护。 < 90发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Super Shotgun' is pretty much a LBX20 in a HandHeld device for BattleMech's, it Rips, Tears and Slays anything the loud end gets pointed at. Internal Ammo 8 Shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这把"超级霰弹枪"基本上就是把一具LBX20装进供战斗机甲使用的手持装置里，它会把枪口指向的任何东西撕碎、扯烂、斩杀。 < 内部弹药 8发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shares Sensor Information on nearby Targets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 共享附近目标的传感器信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target is marked for guided munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已被标记用于制导弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Handheld Clan grade TAG system has received additional sensor and systems, allowing it to paint a target more efficiently at Extreme Ranges. Its Unique Effect grants a massive but decaying Stacked Detection Bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套手持式氏族级TAG系统接受了额外的传感器与系统，使其能在极远距离上更高效地标定目标。其独特效果提供巨量但会衰减的叠加探测加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This target was TAG'ed. +1 to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标已被 TAG 标记。命中 +1。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Visual indicator of the TAG effect
The Heavy Streak Weapon fires a single streak srm-4 launcher
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型连发武器发射单具连发SRM-4发射器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a handheld trio of Streak SRM-4 launchers protected by two tons of armour. 90 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一个手持式三联连发SRM-4发射器，由两吨装甲保护。 < 90发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basically this is a Vehicle Mortar, Boss. Some Junker wired it up to be Held by a Battlemech and to fire home made 'Grenades'. 10 Shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基本上这是一门车辆迫击炮，老大。某个废品商用线把它接到机甲手持，并发射自制"手榴弹"。 < 10发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wrecking Ball is a piece of construction equipment that is rarely seen on the battlefield. Though it has been used by the arena fighters on Solaris, the lack of range and interference with other equipment mean it's not popular with the regular armies of the Inner Sphere. Instead the Wrecking Ball is usually found on IndustrialMechs and support vehicles that are used for demolition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破坏球是一种工程设备，在战场上极为罕见。虽然索拉里斯的竞技场斗士曾使用过它，但射程不足且会干扰其他装备，使它在内层星域的常规军队中并不受欢迎。破坏球通常出现在用于拆迁的工业机甲和支援车辆上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wrecking Ball is a piece of construction equipment that is rarely seen on the battlefield. This was in typical Pirate fashion adorned with Large Metal Spikes to seem even more threatening and deadly, but used a smaller and lighter ball.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破坏球是一种建筑施工设备，在战场上极少见. 这款破坏球采用了典型的海盗风格装饰，装配了大型金属尖刺，使其看起来更加具有威胁性和致命性，但实际使用的是更小、更轻的球体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Actuator Enhancement System (AES) is a combination of finely tuned myomer bundles and an enhanced DI computer interface that can improve the workings of a BattleMech's limbs. In many ways similar to the acuity enhancing servos and mechanisms tied into enhanced targeting computers, AES components serve to stabilize subtle variances in gross 'Mech movements, which can lead to greater weapon precision or improved balance adjustments. However, the systems are heavy and bulky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驱动器增强系统（AES）是精密调校的人造肌束与增强型 DI 计算机接口的结合，能改善战斗机甲肢体的运作。它在许多方面类似与增强型瞄准计算机相连的灵敏度增益伺服与机构：AES 组件用于稳定机甲整体动作中的细微偏差，从而带来更高的武器精度或更好的平衡调整。然而这些系统又重又笨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Armor carries an Integrated Laser Anti Missile System, pocketing the mech with many smaller Pulse Lasers to grant improved interception.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种装甲集成了一套激光反导系统，在机甲上密布许多较小的脉冲激光以提升拦截能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Attempt to create advanced Recon Units has Shengli Arm's incorporated their latest advanced of Stealth tech into a LAM Aluminum Armor. Reserves 1 slot in every Location except the Head and requires an ECM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为打造先进侦察单位的一次尝试，胜利武器公司把他们最新的先进隐形技术融入了LAM铝制装甲。除头部外每个部位占用1个槽位，需要一套ECM。
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Capellan Confederation, Stealth Armor is a modern day equivalent of the Star League era Null Signature System. Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由卡佩拉联邦研发的潜行装甲，是星际联盟时代零特征系统的现代同级装备. 预留 6 个槽位，并需要一套ECM系统.
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seeing the Stealth Armor made by the Capellan Confederation on the invasions, the Society took into researching and equipping it with clan technology. Used mostly on experimental low cost stealth units. Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看到卡佩兰联邦在入侵中使用的隐形装甲后，协会着手研究并以氏族技术装备它。主要用于实验性的低成本隐形单位。占用6个槽位，需要一套ECM。已启用CASE
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Capellan Confederation, Superheavy Stealth Armor is an attempt to give stealth capabilities to the massive 'Mechs. Reserves 12 slots and requires an ECM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超重型隐身装甲由卡佩兰联邦研制，是想为巨型机甲赋予隐身能力的尝试。占用 12 个槽位，并需要一套 ECM。
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Capellan Confederation, Superheavy Stealth Armor is an attempt to give stealth capabilities to the massive 'Mechs. Reserves 12 slots and requires an ECM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超重型隐身装甲由卡佩兰联邦研制，是想为巨型机甲赋予隐身能力的尝试。占用 12 个槽位，并需要一套 ECM。
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon Light Polarization Shield was designed to make a 'Mech invisible to the naked eye. By using a primitive mimetic system, the outline of the 'Mech carrying it was broken up, blending into the surrounding terrain and making it harder to hit. The effect would be lost if the 'Mech had to move fast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙光偏振护盾的设计目的是让机甲在肉眼下隐形。它利用一套原始拟态系统打散搭载机甲的轮廓，使其融入周围地形、更难被击中。若机甲必须高速移动，该效果便会失效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon Light Polarization Shield was designed to make a 'Mech invisible to the naked eye. By using a primitive mimetic system, the outline of the 'Mech carrying it was broken up, blending into the surrounding terrain making it harder to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙光极化护盾旨在让机甲对肉眼不可见。通过使用一种原始拟态系统，携带它的机甲轮廓被打散，融入周围地形，使其更难被命中。
超重型变色龙偏振护盾
超重型变色龙偏振护盾

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical deep Periphery derivative of Impact Resistant Armor with a Lyran Solaris influence, the Spike Cladding bolts interlocking impact resistant plating and spikes across the whole Mech, giving it an edge during the grittiest of infighting at the cost of some mobility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是抗冲击装甲在深空外围星域的典型衍生产物，融合了天琴索拉里斯的影响. 尖刺覆层将互锁的抗冲击装甲板和尖刺螺栓固定于整台机甲之上，以牺牲部分机动性为代价，在最惨烈的近身恶斗中赋予其优势.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A NAIS black-program evolution of the Null Signature System and Stealth Armor, the Mistwalker Veil integrates a new generation of sensor-absorbent composite plating bonded directly to the mech's armor. Advanced ECM baffling woven into the armor matrix suppresses heat and electromagnetic emissions more effectively than any previous production stealth system, functioning in conjunction with any compatible ECM suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为NAIS秘密项目在虚无信号系统与隐形装甲基础上的进化产物，Mistwalker Veil将新一代吸波复合装甲板直接结合到机甲的装甲上。编织进装甲基体的先进电子对抗抑制结构，能比以往任何量产隐形系统更有效地压制热能与电磁辐射，并可与任何兼容的电子对抗套件协同运作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2630, the Null Signature System employs heat baffles and a phased-array sensor suite to mask a mech's thermal and electromagnetic output.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 零信号系统由地球霸权于2630年研发，采用热障与相控阵传感器套件，遮蔽机甲的热信号与电磁输出。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Society under wraps to research into upgrading the SLDF era NSS with top clan era technology. Reserves 5 slots and requires an ECM. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由协会秘密研发，旨在用顶级氏族时代技术升级SLDF时代的NSS。占用5个槽位，需要一套ECM。已启用CASE

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hard hits can break pieces off the inside of armor, without piercing it, turning them into shrapnel. This reinforced lining material slows or catches this spall before it can cause damage. Reserves 2 slots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强力冲击可能会在不击穿装甲的情况下，使装甲内部碎片脱落并形成破片. 这种加固衬层材料能在这些破片造成伤害之前减缓或捕获它们. 预留 2 槽位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Void Signature System is a hybrid evolution of Star League era systems such as the Chameleon Light Polarization Shield and the Null Signature System. Essentially a scaled up version of the Battle Suits Mimetic Armor, the Void Signature System shields a BattleMech's presence from both visual and electronic detection with help from a paired ECM suite.  Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虚空信号系统是星际联盟时代多种系统（比如变色龙光偏振护盾和无效信号系统）的混合演进产物。它本质上就是战斗装甲所用拟态装甲的放大版，在配对 ECM 套件的协助下，将战斗机甲的存在从视觉和电子探测中隐藏起来。占用 6 个槽位，并需要一具 ECM。
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Essentially a scaled up version of the Battle Suits Mimetic Armor, the Void Signature System shields a BattleMech's presence from both visual and electronic detection with help from a paired ECM suite.  Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Developed under RISC's classified Phantom Initiative, the Wraith Suppression Shield System, or W3S, advances Star League mimetic principles through an active phased-array optical disruption field. Adaptive polarization cells across the mech's surface continuously sample and reproject surrounding terrain, blurring visual resolution at a considerably higher level than previous iterations such as CLPS.

By the time anyone noticed that even the abbreviated name was a bit of a mouthful, it was too late to redesignate the project. Most Mechwarriors just call it 'God Mode.'
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
幽灵压制护盾系统（W3S）在RISC机密“幽灵计划”下研制，通过主动相控阵光学干扰场推进了星际联盟的拟态原理。遍布机甲表面的自适应偏振单元持续采样并重新投射周围地形，其视觉分辨率模糊程度远高于CLPS等先前方案。

等到有人意识到就连这个缩写都拗口得离谱时，项目早已来不及改名。大多数机甲战士干脆叫它“上帝模式”。

Super-cooled myomer (SCM) is a RISC experimental modification to BattleMechs to improve their cooling. Interlacing myomers with special friction-reducing fluids and secondary coolant lines, and sheathing key bundles in an extra layer of thermal insulation, the new musculature all but eliminated waste heat caused by routine movement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 【Super-Cooled Myomer】超级冷却肌纤维（SCM）是RISC对战斗机甲进行的一种实验性改装，旨在改善其散热性能. 通过将肌纤维与特殊的减摩液和次级冷却管路交织在一起，并为关键纤维束包裹一层额外的隔热层，这种新型肌肉组织几乎消除了日常运动所产生的废热.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based upon Comstar's groundbreaking XL gyro has Vining Engineering and Salvage Team managed to push the technology even further, further reducing the weight of the mechs gyro, but doubling its size going even into the side Torsos.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在康星开创性的 XL 陀螺仪基础上，维宁工程与打捞队把这项技术推进得更远，进一步减轻了机甲陀螺仪的重量，但把体积翻倍，甚至延伸进两侧躯干。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based upon Comstar's groundbreaking XL gyro has Vining Engineering and Salvage Team managed to push the technology even further, further reducing the weight of the mechs gyro, but doubling its size going even into the side Torsos.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在康星开创性的 XL 陀螺仪基础上，维宁工程与打捞队把这项技术推进得更远，进一步减轻了机甲陀螺仪的重量，但把体积翻倍，甚至延伸进两侧躯干。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Draconis Combine as an 'honorable' alternative to the 'crude' Lyran Hatchet, the Sword inflicts almost as much damage as a Hatchet and offers a better hit probability due to its exceptional balance. This Sword prototype is affixed permanently to the 'Mech’s arm. It may be damage and disabled, but it can be repaired.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由龙尼斯联合体研发，作为"粗俗"莱兰斧头的"体面"替代，这把剑造成的伤害几乎与斧头相当，并因其出色的平衡性拥有更好的命中概率。这把剑的原型被永久固定在机甲手臂上。它可能受损失效，但可以修复。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: BattleMech Mechanical Jump Boosters are intended to provide a simple, heat free jumping ability. Unlike Jump Jets, these Mechanical Jump Boosters are essentially giant hydraulic rams and myomer bundles that act as giant springs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲机械跳跃助推器旨在提供简单、无热量的跳跃能力。与跳跃推进器不同，这些机械跳跃助推器本质上是巨型液压柱和人造肌束，如同巨型弹簧。
