Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: BattleMech Mechanical Jump Boosters are intended to provide a simple, heat free jumping ability. Unlike Jump Jets, these Mechanical Jump Boosters are essentially giant hydraulic rams and myomer bundles that act as giant springs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲机械跳跃助推器旨在提供简单、无热量的跳跃能力。与跳跃推进器不同，这些机械跳跃助推器本质上是巨型液压柱和人造肌束，如同巨型弹簧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DFA attacks deal 10% less damage to the attacker.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "从天而降"攻击对攻击者造成的伤害减少 10%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Increases damage dealt after jumping by 20% and boosts the distance this unit can travel when jumping by 20%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跳跃后造成的伤害提升 20%，跳跃距离提升 20%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Max Jump Jet Amount per Walk MP
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每点行走 MP 的最大跳跃推进器数量

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Jump Jets Heat Generation per Hex
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跳跃推进器每格的产热量

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Environmental sealing adds airtight, hermetic protection to units that otherwise can't operate in vacuum, toxins, or underwater. The retrofit increases chassis mass and cost, fitting cabins and critical compartments with tight seals, air tanks, filters, and scrubbers. This keeps crews safe and mechanisms moving, but doesn't guarantee air-breathing engines will run submerged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 环境密封为原本无法在真空、毒素或水下作业的单位增加气密防护。这项改装会增加底盘的质量和成本，需要为座舱和关键舱室配备严密的密封、储气罐、过滤器和洗涤装置。这能保证乘员安全、机械正常运转，但无法保证需要吸入空气的引擎在水下也能工作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A further development of the Sanctus armor, the Exsecratio has supposedly been bathed in the blood of enemies of the Word giving the 'Mech the power to hide from foes. However, it is more realistic to think that the armor uses some kind of advanced Stealth technology, and the rest is just one of the Word of Blake typical rituals to instill more zeal into its members.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为圣殿装甲的进一步发展，“诅咒”据称被浸泡在布莱克之词敌人的血液中，使机甲获得躲避敌人的力量。不过更现实的说法是，这种装甲使用了某种先进隐形技术，其余不过是布莱克之词为向成员灌输更多狂热而进行的典型仪式之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor merged with a Void signature system creating a new special armor, that not only stealths the mech, but also protects it with the properties of the ferro-fibrous armor. Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族铁纤装甲与虚空信号系统融合，创造出一种新的特殊装甲，不仅能让机甲隐形，还能以铁纤装甲的特性保护它。占用6个槽位，需要一套ECM。已启用CASE
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A specially strengthened Ferro-Fibrous based armor, blessed in the name of Kerensky. The actual technology behind it is largely unknown and kept very secret by the Word.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一种经特殊强化的铁纤维装甲，以克伦斯基之名祝福。它背后的实际技术很大程度上不为人知，并被布莱克之词严格保密。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A NAIS black-program evolution of the Null Signature System and Stealth Armor, the Mistwalker Veil integrates a new generation of sensor-absorbent composite plating bonded directly to the mech's armor. Advanced ECM baffling woven into the armor matrix suppresses heat and electromagnetic emissions more effectively than any previous production stealth system, functioning in conjunction with any compatible ECM suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为NAIS秘密项目在虚无信号系统与隐形装甲基础上的进化产物，Mistwalker Veil将新一代吸波复合装甲板直接结合到机甲的装甲上。编织进装甲基体的先进电子对抗抑制结构，能比以往任何量产隐形系统更有效地压制热能与电磁辐射，并可与任何兼容的电子对抗套件协同运作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Void Signature System is a hybrid evolution of Star League era systems such as the Chameleon Light Polarization Shield and the Null Signature System. Essentially a scaled up version of the Battle Suits Mimetic Armor, the Void Signature System shields a BattleMech's presence from both visual and electronic detection with help from a paired ECM suite.  Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虚空信号系统是星际联盟时代多种系统（比如变色龙光偏振护盾和无效信号系统）的混合演进产物。它本质上就是战斗装甲所用拟态装甲的放大版，在配对 ECM 套件的协助下，将战斗机甲的存在从视觉和电子探测中隐藏起来。占用 6 个槽位，并需要一具 ECM。
隐身装甲需要一台 ECM！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Developed under RISC's classified Phantom Initiative, the Wraith Suppression Shield System, or W3S, advances Star League mimetic principles through an active phased-array optical disruption field. Adaptive polarization cells across the mech's surface continuously sample and reproject surrounding terrain, blurring visual resolution at a considerably higher level than previous iterations such as CLPS.

By the time anyone noticed that even the abbreviated name was a bit of a mouthful, it was too late to redesignate the project. Most Mechwarriors just call it 'God Mode.'
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
幽灵压制护盾系统（W3S）在RISC机密“幽灵计划”下研制，通过主动相控阵光学干扰场推进了星际联盟的拟态原理。遍布机甲表面的自适应偏振单元持续采样并重新投射周围地形，其视觉分辨率模糊程度远高于CLPS等先前方案。

等到有人意识到就连这个缩写都拗口得离谱时，项目早已来不及改名。大多数机甲战士干脆叫它“上帝模式”。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unique Armor has an Integrated LAMS Prototype, capable of defending its owner and allies from the majority of Missile Attacks made during Battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种独特的装甲内置集成式 LAMS 原型，能在战斗中为自身和友军挡下大部分导弹攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Prototype Rotary AC10 has advanced stabilizer and increased range but requires more space. Once this weapon was built, the engineers looked at the creation, and proclaimed it needed wings. Uses RAC10 Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种原型旋转 AC10 拥有先进的稳定器，射程也有所提升，但占用空间更大。这件武器造好后，工程师们端详着成品，声称它还需要一对翅膀。 使用 RAC10 弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Prototype Rotary AC10 has advanced stabilizer and increased range but requires more space. Once this weapon was built, the engineers looked at the creation, and proclaimed it needed wings. Uses RAC10 Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种原型旋转 AC10 拥有先进的稳定器，射程也有所提升，但占用空间更大。这件武器造好后，工程师们端详着成品，声称它还需要一对翅膀。 使用 RAC10 弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a collection of patchwork materials (e.g. ferro-fibrous armour, endo steel structure, or ultralight composites) which provide the same degree of protection at a lighter weight, but at the cost of critical slots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一套拼装材料(例如铁纤维装甲、钢内骨结构或超轻型复合材料)，能以更轻的重量提供同等程度的防护，但代价是占用关键槽位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a collection of patchwork materials (e.g. ferro-fibrous armour, endo steel structure, or ultralight composites) which provide the same degree of protection at a lighter weight, but at the cost of critical slots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一套拼装材料(例如铁纤维装甲、钢内骨结构或超轻型复合材料)，能以更轻的重量提供同等程度的防护，但代价是占用关键槽位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Cooling Jacket' is barely more than a Heat Exchanger wired around the arm actuators, I must say, I'm actually impressed at this ...if it doesn't blow up that is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个“冷却夹套”不过就是个缠在手臂驱动器上的换热器罢了。不得不说，我其实还挺佩服的……前提是它别炸了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This appears to be a bog standard Bulldozer Blade that some yokel decided to heavily reinforce. Looks like they even added some targeting lasers and scanners to it so they could line up their charges better without the blade interfering with their sighting. Use at your own risk, Boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来是一块普通的推土铲，某个乡巴佬决定把它大幅加固。看样子他们还加装了一些瞄准激光和扫描仪，好让推土铲不再妨碍瞄准、能更准确地冲撞目标。自担风险使用，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This appears to be a bog standard Bulldozer Blade that some yokel decided to heavily reinforce. Looks like they even added some targeting lasers and scanners to it so they could line up their charges better without the blade interfering with their sighting. Use at your own risk, Boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来是一块普通的推土铲，某个乡巴佬决定把它大幅加固。看样子他们还加装了一些瞄准激光和扫描仪，好让推土铲不再妨碍瞄准、能更准确地冲撞目标。自担风险使用，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This appears to be a bog standard Bulldozer Blade that some yokel decided to heavily reinforce. Looks like they even added some targeting lasers and scanners to it so they could line up their charges better without the blade interfering with their sighting. Use at your own risk, Boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来是一块普通的推土铲，某个乡巴佬决定把它大幅加固。看样子他们还加装了一些瞄准激光和扫描仪，好让推土铲不再妨碍瞄准、能更准确地冲撞目标。自担风险使用，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While Functionally similar to Standard BattleMech Armor, Heavy Industrial Armor has special reinforcements to securely enhance a 'Mech with Triple Strength Myomer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然在功能上类似标准战斗机甲装甲，重型工业装甲带有特殊加固，能稳固地以三倍强度肌纤维强化机甲。
工业级三倍强度人造肌

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Industrial armor is slightly worse than Standard armor and is only used for IndustrialMechs that generally don't expect to see combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业装甲略逊于标准装甲，只用于通常不预期参战的工业机甲。
工业级三倍强度人造肌

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Age of War, Primitive Armor was introduced on the Mackie, the original BattleMech. This armor was less capable than the armor used in Star League and Succession War designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始装甲开发于战争时代，并首次应用于最初的战斗机甲‘麦基’上. 这种装甲的性能低于星盟和继承战争时期设计所用的装甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Standard BattleMech armor is composed of several layers providing various degrees of protection and support. The first layer is extremely strong titanium alloyed with steel, the result of crystal alignment and radiation treatment, which is also very brittle. The second layer is a ceramic, cubic boron nitride, which combined with a web of artificial diamond fibers acts as a backstop to the steel layer. These two layers rest atop a titanium alloy honeycomb structure which provides support, and a layer of self-sealing polymer sealant which allows for space and underwater operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 标准战斗机甲装甲由多层结构组成，提供不同程度的保护和支撑. 第一层是极其坚固的钛钢合金，经过晶体取向和辐射处理，但同时也非常脆. 第二层是陶瓷立方氮化硼，与人造金刚石纤维网结合，作为钢层的背衬. 这两层置于钛合金蜂窝结构之上，该结构提供支撑，并覆盖一层自密封聚合物密封剂，以实现太空和水下作战能力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While otherwise identical to standard BattleMech Armor, Clan Armor incorporates C.A.S.E. technology. CASE Enabled
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 除集成 C.A.S.E. 技术外，氏族装甲在其他方面与标准战斗机甲装甲完全相同。CASE 已启用

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Industrial Cockpit is functionally similar to the modern BattleMech cockpit, but due to the bulkier components, it weighs five tons instead of three.  It lacks an ejection seat and the sensors are even worse than that of a standard IndustrialMech's
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业座舱在功能上与现代战斗机甲座舱相似，但由于部件更笨重，重量为五吨而非三吨。它没有弹射座椅，传感器甚至比标准工业机甲的还要差。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Industrial Cockpit is functionally similar to the modern BattleMech cockpit, but due to the bulkier components, it weighs five tons instead of three. This advanced version includes an ejection seat and slightly better systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业驾驶舱在功能上类似于现代战斗机甲驾驶舱，但由于采用了更笨重的组件，其重量达到5吨，而非3吨. 这个高级版本配备了弹射座椅，并拥有略微改进的系统.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primitive Cockpit is functionally similar to the modern BattleMech cockpit, but due to the bulkier components, it weighs five tons instead of three.  It lacks an ejection seat and the sensors are even worse than that of a standard IndustrialMech's
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始座舱在功能上与现代战斗机甲座舱相似，但由于部件更笨重，重量为五吨而非三吨。它没有弹射座椅，传感器甚至比标准工业机甲的还要差。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A StarLeague Defense Forces Standard Spec cockpit, complete with ballistic armored cooling suit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟防卫军(SLDF)标准规格驾驶舱，配备防弹冷却服
星盟防卫军标准驾驶舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the Armored Cowl design, Solaris Arm's upgrades this cockpit with a hardened cage and an IFF Jammer; enabling it to take heavier hits with ease.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款驾驶舱以装甲罩设计为基础，Solaris Arm为其加装了强化笼架与敌我识别干扰器，使其能够轻松承受更重的打击。
防止机甲战士受到 [AMT] 点伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reduces effectiveness of stealthed and ECM shielded units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降低隐身与 ECM 护盾单位的效能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris Arms Hardened Cage Cockpit Mod
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯兵工厂 Hardened Cage Cockpit Mod

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock Cockpit and Life Support, which can be upgraded for improved performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱与生命维持系统，可通过升级提升性能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fuel Cell engines are primarily used in civilian applications like rail systems, personal transport, and IndustrialMechs. Fuel Cell engines generate electrical power that is then used by the vehicle to operate its propulsion system. A Fuel Cell engine has several advantages over the typical Internal Combustion Engine. While they require an oxidizer to operate, they are readily able to accept a stored oxidizer along with their fuel, making it a good choice for submarines, satellites, and naval applications. As most fuel cells run on hydrogen and oxygen, they have no exhaust other than water vapor so Fuel Cells are also used as generators for buildings and other large structures. Cannot use Additional Cooling Kits, Exchanger or Banks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 燃料电池引擎主要用于民用领域，如铁路系统、个人交通工具和工业机甲. 燃料电池引擎产生电能，供车辆驱动其推进系统. 与典型的内燃机相比，燃料电池引擎具有多项优势. 虽然它们需要氧化剂才能运行，但它们能够轻松接受储存的氧化剂和燃料，因此是潜艇、卫星和海军应用的理想选择. 由于大多数燃料电池以氢和氧为燃料，除水蒸气外无其他排放物，因此燃料电池也用作建筑物和其他大型结构的发电机. 无法使用附加冷却套件、换热器或蓄热器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For all intents and purposes identical to a modern internal combustion engine, the I.C.E. in BattleTech is used mainly for conventional vehicles and IndustrialMechs. Its power output is less than a fusion engine of similar mass, meaning an I.C.E. needs to be heavier in order to have the same engine rating of a fusion engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从实际功能上来看，BattleTech中的内燃机与现代内燃机别无二致，主要用于常规车辆和工业机甲. 其输出功率低于同等质量的核聚变引擎，这意味着要达到与核聚变引擎相同的额定功率，内燃机必须做得更重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fusion engines function by harnessing the power of a fusion reaction, running on light hydrogen and protium. Fusion engines are defined by their engine rating. For 'Mechs, the engine rating is the mathematical product of the mass of the vehicle and its desired maximum walking or cruising velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 聚变引擎通过驾驭聚变反应的能量运转，使用轻氢与氢作为燃料。 聚变引擎以其引擎额定值为规格。对机甲而言，引擎额定值是车辆质量与其期望最大行走或巡航速度的乘积。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Land Air Mech (LAM) Engine provides a specialized energy concept that allows the Mech to Change into a Wing in Ground Effect (WiGE) Unit. Unit can Change between LAM and 'Mech Mode. Land Air Mech (LAM) Mode: Mech will Hover above the Battlefield. Mech Walk Speeds Translate into Flight Speed. LAM Turbines provide additional 'Walk' Speed in Flight. When in LAM Mode, Unit can perform Extremely Long Jumps at increased Heat('Afterburner') When in LAM Mode, Unit will not be affected by Terrain/Ground
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陆空机甲（LAM）引擎提供了一种特殊的能量方案，可让机甲变形成地面效应翼（WiGE）单位。 单位可在LAM模式与机甲模式之间切换。 陆空机甲（LAM）模式：机甲将悬浮于战场之上。机甲的行走速度会转化为飞行速度。 LAM涡轮在飞行中提供额外的"行走"速度。 处于LAM模式时，单位可通过提高热量（"加力燃烧"）进行超远距离跳跃 处于LAM模式时，单位不受地形/地面影响

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Battle Armor can make swarm attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套战斗装甲可以进行蜂群攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default Clan FCS. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认的部族 FCS。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以跟踪单位、生成射击解算并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The FCS of a Industrial Battlemech. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业战斗机的火控系统。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The FCS of a Primitive Battlemech. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始战斗机甲的 FCS。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以跟踪单位、生成射击解算并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Default SLDF FCS. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认SLDF火控系统。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传来的海量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Society FCS Package attuned to the BattleMech's internals, it's great efficiency leads to improved Heat Regulation. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套社会党火控系统组件与战斗机甲的内部结构相调谐，其出色的效率带来了更佳的热量调节效果。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器输入的海量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A default Mech FCS. A Mech's Fire Control System coordinates and analyzes the vast amount of information brought in by Sensors in order to track units, generate firing solutions and hit targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默认的机甲 FCS。机甲的火控系统负责协调并分析传感器传入的大量信息，以追踪单位、生成射击方案并命中目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All incoming Melee damage reduced extra Melee Damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有来袭近战伤害降低，近战伤害提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All incoming Melee damage reduced, extra Melee Damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有来袭近战伤害降低，近战伤害提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guardian ECM making this unit harder to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守护者 ECM 使该单位更难被击中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gyros counteract the massive amounts of momentum generated from 'Mech engines and allow for precision maneuvering and recovery from stability-impacting attacks. All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock Gyro, which can be upgraded for improved performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪抵消机甲引擎产生的巨大动量，使机甲能精确机动并从影响稳定性的攻击中恢复。所有机甲都配备标准陀螺仪，可通过升级提升性能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This started life as a 'Coventry Dreadnought', but the salvage technicians damaged a few bits and bobs when cutting it free from the unit it was installed in. It comes with vastly superior Control systems directly allowing the passive system to angle the Mech's Armour to deflect incoming Attacks with maximum efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是一台"考文垂无畏"，但打捞技师在把它从原装机甲上切下来时弄坏了几样零碎。它装有远为优越的控制系统，能直接让被动系统以最高效率调整机甲装甲角度，偏转来袭攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Unique variant of the Ultralight Gyro linked to advanced Stabilized providing weight saving benefits without the stability penalty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是超轻陀螺仪的一种独特改型，与先进稳定系统联动，在节省重量的同时没有稳定度惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gyro helps establish center-of-mass equilibrium for the BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 陀螺仪帮助战斗机甲维持重心平衡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hatchet is a melee attack weapon equipped on BattleMechs. While most 'Mechs are equipped with ranged weaponry, melee weaponry is also both feasible and useful due to increased damage potential (over a punch) and a lack of heat buildup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斧是装备在战斗机甲上的近战武器。虽然大多数机甲装备的是远程武器，但近战武器同样可行且有用，因为它相比拳击具有更高的伤害潜力，且不会积热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While initially little more than bulked out hatchets that traded a cutting edge for crushing ability when they first appeared in the Solaris Games, has the weapon evolved into the heavier and distinctive definitive model. Despite finally reaching a production grade standard, the unwieldy and unbalanced nature of the mace compared to the hatchet or sword has made them rarely seen in general military 'Mech designs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钉锤最初在索拉里斯竞技大赛中登场时，不过是加粗的斧头——以切割刃换取粉碎力；如今这种武器已演化为更厚重、更具辨识度的定型款式。尽管最终达到了量产级标准，但相比斧或剑，钉锤笨重失衡的特性使其在常规军用机甲设计中极为罕见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A small BattleMech VibroBlade inflicting alot of damage but generates heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一柄小型战斗机甲振动刃，造成大量伤害但会产生热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sword is a melee attack weapon developed in 3058 by the Draconis Combine as an 'honorable' alternative to the 'crude' Lyran Hatchet, the Sword inflicts almost as much damage as a Hatchet and offers a better hit probability due to its exceptional balance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 剑是德拉科尼斯联合体于 3058 年开发的近战武器，作为"粗野"的莱兰斧的"体面"替代品。剑造成的伤害几乎与斧相当，且因配重出色而拥有更高的命中率。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Radical Heatsink System drastically improves the mechs cooling
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激进散热器系统大幅改善机甲散热

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲的冷却系统为机甲内部部件提供散热，并为机甲各处的额外散热器提供兼容的扩展点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Basic Clan Cockpits Sensor Package is a step above comparable Inner Sphere packages. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by combat vehicles, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础氏族驾驶舱传感器套件优于同类内天体系统. 热成像、微光增强、雷达和磁异常探测器是作战车辆使用的主要传感器，辅以地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪等多种其他传感器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供敌方单位的详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Industrial Sensors Suite. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by BattleMechs, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套工业传感器套件. 热成像、微光增强、雷达和磁异常传感器都是战斗机甲使用的主要传感器，此外还配备了地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪以及众多其他辅助传感设备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides less detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供更少的敌方单位详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Primitive Sensors Suite. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by combat vehicles, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套原始传感器套件. 热成像、微光增强、雷达和磁异常传感器都是战斗车辆使用的主要传感器，此外还辅以地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪以及众多其他设备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Basic SLDF Cockpits Sensor Package, is a step above contemporary Inner Sphere systems. A Basic Sensors Suite. Thermal imaging, light amplification, radar and magnetic anomaly sensors are all among the primary sensors used by combat vehicles, supplemented by seismic sensors, motion detectors, chemical analyzers and a multitude of others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础星际联盟防卫军(SLDF)驾驶舱传感器套件，性能优于当代内天体系统. 一套基础传感器套件. 热成像、微光增强、雷达和磁异常传感器都是战斗车辆使用的主要传感器，此外还辅以地震传感器、运动探测器、化学分析仪以及众多其他设备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它以物理方式协助机师瞄准对手。反冲补偿器与陀螺稳定器用于防止因后坐力和移动等因素造成的常规武器偏移，同时计算机会考虑大气及其他条件，对目标给出精确的"提前量"。这让武器射击具有更外科手术式的精度，尤其对本身精准的系统更是如此。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As part of the experiments that led to Triple Strength Myomer, the NAIS and other research firms went through several prototypes. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quicsell Company (also known as the Quicksell Company, Quicsel Company, Quiksell Company, Quickcel Company, Quiccell Company, Quiccel Company, Quikcell Company, Quikcel Company, and briefly The Qwix'ell Company, due to an incredibly complicated corporate structure that has baffled generations of tax auditors) is a military goods manufacturer with branches across the Inner Sphere. Though ubiquitous, their products are notorious for being of low quality. In fact the AFFS doesn't accept Quikscell products into service until a team of technicians have inspected every vehicle. If repairs need to be made, they are made immediately and the AFFS charges the time to Quikscell.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快销公司（也被称为Quicksell、Quicsel、Quiksell、Quickcel、Quiccell、Quiccel、Quikcell、Quikcel等公司，还曾短暂叫过Qwix'ell公司，这源于一套极其复杂、让数代税务审计员都困惑不已的公司结构）是一家军品制造商，在内天体各地设有分支机构。虽然无处不在，他们的产品以质量低劣著称。事实上，AFFS不接受快销的产品服役，除非一组技师检查过每一辆车辆。若需要维修，就立即维修，而AFFS把工时费记在快销账上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Perfected Thermal Vision on a BattleMech took much time and dedication by Doering. The Optical 320 Suite managed to produce some amazing results for its time. First released in 2950, this model allowed 'Mechs limited vision of heat sources, while removing backwash and interference from 'Mech weapon systems and operation by adding very heavy shielding to the Thermal Imaging Unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在机甲上完善热成像让多林付出了大量时间与专注。光学320套件为其时代创造了一些惊人的成果。该型号于2950年首次发布，为热成像单元加装极重的屏蔽，使机甲能有限地看到热源，同时消除机甲武器系统与运作带来的回流与干扰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An improvement on the original, Doering's Optical 570 Thermal Imaging Unit allowed more sensitive detection of foreign heat sources, at longer ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为原版的改进，多林的光学570热成像单元能在更远距离上更灵敏地探测外来热源。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Add On Thermal Vision MK2: Heat Vision
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 外置热成像MK2: 热成像视觉

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Add On Thermal Vision MK2: Night Vision

With the release of the Optical 990 Imaging Suite, Doering has perfected thermal vision for 'Mechs. This model uses advanced materials to shield the electronics from local interference, greatly improving its effective range at only slightly increased weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着光学990成像套件的发布，多林完善了机甲的热成像视野。该型号使用先进材料为电子器件屏蔽局部干扰，在仅略微增加重量的情况下大幅提升了有效距离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This training target is easier to hit than enemy units in the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个训练靶比战场上的敌方单位更容易被命中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, you primitive screw-heads, listen up! See this? This... is my boomstick! - It's an LB-X/10, double-barreled Defiance Disintegrator. S-Mart's top of the line. You can find this in the sporting goods department. That's right, this sweet baby was made in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Retails for about $109.95. It's got a walnut stock, cobalt-blue steel, and a hair trigger. That's right... shop smart: shop S-Mart... Ya got that?!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，你们这些原始蠢货，听好了！看到这个了吗？这……就是我的轰击棒！这是一门LB-X/10，双管反抗分解器。S-Mart的顶级货。你可以在体育用品部找到它。没错，这宝贝是在密歇根大急流城制造的。零售价大约109.95美元。胡桃木枪托、钴蓝钢、灵敏扳机。没错……聪明购物：去S-Mart……听明白了吗？！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Cooling Jacket' is barely more than a Heat Exchanger wired around the arm actuators, I must say, I'm actually impressed at this ...if it doesn't blow up that is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个“冷却夹套”不过就是个缠在手臂驱动器上的换热器罢了。不得不说，我其实还挺佩服的……前提是它别炸了。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一款为空天战机设计的瞄准系统，好让它们在射击目标时派得上用场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Ammo bin contains the infamous 'Hydra' Missiles from the deep periphery, carrying a volatile payload of a High Explosive and Incendiary Materials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个弹药箱装的是来自深远外缘、臭名昭著的"九头蛇"导弹，其战斗部是高爆与燃烧物质构成的易爆载荷。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All incoming Melee damage reduced, extra Melee Damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有来袭近战伤害降低，近战伤害提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An industrial armor with welded spikes on it, obviously created somewhere far from the civilized systems of the Inner Sphere. Apparently has the nickname of 'Hedgehog Skin'.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种焊上有尖刺的工业装甲，显然是在远离内天体文明星系的某处造出来的。据说绰号叫"刺猬皮"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A stylish red balloon for your mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 给你的机甲一个时尚的红色气球。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Haley Flannigan's Cyclone, Hail Storm, features a pair of reinforced retractable blades; what they lack in finesse, they make up for in brute force. Requires a Hand Actuator to be installed in same Location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑利·弗兰尼根的旋风“冰雹风暴”装有一对加固伸缩刃；它们在技巧上欠缺，便以蛮力弥补。 需在同一位置安装手部驱动器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Someone ripped this off of one of those Atlas variants the Pirates like to use, tore off all of the equipment that turned it into something you use in the hands of a 'Mech, then welded it directly on to the shoulder of this Mackie. THEN, they loaded it up with minelaying rockets and used something to scratch in the words 'Ground Control' for some reason! I honestly don't understand what in the hells these folks are thinking sometimes. 1 SHOT! VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有人从海盗爱用的那种阿特拉斯变型上拆下这东西，撕掉所有把它变成机甲手持武器的装备，然后直接焊到这台麦克机的肩上。再然后，他们给它装满布雷火箭，还不知为什么用什么东西划上了“地面控制”几个字！说实话，我有时真搞不懂这些人到底在想什么。 单发！ 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可通过升级提升性能。驾驶舱改装提升机甲战士战斗中所处区域的结构，从而增强对致命伤害的防护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Dual Cockpit, also called Dual Cockpit Combat (DCC) System, is a nonstandard cockpit layout for BattleMechs that splits 'Mech operation between two operators, usually a pilot and a gunner. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. Command Consoles are components that can only be mounted on Heavy or Assault Class 'Mechs. The Console adds a complete set of controls for a second MechWarrior with added command and control facilities, allowing for better Lance coordination by upgrading initiative.

Star League-vintage Command Consoles are very rare by 3025 because 'Mechs equipped in this way were favoured targets in battle. Most still existing have been relegated to training duties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可通过升级提升性能。指挥控制台是只能装在重型或突击级机甲上的组件。它为第二名机甲战士增加一整套操控装置以及指挥控制设施，通过提升先攻权来改善小队协同。

到 3025 年，星盟时代的指挥控制台已极为罕见，因为如此装备的机甲在战斗中是被优先打击的目标。现存的大多已被降级用于训练任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它能以物理方式帮助机甲战士瞄准对手。它用后坐力补偿器与陀螺稳定器防止武器因后坐力、移动等因素产生常规漂移，同时计算机会考虑大气与其他条件，给出目标的精确"提前量"。这让武器射击更为精准，尤其对本来就很精准的系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Guardian ECM Suite was introduced in 2597 by Johnston Industries of the Terran Hegemony. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The rogue scientists of the Society developed the Nova CEWS after hearing about the C3 Systems used by the Inner Sphere. By combining elements of the Watchdog CEWS with a C3 system, they created a tool that could find enemy forces, hide the unit using it in an ECM bubble, and automatically provide targeting data to other friendly units. In addition, the Nova CEWS didn't require pre-configuration for the C3 capability; It could be programmed on the fly to respond to availability of friendly forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 社会党的叛逆科学家在听闻内层星域使用的 C3 系统后，开发出了 Nova CEWS。他们把看门狗 CEWS 的组件与 C3 系统相结合，创造出一种工具：既能发现敌军，又能让使用它的单位隐藏在 ECM 气泡中，还能自动向其他友军提供瞄准数据。此外，Nova CEWS 的 C3 功能无需预先配置，可以随时编程，以响应友军的可用情况。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Seraphim Suite was developed by the Word of Blake as a response to the clans Nova CEWS, completing the circle as the Society originally created the Nova as a response to the C3 technology. By using all their knowledge of communications and advanced ECM technology, the Blakeist scientists created a combination of sensors, ECM and other EWS equipment that practically put it on par with the clan tech. However, it's prohibitive size and weight kept it from being used outside of the Word's largest 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炽天使套件由布莱克之词研发，用以应对部族的新星CEWS；这也让轮回闭合——毕竟“学会”最初研制新星正是为了应对C3技术。布莱克派科学家利用他们在通讯与先进电子对抗技术上的全部知识，造出了传感器、电子对抗与其他电子战设备的组合，性能几乎与部族技术持平。然而，它体积与重量都过于庞大，因此只能在布莱克之词最大的机甲上使用。
定点射击可靠性提高一倍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems. This system is tuned to enable the pilot to hit the cockpit of enemy mechs in the heat to battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是一种精密电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它能切实帮助机甲战士瞄准对手。它使用后坐力补偿器与陀螺稳定器防止武器因后坐力与移动等因素产生常规偏移，同时计算机考虑大气与其他条件，为射击提供准确的“提前量”。这使武器射击能达到更高的外科手术般精度，对本身精准的系统尤其如此。该系统经过调校，能让飞行员在激战中命中敌方机甲的座舱。

All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. Command Consoles are components that can only be mounted on Heavy or Assault Class 'Mechs. The Console adds a complete set of controls for a second MechWarrior with added command and control facilities, allowing for better Lance coordination by upgrading initiative.

Star League-vintage Command Consoles are very rare by 3025 because 'Mechs equipped in this way were favoured targets in battle. Most still existing have been relegated to training duties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可通过升级提升性能。指挥控制台是只能装在重型或突击级机甲上的组件。它为第二名机甲战士增加一整套操控装置以及指挥控制设施，通过提升先攻权来改善小队协同。

到 3025 年，星盟时代的指挥控制台已极为罕见，因为如此装备的机甲在战斗中是被优先打击的目标。现存的大多已被降级用于训练任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它能以物理方式帮助机甲战士瞄准对手。它用后坐力补偿器与陀螺稳定器防止武器因后坐力、移动等因素产生常规漂移，同时计算机会考虑大气与其他条件，给出目标的精确"提前量"。这让武器射击更为精准，尤其对本来就很精准的系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The latest innovation in BattleMech technology is the Upper Leg Actuator Replacement, a cutting-edge component that replaces both the hip and upper leg actuators with a more compact design. Developed by our engineering team, this new actuator provides increased space and weight savings, allowing for more flexibility in mech design. However, there is a trade-off: while it provides excellent mobility, it comes at the cost of reduced stability. The unique design makes it more challenging to maintain balance and stand firmly on uneven terrain, which can impact the mech's stability during combat. Pilots will need to adapt their tactics accordingly and be mindful of the terrain they engage in.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲技术的最新创新是大腿驱动器替换件——一种前沿部件，以更紧凑的设计替换髋关节驱动器与大腿驱动器。这一新型驱动器由我们的工程团队开发，可提供更多空间并节省重量，让机甲设计获得更大的灵活性。不过它也有取舍：虽然带来出色的机动性，代价却是稳定性下降。其独特设计使机甲更难保持平衡、在不平坦地形上站稳，从而可能影响机甲在战斗中的稳定性。机师需要相应调整战术，并在交战时留意所处地形。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These 'Claws' are actually a bunch of VibroDaggers welded to look like big Bear Paws similar to the original Kodiak's ornamental Claws.......MELEE HAND ACTUATOR. Disables Arm Mounted Weapon Bonus.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This experimental Reactive Armor is solely deployed on this Elite OmniChassis, able to withstand a higher degree of incoming Kinetic damage while allowing to route excess Heat though the plating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种实验性反应装甲仅部署于这一精英全方位底盘上，能承受更高程度的来袭动能伤害，同时允许通过装甲板导出多余热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reactive Armor Plating (sometimes called Blazer Armor) is a type of specialized armor that uses a series of microscopic explosions to reduce the effects of explosive weapons fire like missiles, artillery, and mortars. This experimental variant successfully reduced the armor's formidable weight and bulk, at the cost of some overall protection. Reserves 6 slots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反应装甲板（有时被称为聚焦装甲）是一种特种装甲，利用一系列微观爆炸来降低导弹、火炮和迫击炮等爆炸性武器火力的效果。这一实验性变体成功减轻了该装甲可观的重量与体积，代价是总体防护略降。占用6个槽位。
承受更少手持武器伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A specially strengthened Ferro-Fibrous based armor, blessed in the name of Blake. The actual technology behind it is largely unknown and kept very secret by the Word. All that is known is that makes the Ophanim that much harder to kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种以铁纤为基础特别强化的装甲，以布雷克之名受福。它背后的实际技术大多不明，并被该教团严格保密。人们只知道它让智天使变得远比应有的更难杀死。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hard hits can break pieces off the inside of armor, without piercing it, turning them into shrapnel. This reinforced lining material slows or catches this spall before it can cause damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛烈撞击会在不穿透装甲的前提下崩下装甲内侧的碎块，使其变成弹片。这种加固内衬材料能减缓或拦下这些崩落碎片，使其无法造成伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位可在射击前或射击后移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Secondary CPU extracted from a prototype autonomous combat drone. Coordinates and strengthens the capabilities of the whole Lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从一具原型自主战斗无人机上提取的次级CPU。协调并强化整支分队的能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它能以物理方式帮助机甲战士瞄准对手。它用后坐力补偿器与陀螺稳定器防止武器因后坐力、移动等因素产生常规漂移，同时计算机会考虑大气与其他条件，给出目标的精确"提前量"。这让武器射击更为精准，尤其对本来就很精准的系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A experimental Engine stemming from research into XL and Compact Engines, while it failed to ultimately save weight, it does allow to move the engine assembly into the Side Torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是源于XL引擎与紧凑引擎研究的一种实验性引擎。虽然它最终未能减轻重量，却能让引擎总成移入侧躯干。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit generates an extra EVASIVE charge from movement actions (up to its maximum).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位通过移动行动额外获得 1 层闪避（不超过上限）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was a Light Engine until someone ripped out the Fusion compartment and wired a Fuel Cell into its assembly. They even managed to improve the energy converters wired into it. I can repair it, but this thing can never leave this 'Mech or be used otherwise. Cannot use Additional Cooling Kits, Exchanger or Banks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这原本是一台轻型引擎，直到有人拆掉聚变舱，把燃料电池接进了它的组件里。他们甚至设法改进了接入其中的能量转换器。我能修好它，但这东西永远不能离开这台机甲，也不能另作他用。无法使用附加冷却套件、交换器或储能组。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This specialy modified Marauder Engine Core enables the mech's thrusters to work in conjunction with a LAM system strapped into it while retaining the weight savings of a Light Engine, this effectively makes the engine lighter and makes the mech go faster, it adds a lot more bulk then normal LAM or Light engines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一特别改装的掠夺者引擎核心使机甲的推进器能与绑在它上面的LAM系统协同运作，同时保留轻型引擎的减重效果；这实际上让引擎更轻、机甲更快，代价是比普通LAM或轻型引擎笨重得多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit generates an extra EVASIVE charge from movement actions (up to its maximum).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位通过移动行动额外获得 1 层闪避（不超过上限）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Prototype Light Fusion Engine sacrificed the capacity to carry additional internal Heatsinks and some Shielding but reduced the Engine Weight down to 60% of its Standard Mass.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台原型轻型聚变引擎牺牲了搭载额外内部散热器的能力和部分屏蔽层，但将引擎重量降低到了标准质量的 60%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype by Clan Diamond Shark further improving upon the Ultralight Engine originally developed by RISC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是钻石鲨氏族的一款原型，在RISC最初研发的超轻引擎基础上进一步改进。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A StarLeague Era Prototype XL Engine that does not protrude into the side torsos but suffers increased heat generation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种星盟时代原型XL引擎，它不会凸入侧躯干，但发热量增加。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Prototype Extra Light Fusion Engine was modified to include a Super Charger, able to accelerate its Energy Output beyond all reasonable safety measure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台原型超轻型聚变引擎经过改装，加入了超充器，能够将其能量输出提升到超越所有合理安全措施的程度.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This System allows the engine to more efficiently control the power flow and dissipation of Energy Weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套系统让引擎能更高效地控制能量武器的功率流动与散发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Increases this unit's sensor signature, making it easier to detect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提高该单位的传感器信号，使其更容易被发现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供敌方单位的详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reduces effectiveness of stealthed and ECM shielded units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降低隐身与 ECM 护盾单位的效能

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shows their vision when lancemates move
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小队同僚移动时显示其视野

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The rogue scientists of the Society developed the Nova CEWS after hearing about the C3 Systems used by the Inner Sphere. By combining elements of the Watchdog CEWS with a C3 system, they created a tool that could find enemy forces, hide the unit using it in an ECM bubble, and automatically provide targeting data to other friendly units. In addition, the Nova CEWS didn't require pre-configuration for the C3 capability; It could be programmed on the fly to respond to availability of friendly forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 社会党的叛逆科学家在听闻内层星域使用的 C3 系统后，开发出了 Nova CEWS。他们把看门狗 CEWS 的组件与 C3 系统相结合，创造出一种工具：既能发现敌军，又能让使用它的单位隐藏在 ECM 气泡中，还能自动向其他友军提供瞄准数据。此外，Nova CEWS 的 C3 功能无需预先配置，可以随时编程，以响应友军的可用情况。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A FCS that reduces Jamming Chance, Heat Output, and increases Damage of AntiMissile Systems, but reduces AMS Hit Chance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种火控系统，可降低卡壳几率与热量输出，并提升反导弹系统的伤害，但降低AMS命中率。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides a penalty to all attacks against this unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对攻击该单位的所有攻击施加惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Electronic Warfware suite married to a targeting computer and Missile Targeting System, but cannot be used with any other TTS, Artemis or C3 System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套与瞄准计算机和导弹瞄准系统结合的电子战套件，但不能与任何其他 TTS、Artemis 或 C3 系统同时使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Octagon Accutrack I was commissioned in 3025 as the ongoing mech conflicts found more and more skilled pilots utilizing obstructions in order to reduce oncoming fire. Outfitted with a simple prediction system, it allowed a 'Mech pilot a temporary window to land accurate shots on targets without fear of hitting the cover around the enemy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 八角精准追踪 I 于 3025 年受托研制，当时持续的机甲冲突中，越来越多技术娴熟的飞行员利用障碍物来减少来袭火力。它配备一套简易预测系统，让机甲飞行员获得一个短暂窗口，能对目标完成精准射击而不必担心击中敌人周围的掩体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Howler MKII Designated Comm Suite was specifically designed for the Arctic Wolf BattleMech but never went into mass production, It combines a specialized SRM TTS system with Clan ECM and Probe Technologies tied into a Artemis IV System. Unfortunately it is incompatible to any Streak or ATM system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Howler MKII 专用通讯套件是专为北极狼战斗机甲设计的，但从未投入量产。它把专门的 SRM 瞄准跟踪系统与部族 ECM 和探测器技术结合起来，并接入 Artemis IV 系统。遗憾的是，它与任何连发或 ATM 系统都不兼容。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems. This system has been further improved to help the mechwarrior to aim more accurate in all ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它以物理方式协助机师瞄准对手。反冲补偿器与陀螺稳定器用于防止因后坐力和移动等因素造成的常规武器偏移，同时计算机会考虑大气及其他条件，对目标给出精确的"提前量"。这让武器射击具有更外科手术式的精度，尤其对本身精准的系统更是如此。该系统经过进一步改进，帮助机师在所有射程上瞄得更准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit fires Extreme Range LRM's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位发射极远程 LRM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sophisticated Weapons Computer linked to a delicate system of PPC Capacitors and Energy controllers, allowing this 'Mech to fire its Particle Projector Cannons with impeccable efficiency and accuracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套精密的武器计算机，连接着由粒子炮电容器和能量控制器组成的精巧系统，让这台机甲能以无可挑剔的效率和精度发射粒子投射炮。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。
能量武器 +1 精度，+25% 暴击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like a Elder God unleashed lets this FCS bring Horror and Destruction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如同被释放的远古之神，这套火控系统带来恐惧与毁灭。
能量武器 +1 精度，+25% 暴击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock targeting and tracking system—or TTS—which can be upgraded for improved performance. Upgrades increase accuracy when attacking with Ballistic, Energy, or Missile weaponry, depending on the type of TTS. Doesn't stack with same type but different tiers do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有机甲都配备原装瞄准与追踪系统（TTS），可通过升级提升性能。升级能提高使用弹道、能量或导弹武器攻击时的精度，具体取决于TTS类型。同类型不叠加，但不同等级可以叠加。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Missile weapon attacks have their hit improved by 3.
This model of the KBC Starsight targeting system was developed exclusively for the AEM-01F at the demand of the Amaris Empire Armed Forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款 KBC 星视瞄准系统是应阿马里斯帝国武装部队要求，专为 AEM-01F 开发的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit fires Extreme Range LRM's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位发射极远程 LRM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. Command Consoles are components that can only be mounted on Heavy or Assault Class 'Mechs. The Console adds a complete set of controls for a second MechWarrior with added command and control facilities, allowing for better Lance coordination by upgrading initiative.

Star League-vintage Command Consoles are very rare by 3025 because 'Mechs equipped in this way were favoured targets in battle. Most still existing have been relegated to training duties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可通过升级提升性能。指挥控制台是只能装在重型或突击级机甲上的组件。它为第二名机甲战士增加一整套操控装置以及指挥控制设施，通过提升先攻权来改善小队协同。

到 3025 年，星盟时代的指挥控制台已极为罕见，因为如此装备的机甲在战斗中是被优先打击的目标。现存的大多已被降级用于训练任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 被动：使用单一武器攻击时无视目标的掩体与警戒状态。
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被动：以单件武器攻击时忽略目标的掩护与戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A SLDF Era Royal Double Heat Sink Kit provides superior cooling capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代皇家双散热器套件提供卓越的散热能力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A vastly improved Royal Double Heat Sink Kit. Only available to the very best of the Royal elite MechWarriors of the SLDF.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一款大幅改进的皇家双重散热器套件。只有SLDF皇家精英机师中最顶尖者才能使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Radical Heatsink System drastically improves the mechs cooling

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487, Endo Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. The Corean OM-77 Endo-Steel was an attempt to incorporate Clan Manufacturing Techniques in Inner Sphere Processes, slightly reducing its size at increased costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由泰拉霸权于2487年开发，钢内骨结构是专为战斗机甲骨架设计. Corean OM-77钢内骨结构是尝试将氏族制造技术融入内天体工艺的产物，以增加成本为代价略微减小了其体积.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Federated Suns introduced the Composite Internal Structure. Inspired by the Endo Steel chassis, the FedSuns engineers produced a chassis that was light weight but wasn't as bulky as the Endo Steel skeleton. Though they were successful, the materials used in the Composite Structure were incredibly fragile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联邦太阳国推出了复合内部结构。受内骨架底盘启发，联邦太阳国的工程师造出了重量轻但不似内骨架般臃肿的底盘。虽然他们成功了，但复合结构所用的材料极为脆弱。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是早期的一次原型尝试，试图把氏族级内层钢技术与内层复合结构材料结合起来，后者能带来更大的减重效果，但维修起来极其复杂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early proto-type version of Endo Steel, slightly bulkier than the final production version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种早期原型版本的内层钢，比最终量产版本略为笨重。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reinforced Industrial Structure with Experimental TSM is a bulky and expensive structure designed for deep space exploration and prospector chassis.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OmniMech is a highly configurable type of BattleMech. OmniMechs mount some of their loadout in modular OmniPods. This gives Omnis the ability to replace damaged components and change battlefield role to fulfill mission requirements. Though not solely created for modular weapon loadouts, the OmniMech design greatly aids repair and construction. Once their modular weaponry and equipment is removed, the empty bays provide better access to repair the chassis. Damaged components such as arms and legs can be easily repaired in half the time it takes for common BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 万能机甲是一种高度可配置的战斗机甲类型. 万能机甲将其部分载荷安装在模块化的OmniPod中. 这使得万能机甲能够替换受损部件，并根据任务需求改变战场角色. 虽然并非仅为模块化武器载荷而创造，但万能机甲设计大大有助于维修和建造. 一旦其模块化武器和装备被移除，空置的舱室便能提供更好的通道来修理底盘. 诸如手臂和腿部等受损部件可以轻松修复，所需时间仅为普通战斗机甲的一半.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供 70 点稳定值，并减少 20% 所受稳定伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
All 'Mechs come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. Command Consoles are components that can only be mounted on Heavy or Assault Class 'Mechs. The Console adds a complete set of controls for a second MechWarrior with added command and control facilities, allowing for better Lance coordination by upgrading initiative.

Star League-vintage Command Consoles are very rare by 3025 because 'Mechs equipped in this way were favoured targets in battle. Most still existing have been relegated to training duties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可通过升级提升性能。指挥控制台是只能装在重型或突击级机甲上的组件。它为第二名机甲战士增加一整套操控装置以及指挥控制设施，通过提升先攻权来改善小队协同。

到 3025 年，星盟时代的指挥控制台已极为罕见，因为如此装备的机甲在战斗中是被优先打击的目标。现存的大多已被降级用于训练任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它能以物理方式帮助机甲战士瞄准对手。它用后坐力补偿器与陀螺稳定器防止武器因后坐力、移动等因素产生常规漂移，同时计算机会考虑大气与其他条件，给出目标的精确"提前量"。这让武器射击更为精准，尤其对本来就很精准的系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss... \"Goat-Fi\", REALLY? Of all the things I've seen and heard in my time, this might take the cake, and eat it too. And look here, it's got something stamped on it: \"He who controls Goat Path, is destined to control the Inner Sphere!\" What the hell is that supposed to mean?!?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板……“羊特菲”，认真的？我在这一生中见过听过的东西里，这可能要算头一份，连锅端走。你瞧这儿，上面还印着什么：“谁掌控羊径，谁就注定掌控内层星域！”这到底什么意思？！？
决心生成量降低 1 点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As part of the experiments that led to Triple Strength Myomer, the NAIS and other research firms went through several prototypes. Though unsuited for combat use, there were several formulations that held promise for Industrial applications. This information, allowed IndustrialMech manufacturers to create Industrial Triple Strength Myomer which was ideally suited for loading, hauling, and other heavy lift tasks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在催生三重肌纤维束（TSM）的实验中，新阿瓦隆科学研究院（NAIS）及其他研究机构经历了多轮原型开发. 虽然这些原型并不适合战斗用途，但其中几种配方在工业应用上展现出巨大潜力. 基于这些信息，工业机甲制造商成功研发出工业型三重肌纤维束，非常适合装卸、拖运及其他重型起重作业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Laser Anti-Missile System (LAMS) is an advanced variation of the standard Anti-Missile Systems. While the standard system utilizes a machine gun linked to specialized tracking systems, the LAMS uses a Small Pulse Laser, ensuring that the system never runs out of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导系统（LAMS）是标准反导系统的先进变体。标准系统使用与专用追踪系统联动的机枪，而 LAMS 使用小型脉冲激光，确保系统永不缺弹。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Laser Anti-Missile System (LAMS) is an advanced variation of the standard Anti-Missile Systems. While the standard system utilizes a machine gun linked to specialized tracking systems, the LAMS uses a Small Pulse Laser, ensuring that the system never runs out of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导弹系统（LAMS）是标准反导弹系统的一种先进改型. 标准系统使用与专用跟踪系统相连的机枪，而LAMS则使用小型脉冲激光，确保该系统永远不会耗尽弹药.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: LAMS fires 20 Shots at every Missile in Range
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导弹系统对射程内每枚导弹发射20发

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rain Dancer Laser Anti-Missile System (LAMS) utilizes a series of micro pulse lasers to rapidly take down incoming missiles; unfortunately, this system runs incredibly hot and it is heavily integrated into the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雨舞者激光反导弹系统（LAMS）利用一系列微型脉冲激光快速击落来袭导弹；遗憾的是，该系统发热极高，且与底盘深度整合。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arrow IV is a stand-alone, missile based, artillery system, designed to augment conventional systems such as the Long Tom and the Sniper. This is a rotary abomination, capable of launching up to three high speed air-to-ground Arrow IV warheads at once... if it doesn't explode when you pull the trigger, that is. 15 shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 箭矢IV是一种独立、以导弹为基础的炮兵系统，旨在补充长汤姆和狙击手等常规系统。这一具却是旋转式的怪物，能一次性发射多达三枚高速空对地箭矢IV弹头……前提是你扣下扳机时它没炸掉。 < 15发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Directly at flying targets in line of sight. -3 Accuracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对视线内的飞行目标直接射击。-3 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Directly at line of sight targets at short range. -4 Accuracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在近距离对视线内目标直接射击。-4 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire in a high arc at ground targets. -5 精度
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以高弧线对地面目标射击。-5 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arrow IV is a stand-alone, missile based, artillery system, designed to augment conventional systems such as the Long Tom and the Sniper. It was first introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2600 and became a staple of the Star League Defense Force. Although the technology to create Arrow IVs was lost during the Star League's collapse, it was recovered by Capellan Confederation engineers in 3044 working off of surviving examples and the Helm Memory Core. 5 shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 箭矢IV是一种独立、以导弹为基础的炮兵系统，旨在补充长汤姆和狙击手等常规系统。它由地球霸权于2600年首次推出，此后成为星盟防卫部队的主力装备。虽然制造箭矢IV的技术在星盟崩溃期间失传，但卡佩兰联邦的工程师在3044年依据幸存的样机和亥姆记忆核心将其复原。 < 5发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inferno-IV Missiles are a variation of Arrow IV missiles first introduced by the Capellan Confederation. The technology was based on recovered Clan FASCAM missiles and was designed to deploy the newly-invented Inferno Mines. Unfortunately, the mines proved to be unstable and would instead ignite upon impact, causing widespread fires. 10 rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱火IV导弹是卡佩兰联邦首次推出的箭矢IV导弹变体。该技术基于回收的氏族FASCAM导弹，旨在布设新发明的地狱火地雷。不幸的是，这些地雷被证明不稳定，反而会在撞击时点燃，造成大范围火灾。10发。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Directly at flying targets in line of sight. -3 Accuracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对视线内的飞行目标直接射击。-3 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Directly at line of sight targets at short range, minimum range 90. -4 Accuracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在近距离对视线内目标直接射击，最小射程 90。-4 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire in a high arc at ground targets. -5 精度
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以高弧线对地面目标射击。-5 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An elegant union between a Sniper Artillery Piece and a Ultra Autocannon/5 feeder, the Big Steel is the custom-built namesake for the Helepolis 2L 'Big Steel'. Capable of firing two successive artillery shells with a reduced payload, nobody dares to ask Big Steel's business. Uses Sniper Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为狙击手炮与超速自动炮/5供弹机的优雅结合，巨钢是攻城锤2L"巨钢"的定制同名武器。它能连续发射两发载荷削弱过的炮弹，没人敢去打听巨钢的生意。 使用狙击手弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was an Advanced Tactical Missile system, before someone turned it into this wreckage. This is the famous case of getting a weapon into some nutcases hand but no ammo for it. The whole system has been turned upside down, the Artemis got completely yanked out and they put a jury rigged RAC-feeder in its place, allowing the speed at which it launches Missiles to be adjusted, but i'd be carefull setting it to high speed, though slower speeds improve its lock on speed. VOLATILE! Uses LRM/MRM/SRM Ammo. Firing Modes: LRM, MRM, SRM
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这原本是一套高级战术导弹系统，直到有人把它变成了这堆残骸。这是那种著名的案例：武器落到某个疯子手里，却没有配套弹药。整个系统被翻了个底朝天，阿尔忒弥斯被彻底拔出，他们塞进了一个临时拼凑的旋转自动炮供弹器，让发射导弹的速度可调，但把速度调高时你要小心，虽然较低速度能提升其锁定速度。 < 易爆！ < 使用LRM/MRM/SRM弹药。 < 射击模式：LRM、MRM、SRM

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Astral Hammer is a huge 245 mm Ultra Autocannon that through an advanced reload mechanism is able to deliver almost 300 kilograms of ammunition in a 10 second period. This would technically classify it as a UAC/30, but since this designation doesn't normally exist and the Blakeist engineers wanted a more holy name the classification was never used.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星界之锤是一门巨大的245毫米超速自动炮，通过先进的再装填机制，能在10秒内投送近300公斤弹药。严格来说这会把它归类为UAC/30，但由于这个编号通常并不存在，而布雷克派的工程师想要一个更神圣的名字，这个分类从未被使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Prototype Rotary AC10 has advanced stabilizer and increased range but requires more space. Once this weapon was built, the engineers looked at the creation, and proclaimed it needed wings. Uses RAC10 Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种原型旋转 AC10 拥有先进的稳定器，射程也有所提升，但占用空间更大。这件武器造好后，工程师们端详着成品，声称它还需要一对翅膀。 使用 RAC10 弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SodaPopAC-TAC-UltraLightAutoRevolver is another salvage miracle from Cyrus Miles. This chopped RAC2 was modified to fire rounds formed from SodaPop cans, hardened to form a penetrating shell, and filled with a sticky liquid that's guaranteed to short-circuit and gum-up any internals it hits. Weight savings came at the expense of combat reloads and any range whatsoever. Still not sure what Through Armor Criticals mean though, only thing I got from Cyrus was '4th Wall'. 1 SHOT!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款“汽水罐-超轻型自动左轮炮”是赛勒斯·迈尔斯的又一个打捞奇迹。这把被改短的RAC2经过改装，可发射用汽水罐成型的弹丸——经硬化形成穿透弹壳，内填一种黏性液体，保证能让它击中的任何内部结构短路并卡死。减重的代价是失去战斗再装填能力和一切射程。不过我仍然不确定“穿甲致命一击”是什么意思，赛勒斯只给了我一句“第四面墙”。 单发！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Agricultural 'Mechs use arm-mounted Chainsaws to fell trees and harvest timber. In an emergency these giant saws can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons, Chainsaws suffer a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 农业机甲使用手臂安装的链锯伐树和采伐木材。紧急情况下，这些巨型锯子也可用于机甲近战。与所有工业武器一样，链锯有轻微的固有命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chance to stand up improved by actuator
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由驱动器提升的起身几率

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Chainsaw: Increased Bonus Flat Physical Weapon Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型链锯: 提高物理武器固定伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Chainsaw: Increased Bonus Flat Physical Weapon Stability Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型链锯: 提高物理武器固定稳定性伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Chainsaw: Increased Chance to Stand Up
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型链锯: 起身概率提升

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Chainsaw: Increased Physical Weapon Extra Hits
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型链锯: 物理武器增加额外攻击判定
重型链锯: 是物理武器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heavy Chainsaw: Use STANDARD Hit Table
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型链锯: 使用标准命中表

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Homelite XL in Red is the aspiring Woodmans Tool of choice, it will reliable cut through all that needs be cutting, be it Tree, Table or Deadites, Shop smart, Shop S-Mart!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 红色的Homelite XL型号，是怀揣梦想的伐木者首选工具. 它能可靠地切割所有需要切割的东西，无论是树木、桌子还是恶鬼. 明智购物，就到S-Mart!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chainsaw: Physical Weapon Attacker Unsteady on Miss
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 链锯: 物理武器攻击者未命中时失衡

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chainsaw: Physical Weapon Target Unsteady on Hit
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 链锯: 物理武器命中使目标失衡

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chainsaw: Reduced Physical Weapon Hit Chance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 链锯: 物理武器命中率降低

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique Chainsaw: Increased Bonus Flat Physical Weapon Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独特链锯: 提高物理武器固定伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique Chainsaw: Increased Bonus Flat Physical Weapon Stability Damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独特链锯: 提高物理武器固定稳定性伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique Chainsaw: Increased Physical Weapon Extra Hits
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独特链锯: 物理武器增加额外攻击判定
独特链锯: 是物理武器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique Chainsaw: Use STANDARD Hit Table
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独特链锯: 使用标准命中表

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, I don't know what this is, but some jokester welded a flamer onto the cockpit, and hotwired a heat bank into it that runs through a coffee machine. This can only be installed in the head.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，我不知道这是什么，但有个爱开玩笑的家伙把一具火焰喷射器焊到座舱上，还硬接了一个热储罐，管线还穿过一台咖啡机。这东西只能装在头部。
提供 +1 先攻权和若干增益。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is coated with burning chemicals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被燃烧化学品覆盖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Solaris Weapon, some psycho thought it was a good idea to make a mech fist which, when it sucker punches other mechs, will fire a flamer at pinpoint range! Its not very effective but the Liao guys talk about 'Burning Fist' move from an old antique game.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一件典型的 Solaris 武器：某个疯子觉得造一只机甲拳头是个好主意——当它偷袭其他机甲时，会在贴脸的距离上喷出火焰喷射器的火舌！它其实并不怎么有效，但 Liao 那帮人总爱提起某款老古董游戏里的“燃烧之拳”招式。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Flammable Oil increases Incoming Heat Damage +12.5%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可燃油料使受到的热量伤害增加 12.5%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fluid Gun is nothing more than a militarized Fluid Sprayer system. By toughening the feed lines and storage tanks, the engineers of Solaris VII created a system roughly equivalent to a Flamer. Unlike the flamer however, the Fluid Gun can store and spray a variety of fluid types. Clever arena fighters have used water, oil slicks, Inferno Fuel, Cooling Fluid, and Corrosive Fluids in matches. Uses Fluid Cannisters (Ammo).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 流体枪不过是军用化的流体喷射系统。通过加固输送管与储罐，索拉里斯VII的工程师造出了一套大致相当于火焰喷射器的系统。但与火焰喷射器不同，流体枪能储存并喷射多种流体。聪明的竞技场缠斗者已在比赛中使用过水、滑油、燃烧燃料、冷却液和腐蚀性液体。 使用流体罐（弹药）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is covered with fluorescent paint! Its vision range is -80%, it has -2 Accuracy and is +20% more visible. 3 Turn duration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被荧光涂料覆盖! 其视野范围降低 80%，命中精度 -2，可见度提高 20%. 持续 3 回合.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is coated with burning chemicals. It will gain 15 heat on its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被燃烧的化学物质覆盖，下次行动时将增加 15 点热量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is coated with corrosive Acid. It will take 10% increased Damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被腐蚀性强酸覆盖，将承受 10% 额外伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is coated with oil. It will take +25% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被油污覆盖，在其下次行动前，受到的所有攻击将造成 +25% 的稳定性伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is covered in high visibility paint
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被高可见度涂料覆盖

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Decreased Target Cooling
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 降低目标冷却能力

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Decreased Target Vision Range Multiplier
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 降低目标视野范围倍率

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Decreased Target Walk Speed
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 降低目标步行速度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Increased Target AoE Damage Taken
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 增加目标受到的范围伤害

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Increased Target Damage Taken
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 增加目标所受伤害

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Increased Target Heat Damage Taken
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 目标受到的热量伤害增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Increased Target Stability Damage Taken
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 目标受到的稳定性伤害增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Increased Target Visual Signature
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 增加目标视觉特征

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Super Fluid Gun: Reduced Target Accuracy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超流体枪: 降低目标命中精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily optimized version of the standard AP Gauss Rifle Battery allowing two of them to work in tandem from the same fire control hardware, thus bringing the total to eight AP Gauss Rifles. Uses MagShot Ammo.. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是标准反人员磁轨炮组经过大幅优化的版本，让两组炮组共用同一套火控硬件协同运作，从而总计八门反人员磁轨炮。使用麦格射击弹药。。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Prototype Gauss Rifle from the NAIS, firing a larger and heavier projectile with more force and speed than later production models. It does suffer occasional energy failures and recoil.VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是NAIS制造的原型磁轨炮，发射比后来的量产型号更重、更有力、更快的弹丸。它偶尔会出现能量故障和后坐力。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Prototype Hammerfist Heavy Gauss Rifle is permanently affixed to the Dreka Chassis. It sports superior range and damage to the final production model, at the cost of heat and a chance that the Capacitor may fail to charge in time.VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这门原型锤拳重型磁轨炮被永久固定在德雷卡底盘上。它的射程与伤害都优于最终量产型号，代价是热量以及电容器可能来不及充能。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This poor mangled and tortured Weapon was a Star League era relic, a Masterpiece of lost Technology, a 'Rail Gun'. Then some Pirates found it and made it 'working' again, the chambering system is a complete mess that only accepts 'Canisters' with 'Magnetic Materials'. VOLATILE! Uses Railgun Ammo. Reduced Damage from Movement
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这件被可怜地撕裂、折磨的武器曾是星盟时代的遗物、失传科技的杰作——一门"磁轨炮"。然后一些海盗找到了它，让它重新"能用"。其装填系统已彻底混乱，只接受装有"磁性材料"的"罐体"。 < 易爆！ < 使用磁轨炮弹药。 < 移动造成的伤害降低

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Gauss Rifle uses electromagnetic charges to accelerate metallic rounds at extremely high speed, dealing massive damage by kinetic force alone. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高斯步枪利用电磁电荷把金属弹丸加速到极高速度，仅凭动能就造成巨大伤害。 使用高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the weapon used by infantry for centuries, the Grenade Launcher fires a small shell in a high arc that falls onto the target. Uses Mortar Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 榴弹发射器以步兵使用了几个世纪的武器为基础，能把小型炮弹以高抛弹道射向目标。 使用迫击炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple loading crane used to move heavy loads around, not very impressive as a weapon by itself but some LoaderKing pilots manage to use it to ensnare and topple enemy mechs
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种用于搬移重物的简易装货吊车，作为武器本身并不起眼，但一些重载之王飞行员能用它缠住并掀翻敌方机甲
提供 +1 先攻权和若干增益。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides a bonus to actions that generate Morale.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为产生士气的行动提供加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Provides detailed information on enemy units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提供敌方单位的详细信息

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target is marked for guided munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已被标记用于制导弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This target was TAG'ed. +1 to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标已被 TAG 标记。命中 +1。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grazer is one of many dead end attempts at producing a next generation directed energy weapon. Particles in the Gamma Ray range are not as easily stopped by solid matter as conventional light resulting in improved armor penetration chance, but only on par with a gauss rifle. Mounted on the, also experimental, Urbanlord, it proved effective in fighting to Free Tiaw...St. Ives. However the system was ultimately judged too difficult to manufacture on a large scale, and some mechwarriors reported finding it's multiple firing modes distracting and difficult to manage in the heat of battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰泽是许多旨在打造下一代定向能武器的死胡同之一。伽马射线波段的粒子不像常规光那样容易被固体物质阻挡，因此穿甲几率更高，但也就与高斯步枪相当。它装在那台同样是实验性的“城市领主”上，在“自由提亚……圣艾夫斯”的战斗中被证明有效。然而该系统最终被判定为难以大规模制造，一些机甲战士也报告说它多种射击模式令人分心，在激战中难以管理。
C3 信号特征状态效果。

A more reliable and improved version of the experimental Rotary LRM20. While still being able to fire up to three salvos in very short sequence, the jam chance from the internal rotation mechanism jamming is lower and the accuracy has been improved. By going down to 15 missile launch tubes instead of 20, the weight and size of the weapon has been decreased enough that any 'Mech can mount it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为实验性旋转LRM20更可靠、更改进的版本。它仍能在极短序列内发射多达三轮齐射，而内部旋转机构卡壳的几率更低，精度也得到改善。通过减到15具导弹发射管而非20具，该武器的重量与体积下降到任何机甲都能安装的程度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: MAC-II Drop Ship Bay for mecha Transport
A heavily modified machine gun firing oversized paperclips at blistering speeds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一挺经过大幅改装的机枪，以极快的速度发射超大号回形针。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on an ancient Ballistic Multiple Launch Rocket System does this fire Long Range Area of Effect Missiles. This version got heavily modified with a modern ammo feed system compatible to most Battle Mech's. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它基于一种古老的弹道多管火箭发射系统，发射远程面杀伤导弹。这一版本经过大幅改装，配上了兼容大多数战斗机甲的现代供弹系统。易爆！
MML 发射 LRM（远程导弹）
MML 发射 SRM（近程导弹）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Product of the RISC MML Program for the Raptor II Experimentals, it has an Advanced Targeting System that Securely Guides in the First Volley. Uses Clan SRM/LRM Ammo. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为RISC为猛禽II实验型所做MML项目的产物，它带有先进瞄准系统，能在第一轮齐射中稳固制导。 < 使用氏族SRM/LRM弹药。 < 战斗中左键点击命中率可在LRM与SRM之间切换。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Broadside is Barrymore Munitions very own take on the Mech Mortar, able to fire 10 Shells per trigger pull it does deliver a barrage of all types of Barrymore Munitions finest choices. Uses Mortar Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 舷炮是贝里莫尔弹药自己对机甲迫击炮的演绎，每次扣扳机可发射10发炮弹，能呈上一轮由贝里莫尔各类精良弹药构成的弹幕。 < 使用迫击炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medium-Range Missile Launcher was designed by scientists at Luthien Armor Works. MRMs are dead-fire missiles that are fired more like lasers than missiles. In order to pack as many missiles as possible into one salvo, scientists removed guidance systems and made the whole package smaller. Though this was seen as a step backwards in technological development, the inexpensive and deadly MRMs have spread throughout the Draconis Combine and to many mercenary units. Uses MRM Ammo. 5 Salvos VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中程导弹发射器由卢西恩装甲厂的科学家设计。MRM是一种无制导导弹，发射方式更像激光而非导弹。为了把尽可能多的导弹塞进一轮齐射，科学家们拆掉了制导系统，让整个组件更小。虽然这被视为技术发展上的一次倒退，但廉价而致命的MRM已遍布龙尼斯联合体和许多雇佣兵部队。 < 使用MRM弹药。 5轮齐射 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't wanna know what Moonshine was responsible for this. Someone hotwired a Clan and Standard Plasma Cannon together, but on a single feeding system. On the upside, this spreads the Plasma reaction all over its impact area. On the other hand, it probably explodes. Uses Plasma Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不想追问这是哪家的私酒惹的祸。有人把一门氏族等离子炮和一门标准等离子炮硬接在一起，却共用一套供弹系统。好处是，这会把等离子反应散布到整个命中区域。坏处是，它很可能会爆炸。 使用等离子弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unique Plasma Cannon (P): Increased Target Heat Generated
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 独特等离子炮(海盗): 增加目标的热量生成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unlike later variants using cartridges with excitable Matter draws this Plasma Cannon entirely upon the Mech's Fusion Core creating a more powerfull Plasma exhaust with less of a kinetic punchVOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与后来使用兴奋物质弹筒的变体不同，这门等离子炮完全依赖机甲的聚变核心，产生更强大的等离子尾流，而动能打击较弱易爆！
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Said to have been designed in outmost secret by Clan Wolverine as their alternative take on improving the classical Inner Sphere PPC. Bringing the miniaturization knowledge of the Clans to the extreme, the Compact PPC reduces the size of the weapon's internal components to the very limit of what the circuitry can withstand before failing due to the increased heat generation and lack of separation. The main downsides of the design is its reduced range, increased recoil and high heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据说这是狼獾部族在极度机密中设计的，作为他们对改良经典内层星域粒子炮的另一条路径。它将部族的微型化知识推向极致，把武器内部部件的尺寸压缩到电路所能承受的极限——再进一步就会因热量增加与隔离不足而失效。该设计的主要缺点是射程缩短、后坐力增加、热量偏高。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype of an improved rotary PPC, based on the original Yin model. Using more exotic materials and advanced circuitry the weapons is both lighter and smaller than the original, yet performs considerably better.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种改进型旋转PPC的原型，以原始的阴模型为基础。使用更奇特的材料与先进电路，这件武器比原版更轻更小，性能却显著更好。
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Disabled FI reduces Range, fires with an AoE Impact but a 25% Chance to Misfire. Mitigated by Jam Reduction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 禁用FI会降低射程，以范围伤害方式开火，但有 25% 概率走火. 受卡壳减免影响.
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's a PPC designed for a small spacecraft. The EMP Field is generates is massive, affecting units near the target, disrupting myomer and sensor systems. It's hard to focus it on nearby targets due to the large minimum range in safe mode. FIOFF Has no minimum range penalty and does full damage at close range, but is very likely to fry the weapon. Boosted Mode greatly increases damage, but has distance falloff and requires a recharge period.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一门为小型航天器设计的PPC。它产生的电磁脉冲场极为庞大，会影响目标附近的单位，扰乱肌纤维与传感器系统。在安全模式下，由于最小射程过大，很难把它聚焦到附近目标上。 < FIOFF无最小射程惩罚，在近距离造成全额伤害，但极可能烧毁武器。 增压模式大幅提升伤害，但有距离衰减并需要一段充能时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rocket Launchers are cheap, unguided, one-shot missile launchers. Someone took these warheads and replaced their payload with Inferno Gel. Smokey's Special has 3 salvos. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火箭发射器廉价、无制导、一次性使用。有人把这些弹头换成了燃烧凝胶。"烟鬼特调"有 3 轮齐射。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom developed Quad Streak SRM-2 launcher only seen on the Rattler BattleMech. The system allows selecting between 2 and 8 missiles launched per fire sequence, with all missiles sharing the same target lock information.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一种定制研发的四联连发SRM-2发射器，只见于响尾蛇战斗机甲。该系统可在每次发射序列中选择发射2至8枚导弹，所有导弹共享同一套目标锁定信息。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unique Sword was designed to cleave an target being charged by this Templar.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这把独特的剑专为劈开被这台圣殿骑士冲锋撞击的目标而设计。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 另一项星际联盟科技复原成果，这款目标捕获装置(TAG)结合了多个主动扫描系统，功能如同机甲大小的激光指示器，并能与小队共享目标信息.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Anti-Missile System is used to destroy missiles before they strike their target. This is accomplished by using a short ranged rapid firing weapon which shoots at the missiles. Uses AMS Ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Some sort of savant made this; although clearly they had more engineering sense than the common sort. This is two light machinegun arrays forced into an AMS gimbal and hardwired to a sophisticated auto-tracking radar. Uses LMG Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 某个天才造出了这东西；显然他们的工程头脑胜过常人。这是把两组轻型机枪阵列硬塞进一个反导弹系统万向架，并硬接到一套精密的自动追踪雷达上。 使用轻型机枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Laser Anti-Missile System (LAMS) is an advanced variation of the standard Anti-Missile Systems. While the standard system utilizes a machine gun linked to specialized tracking systems, the LAMS uses a Small Pulse Laser, ensuring that the system never runs out of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导弹系统（LAMS）是标准反导弹系统的一种先进改型. 标准系统使用与专用跟踪系统相连的机枪，而LAMS则使用小型脉冲激光，确保该系统永远不会耗尽弹药.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Laser Anti-Missile System (LAMS) is an advanced variation of the standard Anti-Missile Systems. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导弹系统（LAMS）是标准反导弹系统的一种先进改型. 标准系统使用与专用跟踪系统相连的机枪，而LAMS则使用小型脉冲激光，确保该系统永远不会耗尽弹药.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: LAMS Fires 50 Shots at Every Missile Attack in Range
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导系统对射程内每次导弹攻击发射 50 发

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Armor carries an Integrated Laser Anti Missile System, pocketing the mech with many smaller Pulse Lasers to grant improved interception.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种装甲集成了一套激光反导系统，在机甲上密布许多较小的脉冲激光以提升拦截能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: LAMS Fires 16 Shots Every Missile Attack in Range
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光反导弹系统对射程内每次导弹攻击发射16发

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On the plus side, they managed to get about four times as much power as expected to the laser diodes, which really helps with tough missiles. On the down side, they did it by bypassing the shutoff sequence entirely, so the only way to stop supplying power is to hope the heat cooks the control board in just the right way. So ask yourself. Are you feeling lucky?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的一面是，他们成功让激光二极管获得了约四倍于预期的功率，这对付硬皮导弹确实很有帮助。坏的一面是，他们靠完全绕过关断序列做到这一点，所以停止供电的唯一办法就是祈祷热量以恰到好处的方式烧掉控制板。那么问问自己吧。你今天运气好吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: AMS Fires 60 Shots Every Missile Attack in Range
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AMS(反导系统)对射程内的每次导弹攻击发射 60 发拦截弹

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Anti-Missile System is used to destroy missiles before they strike their target. The Blankenburg Technologies MacArthur II offers increased protection through an extremely sophisticated targeting system enabling it to track any and all incoming Missiles. Uses AMS Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反导弹系统用于在导弹命中目标之前将其摧毁。布兰肯堡技术的麦克阿瑟II通过一套极其精密的瞄准系统提供更强的防护，使其能追踪任何及所有来袭导弹。 使用AMS弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arrow IV is a stand-alone, missile based, artillery system, designed to augment conventional systems such as the Long Tom and the Sniper. It was first introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2600 and became a staple of the Star League Defense Force. Although the technology to create Arrow IVs was lost during the Star League's collapse, it was recovered by Capellan Confederation engineers in 3044 working off of surviving examples and the Helm Memory Core. Uses ArrowIV Ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 箭IV是一种独立的导弹式火炮系统，用于增强长汤姆、狙击炮这类常规系统。它由地球霸权于2600年首次推出，随后成为星际联盟国防军的常备装备。虽然制造箭IV的技术在星际联盟崩溃期间失传，但卡佩兰联邦的工程师在3044年依据幸存样品和地狱记忆核心将其重新掌握。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The smallest of the Cruise Missile family developed by the Federated Suns in the 3060s, the CM/50 is nonetheless an utterly devastating weapon of war. The CM/50 is a truly massive missile and its payload is perfectly capable of annihilating smaller 'Mechs in a single shot as well as devastate stationary targets. However, the weapon's immense bulk and absurd ammo weight requirements limited its ability to be fielded and as of now only a single combat unit is capable of fielding the CM/50, the Kalki Cruise Missile Launcher superheavy tank. Uses Cruise Missile/50 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联邦太阳在3060年代研发的巡航导弹家族中最小的一款，CM/50仍是一种彻底毁灭性的战争武器。CM/50是一枚真正巨大的导弹，其弹头完全有能力一击歼灭较小的机甲，也能摧毁固定目标。然而该武器庞大的体积与荒谬的弹药重量要求限制了它的部署能力，目前为止只有一种战斗单位能搭载CM/50，即卡尔基巡航导弹发射车超重型坦克。 < 使用巡航导弹/50弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yeah Boss, this is a Howitzer with a RAC Feeder, what do you want me to say? This is typical Pirate tech and I don't even want to know what they were taking when they came up with this! Uses Hellstorm Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是啊老大，这就是一门装了旋转自动炮供弹机的榴弹炮，你想让我说什么？这是典型的海盗技术，我甚至不想知道他们想出这东西时在嗑什么！ 使用地狱风暴弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fire Directly at line of sight targets at short range, minimum range 75.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在近距离直接向视线内目标开火，最小射程75。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Need to remind your Neighbor of the Noise? Chug some Budget over to the Rowdy Town over? Cant Afford a Fancy Long Tom? Look no Further we at Quicsell work hard to bring you finest in Weapons, Our Howitzer 2000 is based on well known Lyran designs coming straight from Terra! Uses Medium Rifle Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 需要提醒你的邻居什么叫噪音？想给闹腾的镇上送点预算过去？买不起昂贵的长汤姆？不用再找了，我们快销公司致力于为你带来最精良的武器，我们的榴弹炮2000基于众所周知的莱兰设计，直接从地球而来！ < 使用中型步枪弹药。
