Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Long Tom Artillery Piece is the largest conventional artillery piece designed by Armstrong Industries. It is the primary weapon of the LT-MOB-25 Mobile Long Tom Artillery vehicle, which is better known as the Mobile Long Tom. Uses LongTom Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长汤姆火炮是阿姆斯特朗工业设计的最大型常规火炮，是LT-MOB-25机动长汤姆炮车的武器，后者更常被称为机动长汤姆。 使用长汤姆弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Long Tom Artillery Cannon is a scaled down version of the Long Tom Artillery Piece designed for use as an on-board indirect fire weapon. Capable of being mounted on 'Mechs, combat vehicles, and AeroSpace Fighters, the Long Tom Cannon is a snub-nosed version of the artillery piece of the same name. Uses LongTom Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长汤姆火炮是长汤姆炮身的缩小版，设计用作机载间接火力武器。它能装到机甲、战斗车辆和航空战机上，是同名炮身的短鼻版本。 < 使用长汤姆弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sniper Rifle Artillery Piece is the smaller cousin to the Long Tom Artillery Piece designed by Armstrong Industries. As the second most-powerful tube artillery in the Inner Sphere, the Sniper can cripple or destroy most light and medium BattleMechs with a single hit. Uses Sniper Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狙击炮是 Armstrong 工业设计的“长汤姆”火炮的较小同门。作为内层星域第二强大的身管火炮，狙击炮只需一发命中就能重创甚至摧毁大多数轻型和中型战斗机甲。 使用狙击炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thumper Artillery Piece is the smallest conventional artillery piece with an effective range of 10.5 kilometers. While an effective Field Artillery weapon, the Thumper is perhaps best known for its use as the main gun on the SLDF's Thor Artillery Vehicle, as well as the Thor's knock-off the Thumper. Uses Thumper Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Thumper 火炮是最小的常规火炮，有效射程 10.5 公里。作为一款有效的野战炮兵武器，Thumper 最为人所知的用途或许是作为 SLDF 的 Thor 自行火炮的主炮，以及 Thor 的仿制品 Thumper。 使用 Thumper 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thumper Artillery Cannon is a scaled down version of the Thumper Artillery Piece capable of direct fire. When mounted on BattleMechs, combat vehicles, and AeroSpace Fighters, it provides artillery support at much closer ranges than its cousin. Essentially a snub-nosed version of the Thumper Artillery Piece, the Thumper Artillery Cannon fires a shell at an enemy location like an autocannon. Uses Thumper Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重锤火炮是重锤炮身的缩小版，能进行直射。当装到战斗机甲、战斗车辆和航空战机上时，它能在比其表亲近得多的距离上提供炮火支援。重锤火炮本质上是重锤炮身的短鼻版本，像自动炮一样朝敌方位置发射炮弹。 < 使用重锤弹药。

While an effective Field Artillery weapon, the Thumper is perhaps best known for its use as the main gun on the SLDF's Thor Artillery Vehicle, as well as the Thor's knock-off the Thumper. Uses Thumper Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Thumper 火炮是最小的常规火炮，有效射程 10.5 公里。作为一款有效的野战炮兵武器，Thumper 最为人所知的用途或许是作为 SLDF 的 Thor 自行火炮的主炮，以及 Thor 的仿制品 Thumper。 使用 Thumper 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderstorm is an experiment in using Thunderbolt missiles as artillery. It's unique rack system loads and launches a full ton of any size Thunderbolt Missile per volley. Uses TBOLT20, TBOLTM15, TBOLTM10, TBOLTM5 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷暴是把雷霆导弹当炮使用的实验。它独特的挂架系统每轮齐射可装载并发射整整一吨任意规格的雷霆导弹。 < 使用TBOLT20、TBOLTM15、TBOLTM10、TBOLTM5弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Advanced Tactical Missile system (ATM) was developed by Clan Coyote and allows its users to choose between three different types of ammunition. ATMs also include an integral Artemis IV Fire Control System. Uses ATM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高级战术导弹系统（ATM）由郊狼氏族开发，允许使用者选择三种不同弹药。ATM 还内置 Artemis IV 火控系统。 使用 ATM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most powerful and efficient weapons mounted in combat, AC/10s are known for their heavy damage and ability to stagger opponents. Like all Autocannon weaponry, AC/10s suffer from recoil effects in rapid-fire mode. Uses AC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自动炮 10 是战场上最强大、最高效的武器之一，以沉重伤害和击退对手的能力著称。与所有自动炮武器一样，AC/10 在速射模式下会受到后坐力影响。 使用 AC10 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: AutoCannon fires a Burst of 3 Projectiles

Early Clan ballistic weapons tech also benefited from advanced metallurgy and construction techniques that rendered these classics of warfare lighter and more compact. Firing bursts of smaller Caliber have Clan Engineers managed to enable it firing a reliable Rapid Fire too. Uses AC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 早期氏族弹道武器技术同样受益于先进冶金与制造工艺，这些工艺让这些战争经典变得更轻、更紧凑。通过发射较小口径的连发，氏族工程师还设法让它能可靠地进行速射。 < 使用AC10弹药。

Federated Autocannons, while posessing no rapid-fire mode, also lack the recoil issues of other, faster autocannons. Uses AC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战场上最强大高效的武器之一，AC/10以高伤害与击退对手的能力著称。联邦自动炮虽然没有速射模式，却也没有其他更快自动炮的后坐力问题。 使用AC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most powerful and efficient weapons mounted in combat, AC/10s are known for their heavy damage and ability to stagger opponents. Like all Autocannon weaponry, AC/10s suffer from recoil effects from continuous fire. Uses AC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战斗中最强大、最高效的武器之一，AC/10以沉重伤害和击退对手的能力著称。与所有自动炮武器一样，AC/10会因持续射击而受后坐力影响。 < 使用AC10弹药。
双发，10% 永久卡壳，+2 后坐力，-1 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Light Autocannon trade some range for a weight reduction of approximately 40%. This allows combat units to carry more weapons, ammunition, or armor, and still use the specialized autocannon rounds. The first Light AC were prototypes created by the NAIS during the Clan Invasion. They didn't see widespread production until after the NAIS was destroyed by the Word of Blake's assault on New Avalon. Uses AC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型自动炮以一定射程换取约40%的减重。这使战斗单位能携带更多武器、弹药或装甲，同时仍可使用特种自动炮弹。最早的轻型AC是部族入侵期间由NAIS打造的原型。直到NAIS被布莱克之词对新瓦隆的进攻摧毁之后，它们才实现广泛量产。 使用AC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: AutoCannon fires a Burst of 3 Projectiles

One of the most powerful and efficient weapons mounted in combat, AC/10s are known for their heavy damage and ability to stagger opponents. Mydron's burst-fire autocannons do not suffer the recoil typical of continuous use. Uses AC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战斗中最强大、最高效的武器之一，AC/10以沉重伤害和击退对手的能力著称。迈德隆的连发自动炮不会像持续射击那样产生典型的后坐力。 < 使用AC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Need something loud and nasty but cant afford Defiance Boomboxes? We at QuicSell got just the right thing, our Tech's worked hard to bring you this Top of the Line AutoCannon/10. SUPER LOW SAVINGS TO KEEP YOU LAND FREE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 需要点又响又凶的东西，却买不起反抗牌音箱？我们快销公司正好有合适的东西，我们的技师辛苦为你带来这款顶级自动炮/10。超级省钱，让你免于破产！
双发，10% 永久卡壳，+2 后坐力，-1 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended for use as supporting fire at very long range, AC/2s deal moderate damage with low heat and a large ammunition count per ton. Uses AC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为极远距离支援火力使用，AC/2 造成中等伤害、热量低、每吨弹药数量多。 使用 AC2 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: AutoCannon fires a Burst of 3 Projectiles

Early Clan ballistic weapons tech also benefited from advanced metallurgy and construction techniques that rendered these classics of warfare lighter and more compact. Firing bursts of smaller Caliber have Clan Engineers managed to enable it firing a reliable Rapid Fire too. Uses AC2 Ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This does Look like a pretty basic AC10 Class Weapon, but it fires a steady stream of Ultra Munitions. Uses UAC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来确实像一件相当基础的AC10级武器，但它会持续射出超速弹药。 < 使用UAC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hypervelocity Autocannon (HVAC) family of weapons is based on the Autocannon. While they have the same damage classes, they're capable of firing much further. However, in order to obtain the increased ballistic range, the hypervelocity ammo is larger and uses a unique type of propellant, reducing the number of shots per ton of ammo along with a couple other drawbacks, such as a chance of the weapon exploding, and a thick smoke trail every time the weapon is fired. Uses HVAC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超高速自动炮（HVAC）武器系列以自动炮为基础。虽然它们拥有相同的伤害等级，却能射得更远。然而，为了获得更高的弹道射程，超高速弹药更大，并使用一种独特的推进剂，这减少了每吨弹药的发射次数，也带来另外几项缺点，比如武器有爆炸几率，以及每次开火都会拖出一条浓重的烟迹。 < 使用HVAC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Lubalin Ballistics for the Terran Hegemony, the LB-X Autocannon was a derivative of the standard and relatively primitive Autocannon design. Taking advantage of advanced materials, the company was able to reduce the weight of the weapon for only a slight increase in bulk and mated it with the advanced Mercury-VII targeting system to boost its effective range. Uses LBX10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LB-X自动炮由卢巴林弹道公司为地球霸权研发，是标准且相对原始自动炮设计的衍生型。得益于先进材料，该公司得以在仅略微增加体积的情况下减轻武器重量，并将其与先进的墨丘利VII瞄准系统配对，以提升有效射程。 < 使用LBX10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Early Clan prototypes of the LB-X also underwent testing during Operation KLONDIKE. Though a little less effective and a little more bulky than their modern Inner Sphere-made equivalents, these autocannons paved the way for what became known as the Clan standard. Uses LBX10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LB-X的部族早期原型也在克朗代克行动期间接受过测试。虽然效能略低、体积略大于现代内层星域制造的同类，这些自动炮为后来被称为部族标准的东西铺平了道路。 使用LBX10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Autocannon LB 10-X-P is the prototype of what eventually became the normal LB 10-X. Developed to fill the need for a dual-purpose weapon capable of both powerful direct fire as well as anti-air fire, the LB 10-X-P utilizes two different ammunition types: traditional armor-piercing shells as well as flechette shells that proved as equally capable in anti-air roles as in anti-armor and anti-personnel roles. The SLDF debuted the prototype autocannon in time to participate in the final battles in both the Rim Worlds Republic and the Taurian Concordat, while those two nations fielded only a relative handful of prototypes before the end of the war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LB 10-X-P自动炮是最终成为标准LB 10-X的原型产品. 为满足既能进行强力直射又能进行防空的双重用途武器的需求而开发，LB 10-X-P使用两种不同的弹药类型: 传统的穿甲弹以及被证明在防空、反装甲和反人员角色上同样有效的飞镖弹. SLDF及时让这款原型自动炮在边缘世界共和国和金牛协约国的最终战斗中亮相，而这两个国家在战争结束前只部署了相对少数的原型机.

Taking advantage of advanced materials, the company was able to reduce the weight of the weapon for only a slight increase in bulk and mated it with the advanced Mercury-VII targeting system to boost its effective range. Uses LBX2 Ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced by Clan Blood Spirit in 3073, these Protomech sized Autocannons provide the punch of their bigger brothers but remain small enough to fit on protomechs. Uses Proto AC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些由血灵氏族在3073年推出的原型机甲尺寸自动炮，提供了其大块头兄弟的打击力，同时尺寸足够小，能装在原型机甲上。 使用原型AC2弹药。
双发，10% 永久卡壳，+2 后坐力，-1 精度

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rotary Autocannon is based only loosely on the Autocannon. While it has the same bore, it is capable of firing up to six times as many rounds as its standard cousin, allowing it to deal three times the damage of even an Ultra Autocannon. At the same time, each extra shot increases the amount of heat the autocannon builds and increases the chance for a jam. Uses RAC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旋转自动炮只是松散地以自动炮为基础。虽然口径相同，它能发射的弹数是其标准同类的六倍，使其造成的伤害甚至是超速自动炮的三倍。同时，每一发额外的射击都会增加自动炮积累的热量，也提高卡壳的几率。 使用RAC2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rotary Autocannon is based only loosely on the Autocannon. While it has the same bore, it is capable of firing up to six times as many rounds as its standard cousin, allowing it to deal three times the damage of even an Ultra Autocannon. At the same time, each extra shot increases the amount of heat the autocannon builds and increases the chance for a jam. The Clan Variant sports increased range at the cost of increased size. Uses RAC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旋转自动炮只是松散地基于自动炮。虽然口径相同，它却能发射标准同类多达六倍的弹药，造成的伤害甚至是超级自动炮的三倍。同时，每多发一次都会增加自动炮积累的热量，也提高卡壳几率。部族版本以更大体积换取更远射程。 使用RAC2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rotary Autocannon is based only loosely on the Autocannon. While it has the same bore, it is capable of firing up to six times as many rounds as its standard cousin, allowing it to deal three times the damage of even an Ultra Autocannon. At the same time, each extra shot increases the amount of heat the autocannon builds and increases the chance for a jam. Uses RAC5 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旋转自动炮只是松散地以自动炮为基础。虽然口径相同，它能发射的弹数是其标准同类的六倍，使其造成的伤害甚至是超速自动炮的三倍。同时，每一发额外的射击都会增加自动炮积累的热量，也提高卡壳的几率。 使用RAC5弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rotary Autocannon is based only loosely on the Autocannon. While it has the same bore, it is capable of firing up to six times as many rounds as its standard cousin, allowing it to deal three times the damage of even an Ultra Autocannon. At the same time, each extra shot increases the amount of heat the autocannon builds and increases the chance for a jam. Like Ultra autocannons, Rotary autocannons are unable to make use of special munitions. The Clan Variant sports increased range at the cost of increased size. Uses RAC5 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旋转自动炮只是在名义上借鉴了自动炮。虽然口径相同，它的射速却可达标准同类的六倍，能够造成甚至比超级自动炮高三倍的伤害。与此同时，每多发射一次都会增加自动炮积累的热量，并提高卡壳的几率。与超级自动炮一样，旋转自动炮无法使用特殊弹药。部族版本以增大体积为代价换取了更远的射程。 使用RAC5弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultra Autocannons boast double the rate of fire of a regular Autocannon, with only moderate increases in weight, size, and heat. The UAC/10 is your standard heavy gun, with all-around good damage, range, and heat efficiency. Uses UAC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超速自动炮的射速是普通自动炮的两倍，而重量、体积和热量只适度增加。UAC/10是你的标准重型火力，伤害、射程与热量效率全面均衡。 < 使用UAC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype versions of the Ultra Autocannon all saw limited use with the Clans during Operation KLONDIKE. As with the other weapons of this era, the final evolution of modern ''Clan-spec'' versions would not come until after the conquest of the Pentagon worlds and the dawn of the Golden Century. Uses UAC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超速自动炮的原型版本在克朗代克行动期间在氏族中仅有有限使用。与这一时代的其他武器一样，现代"氏族规格"版本的最终演化要等到五角星系被征服、黄金世纪来临之后才会出现。 < 使用UAC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most powerful and efficient weapons mounted in combat, AC/10s are known for their heavy damage and ability to stagger opponents. Like all Autocannon weaponry, AC/10s suffer from recoil effects in rapid-fire mode. Uses UAC10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战斗中最强大、最高效的武器之一，AC/10以沉重伤害和击退对手的能力著称。与所有自动炮武器一样，AC/10在速射模式下会受后坐力影响。 使用UAC10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultra Autocannons boast double the rate of fire of a regular Autocannon, with only moderate increases in weight, size, and heat. While the UAC/2 has the smallest bore of all UACs, it has unparalleled headhunting capability. Uses UAC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超级自动炮的射速是常规自动炮的两倍，而重量、体积与热量只有适度增加。虽然UAC/2在所有UAC中口径最小，却拥有无与伦比的爆头能力。 使用UAC2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype versions of the Ultra Autocannon all saw limited use with the Clans during Operation KLONDIKE. As with the other weapons of this era, the final evolution of modern ''Clan-spec'' versions would not come until after the conquest of the Pentagon worlds and the dawn of the Golden Century. Uses UAC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超速自动炮的原型版本在克朗代克行动期间在氏族中仅有有限使用。与这一时代的其他武器一样，现代"氏族规格"版本的最终演化要等到五角星系被征服、黄金世纪来临之后才会出现。 < 使用UAC2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended for use as supporting fire at very long range, AC/2s deal moderate damage with low heat and a large ammunition count per ton. Like all Autocannon weaponry, AC/2s suffer from recoil effects in rapid-fire mode. Uses UAC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AC/2意在作为极远距离上的支援火力，造成中等伤害、热量低，且每吨弹药量很大。与所有自动炮一样，AC/2在速射模式下会受后坐力影响。 使用UAC2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultra Autocannons boast double the rate of fire of a regular Autocannon, with only moderate increases in weight, size, and heat. The UAC/20 is one of the most fearsome weapons on the battlefield. Uses UAC20 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超速自动炮的射速是普通自动炮的两倍，而重量、体积和热量只适度增加。UAC/20是战场上最令人生畏的武器之一。 < 使用UAC20弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype versions of the Ultra Autocannon all saw limited use with the Clans during Operation KLONDIKE. As with the other weapons of this era, the final evolution of modern ''Clan-spec'' versions would not come until after the conquest of the Pentagon worlds and the dawn of the Golden Century. Uses UAC20 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超级自动炮的原型版本在克朗代克行动期间都曾被部族有限使用。与这一时期的其他武器一样，现代“部族规格”版本的最终形态直到征服五角世界、黄金世纪开始之后才出现。 使用UAC20弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The king of the battlefield in terms of raw damage, AC/20s hit harder than any other weapon. However, this comes at the expense of weight, range, and severely limited ammunition. Like all Autocannon weaponry, AC/20s suffer from recoil effects in rapid-fire mode. Uses UAC20 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就纯粹伤害而言，AC/20是战场之王，打击力超过任何其他武器。但代价是重量、射程与严重受限的弹药量。与所有自动炮一样，AC/20在速射模式下会受后坐力影响。 使用UAC20弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultra Autocannons boast double the rate of fire of a regular Autocannon, with only moderate increases in weight, size, and heat. The UAC/5 is a reliable long range weapon. Uses UAC5 Ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a battle armor sized 'Fluid Gun' that spews acid at close range. Boss, I have no idea where the acid is actually coming from.  My crew hasn't been replacing any tanks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件战斗装甲尺寸的“流体枪”，在近距喷射酸液。老板，我完全不知道那酸液到底是从哪来的——我的团队可没换过任何储罐。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is coated with corrosive Acid. It will take 30% increased Damage. Can stack. 2 Turn Duration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被腐蚀性强酸覆盖，将承受 30% 额外伤害，效果可叠加，持续 2 回合.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Battle Armor Point Defense System, allowing to intercept nearby enemy Missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲近程防御系统，可拦截附近的敌方导弹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bomb Rack is a piece of battle armor equipment first produced by Clan Cloud Cobra for their Sylph armor in 3060. Considered an oddity, the one-shot weapon is nevertheless quite dangerous in its ability to drop cluster munitions on ground targets. The weapon can only be mounted on battle armor with VTOL capability, and thus far has no Inner Sphere counterpart.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炸弹架是一种战斗装甲装备，最初由云眼镜蛇氏族于3060年为其风精装甲生产。这件单发武器被视为奇物，但它在向地面目标投掷集束弹药的能力上相当危险。该武器只能装在具备VTOL能力的战斗装甲上，目前还没有内天体的对应型号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The cutting torch mounted on a typical exoskeleton is an enhanced version of the same technology used by technicians and engineers for more than a millennium. Simply described, the torch is a highly adaptable energy-based cutting tool, which can also be used to weld metal parts together or cut through even the advanced aerospace and battlefield materials used today. However, the time this item requires to do its work properly, coupled with its extremely short range, makes the cutting torch an ineffective combat weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安装在典型外骨骼上的切割炬，是技师和工程师已使用超过千年的同一技术的增强版. 简而言之，切割炬是一种高度通用的能量切割工具，也可用于焊接金属部件或切割包括现今使用的先进航空航天和战场材料. 然而，该工具正常工作所需的时间，加上其极短的射程，使得切割炬无法作为有效的战斗武器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This compact NARC launcher fires a single beacon that attaches itself to the enemy and emits a homing signal for all friendly missiles. Uses BA NARC ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Also known as flechette weapons, needler weapons (or simply needlers) are typically useless on the battlefield, specifically against battlesuits and other armored units. Essentially a projectile weapon that uses a block of treated polymer for ammunition, a needler sprays a shotgun-like cloud of shredded plastic, intended to rip through lighter personal armor and bare flesh. While devastatingly effective in close-quarters, anti-personnel situations, the typical needler lacks the range and the armor penetration to be of much use beyond crowd control or spacecraft boarding missions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 针刺武器（又称飞镖武器）通常被视为战场上的鸡肋，尤其是面对战斗服及其他装甲单位时. 究其本质，这是一种采用经处理聚合物块作为弹药的投射武器，能喷射出类似霰弹枪的碎塑料弹幕，旨在撕开轻型单兵护甲和裸露的肉体. 尽管在近身反人员场合具有毁灭性的杀伤效果，但典型的针刺武器缺乏足够射程与穿甲能力，因此除了人群控制和飞船登舰任务外，其用途十分有限.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Battle Armor Plasma Rifle, carrying 20 shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲等离子步枪，携带20发弹药.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a rare weapon indeed, a Pop-Up Mine designed for mounting on the Sloth Battle Armor suit. The first quad battle armor, the Sloth was designed to carry this mine into combat and deploy it while directly beneath the target mech. The mine would then pop up and penetrate the armor from below, dealing direct structure damage. The BA-scale Pop-Up Mine was only ever deployed on the Sloth and fell out of favor along with the Sloth as technology advanced and suits became more complex.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这确实是一种稀有武器，一种设计用于安装在Sloth战斗装甲服上的弹出式地雷. 作为第一种四足战斗装甲，Sloth被设计用于携带这种地雷进入战斗，并在目标机甲正下方部署. 地雷随后会弹出并从下方穿透装甲，造成直接结构损伤. 战斗装甲级别的弹出式地雷仅曾在Sloth上部署，随着技术进步和装甲服变得更为复杂，它与Sloth一同失宠.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Satchel Charges are powerful explosive devices that have to be placed on its target by hand. The resulting explosion is not very large, but is specially designed to penetrate thick armor. Due to its shape and having to be placed manually, it is quite slow to arm and requires a flexible manipulator to be handled. Can fail to fire if placed misaligned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炸药包是一种威力强大的爆炸装置，必须手动安放于目标之上. 其造成的爆炸范围并不很大，但经过特殊设计，能够穿透厚重的装甲. 由于其形状特殊且需人工安置，引信准备过程相当缓慢，同时需要灵活的机械手臂才能操作. 若安放位置不正，可能导致引爆失败.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Flamer weapons are unique in that they deal little physical damage but instead expel superheated plasma, applying substantial heat to their target. When done properly, this can hamper enemy return fire or even cause the targeted unit to shut down from overheating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火焰喷射器武器独特之处在于它们造成的物理伤害很少，而是喷出过热等离子，给目标施加大量热量。运用得当可削弱敌方还击，甚至让目标单位因过热而停机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extended Range Flamer (or ER Flamer) is a longer-range, weaker version of the fusion-based Flamer. First developed by Clan Jade Falcon and introduced to the Inner Sphere by the Federated Suns, the Extended Range Flamer uses tighter magnetic coils and a narrower muzzle diameter to increase the weapon's range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增程火焰喷射器（ER火焰喷射器）是基于聚变的火焰喷射器的更远射程、更弱版本。它最初由玉猫部族研制，并由联邦太阳国引入内层星域；增程火焰喷射器采用更紧密的磁线圈与更窄的炮口直径来提升射程。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vehicle Flamer performs the same as a 'Mech-mounted Flamer, venting superheated gases at a target to cause it to overheat/burn up. As most non-'Mech combat units lack expensive fusion reactors do Vehicle Flamers draw from a pool of combusting ''ammunition'' instead. Uses Vehicle Flamer Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车辆火焰喷射器的表现与机甲搭载的火焰喷射器相同，都是向目标喷出过热气体使其过热或烧毁。由于大多数非机甲战斗单位没有昂贵的聚变反应堆，车辆火焰喷射器改为消耗燃烧性“弹药”。使用车辆火焰喷射器弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Flamer was developed by Clan Jade Falcon after encountering large infantry formations during Operation Revival. The Lyran Alliance captured several and was able to reverse engineer them and put it into production one year later. Heavier, yet smaller then the old Vehicle Heavy Flamer, does it provide minor improvements at range and against overheating targets. Uses Heavy Flamer Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型火焰喷射器由玉猫部族在“复兴行动”期间遭遇大规模步兵编队后研制。莱兰联盟缴获了若干具并成功逆向仿制，一年后投入生产。它比旧式车载重型火焰喷射器更重却更小，在射程与对付过热目标方面提供了轻微改进。 使用重型火焰喷射器弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Flamer weapons are unique in that they deal little physical damage but instead expel superheated plasma, applying substantial heat to their target. When done properly, this can hamper enemy return fire or even cause the targeted unit to shut down from overheating.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vehicle Flamer performs the same as a 'Mech-mounted Flamer, venting superheated gases at a target to cause it to overheat/burn up. As most non-'Mech combat units lack expensive fusion reactors do Vehicle Flamers draw from a pool of combusting ''ammunition'' instead. Uses Vehicle Flamer Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车辆火焰喷射器的表现与机甲搭载的火焰喷射器相同，都是向目标喷出过热气体使其过热或烧毁。由于大多数非机甲战斗单位没有昂贵的聚变反应堆，车辆火焰喷射器改为消耗燃烧性“弹药”。使用车辆火焰喷射器弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fluid Gun is nothing more than a militarized Fluid Sprayer system. By toughening the feed lines and storage tanks, the engineers of Solaris VII created a system roughly equivalent to a Flamer. Unlike the flamer however, the Fluid Gun can store and spray a variety of fluid types. Clever arena fighters have used water, oil slicks, Inferno Fuel, Cooling Fluid, and Corrosive Fluids in matches. Uses Fluid Canisters (Ammo).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 流体炮不过是军用化的流体喷洒系统。通过加固供料管线与储罐，索拉里斯VII的工程师造出一套大致相当于火焰喷射器的系统。不过与火焰喷射器不同，流体炮能储存并喷洒多种流体。聪明的竞技场斗士在比赛中用过水、油膜、地狱火燃料、冷却液和腐蚀性流体。 < 使用流体罐（弹药）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle is a variation on the Gauss Rifle developed by Clan Hell's Horses. Hoping to stay ahead of the increasing technological curve, they used similar design principles to the Heavy Gauss Rifle, however, Horse scientists used a series of capacitors and launching tubes to fire a multitude of smaller-caliber slugs. Uses Hyper Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超强突击高斯步枪是地狱之马部族开发的高斯步枪变体。为了在不断提升的技术水平上保持领先，他们采用了与重型高斯步枪类似的设计原理，不过地狱之马的科学家用一系列电容器和发射管来射出大量小口径弹丸。 使用超级高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle is a variation on the Gauss Rifle developed by Clan Hell's Horses. Hoping to stay ahead of the increasing technological curve, they used similar design principles to the Heavy Gauss Rifle, however, Horse scientists used a series of capacitors and launching tubes to fire a multitude of smaller-caliber slugs. Uses Hyper Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超强突击高斯步枪是地狱之马部族开发的高斯步枪变体。为了在不断提升的技术水平上保持领先，他们采用了与重型高斯步枪类似的设计原理，不过地狱之马的科学家用一系列电容器和发射管来射出大量小口径弹丸。 使用超级高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gauss Rifle HA30 (C): Anti Air Factor
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HA30高斯步枪(氏族): 防空系数

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle is a variation on the Gauss Rifle developed by Clan Hell's Horses. Hoping to stay ahead of the increasing technological curve, they used similar design principles to the Heavy Gauss Rifle, however, Horse scientists used a series of capacitors and launching tubes to fire a multitude of smaller-caliber slugs. Uses Hyper Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HA40高斯步枪(氏族): 防空系数

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech sized version of the Infantry MagShot Gauss Rifle Prototype for testing in the sands of Solaris as an alternative to Medium Laser arrays. Uses MagShot Ammo.. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是步兵麦格射击磁轨步枪原型机的机甲尺寸版本，在索拉里斯的沙地上测试，作为中型激光阵列的替代方案。使用麦格射击弹药。。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle is a scaled-down Gauss Rifle meant for work against conventional infantry and battle armor. The AP Gauss Rifle Battery is a total of four AP Gauss Rifles slaved together to unleash a tidal wave of flachettes into an opponent while removing the redundant bulk and fire control burden of four individual weapons. Uses MagShot Ammo.. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反人员磁轨炮是缩小的磁轨炮，用于对付常规步兵与战斗装甲。反人员磁轨炮组是四门反人员磁轨炮联动在一起，向对手释放一片飞镖洪流，同时去掉了四件独立武器的冗余体积与火控负担。使用麦格射击弹药。。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Clan Jade Falcon, the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle is a scaled-down Gauss Rifle meant for work against conventional infantry and battle armor. Uses Magshot Ammo.. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反人员磁轨炮由翡翠猎鹰氏族研发，是一种缩小版磁轨炮，用于对付常规步兵与战斗装甲。使用麦格射击弹药。。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cannon fires 5 separate shots with bonus accuracy and damage against squads
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 加农炮发射 5 发独立弹丸，对抗小队单位时获得精度与伤害加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'MagShot Cannon' is based upon the technologies of AP MagShot Gauss Rifles for BattleMechs and the Free Worlds League Light Gauss Rifle has Johnston Industries Managed to create a Ultra Light Weight Gauss Rifle. Unusually it uses standard magshot ammo, but launches a ''stack'' of five slugs remain together in flight, separate projectiles all hitting the same place resist some types of reactive armor. An alternate ''burst mode'' fires five slugs individually machine gun style. Fires 5 Rounds Per Shot. Uses Magshot Ammo.. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这门"麦格射击炮"基于战斗机甲用反人员麦格射击磁轨步枪以及自由世界联盟轻型磁轨炮的技术，约翰斯顿工业成功造出一种超轻重量的磁轨炮。不同寻常的是，它使用标准麦格射击弹药，但发射的是一"叠"五枚弹丸在飞行中保持在一起，分离的弹丸全部命中同一位置，能抵抗某些类型的反应装甲。另一种"点射模式"则以机枪方式逐发发射五枚弹丸。每次射击发射5发。使用麦格射击弹药。。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Gauss Rifle uses electromagnetic charges to accelerate metallic rounds at extremely high speed, dealing massive damage by kinetic force alone. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高斯步枪利用电磁电荷把金属弹丸加速到极高速度，仅凭动能就造成巨大伤害。 使用高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Gauss Rifle uses electromagnetic charges to accelerate metallic rounds at extremely high speed, dealing massive damage by kinetic force alone. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高斯步枪利用电磁电荷把金属弹丸加速到极高速度，仅凭动能就造成巨大伤害。 使用高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan technology would scarcely improve the performance of the standard Gauss rifle beyond its Star League-era glory, but the improved version nevertheless demonstrated how Kerensky’s disciples proceeded along that path. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技几乎无法在星盟时代的荣光之上再提升标准磁轨炮的性能，但改进版仍然展示了克伦斯基的追随者们是如何沿着那条路走下去的。 < 使用磁轨炮弹药。 < 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Gauss Rifle uses electromagnetic charges to accelerate metallic rounds at extremely high speed, dealing massive damage by kinetic force alone. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁轨炮利用电磁电荷将金属弹丸以极高速度加速，仅凭动能就能造成巨大伤害。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Gauss Rifle is a new, deadly innovation by Lyran Alliance scientists in conjunction with a manufacturing cooperation between Defiance Industries and TharHes. Applying their ''bigger is better'' philosophy to Gauss technology, the Heavy Gauss Rifle is one of the heaviest battlefield weapons in existence. Uses Heavy Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型磁轨炮是莱兰联盟科学家与反抗工业和塔尔赫斯制造合作的一项新的致命创新。他们把自己的"越大越好"哲学应用到磁轨技术上，重型磁轨炮是现存最重的战场武器之一。 < 使用重型磁轨炮弹药。 < 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though the Heavy Gauss Rifle was mostly effective, engineers thought they could improve the ballistic performance of the projectile. This would lead to a more consistent damage profile, making the Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle effective at all ranges. After four years of work, the engineers had created a weapon that occupied the same amount of space as the Heavy Gauss Rifle but was able to inflict consistent damage at all ranges. Uses Heavy Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然重型高斯步枪大体上有效，工程师们认为还能改进弹丸的弹道性能，从而获得更稳定的伤害曲线，让改进型重型高斯步枪在所有距离上都有效。经过四年工作，工程师造出了一款占用空间与重型高斯步枪相同、却能在所有距离上造成稳定伤害的武器。 使用重型高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Improved HGR: Increased Self Instability on Fire
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 改进型HGR: 开火时自身不稳定性增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Light Gauss Rifle was introduced by the Free Worlds League. It functions identically to a Gauss Rifle, electromagnetically accelerating a slug to high speeds to cause massive damage at long range. As its name suggests, however, the Light Gauss Rifle is designed to be more compact, allowing Gauss Rifles to be mounted on smaller combat units. Uses Light Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型磁轨炮由自由世界联盟推出。它的工作原理与磁轨炮完全相同，以电磁方式将弹丸加速到高速，在远距离造成巨大伤害。但正如其名，轻型磁轨炮被设计得更紧凑，使磁轨炮能装在更小的战斗单位上。 < 使用轻型磁轨炮弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The NAIS developed the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle (or SB Gauss) in an attempt to bring the functionality of an LB-X Autocannon to the Gauss Rifle. Though the cluster-like ammunition made it easier to hit a target and was particularly effective in the anti-aircraft role, gave them a unreliable damage profile. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: NAIS研制银弹高斯步枪（即SB高斯），试图把LB-X自动炮的功能带到高斯步枪上。虽然类似集束弹的弹药让命中目标更容易，在防空角色上尤其有效，却也带来了不可靠的伤害曲线。 使用高斯弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Bolter' seems to be a development similar to the AutoCannon but trading weight for range. Uses RAC2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种“爆弹”似乎是类似自动炮的发展型，用重量换取了射程。 使用RAC2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While it seems to be similar to a Thunderbolt Missile this missile carries a sophisticated Shaped-Charge Warhead with advanced guidance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然它看起来与雷霆导弹相似，这枚导弹携带的是精密成型装药战斗部，带先进制导。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Direct Fire in Streak mode with Artemis Grouping.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以连续模式配合 Artemis 集束进行直接射击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Improved Advanced Tactical Missile system (iATM) was developed by The Society. Like the Advanced Tactical Missile that it's based on, the iATM system uses a variety of ammunition types and includes an advanced targeting option. Unlike the ATM, the iATM uses a Streak SRM style guidance system to improve accuracy. Uses iATM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 改进型先进战术导弹系统（iATM）由“学会”研制。与其基础的先进战术导弹一样，iATM系统可使用多种弹药，并附带先进的瞄准选项。与ATM不同的是，iATM采用连发SRM式制导系统以提高精度。 使用iATM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Direct Fire in Streak mode with Artemis Grouping.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以连续模式配合 Artemis 集束进行直接射击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Improved Advanced Tactical Missile system (iATM) was developed by The Society. Like the Advanced Tactical Missile that it's based on, the iATM system uses a variety of ammunition types and includes an advanced targeting option. Uses iATM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 改进型高级战术导弹系统（iATM）由协会研发。与它所基于的高级战术导弹一样，iATM系统使用多种弹药类型，并包含一个高级瞄准选项。 使用iATM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Direct Fire in Streak mode with Artemis Grouping.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以连续模式配合 Artemis 集束进行直接射击。

Like the Advanced Tactical Missile that it's based on, the iATM system uses a variety of ammunition types and includes an advanced targeting option. Unlike the ATM, the iATM uses a Streak SRM style guidance system to improve accuracy. Uses iATM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 改进型先进战术导弹系统（iATM）由“学会”研制。与其基础的先进战术导弹一样，iATM系统可使用多种弹药，并附带先进的瞄准选项。与ATM不同的是，iATM采用连发SRM式制导系统以提高精度。 使用iATM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Agricultural 'Mechs use arm-mounted Chainsaws to fell trees and harvest timber. In an emergency these giant saws can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons, Chainsaws suffer a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 农业机甲使用手臂安装的链锯伐树和采伐木材。紧急情况下，这些巨型锯子也可用于机甲近战。与所有工业武器一样，链锯有轻微的固有命中惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Combines are agricultural equipment using rotating blades to thresh grain crops. Built from sturdy materials for durability, they're rarely used in combat, usually mounted on AgroMechs or farming vehicles only out of desperation, since they inflict negligible damage against armored units. Against unarmored infantry, however, a combine isn't desperation but cruelty, capable of shredding soft targets in seconds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收割机是使用旋转刀片脱粒谷物的农业设备。它由坚固材料制成以求耐用，很少用于战斗，通常只因绝望才装在农用机甲或农用车辆上，因为它对装甲单位的伤害微不足道。然而面对无装甲步兵，收割机就无关绝望而是残忍了，能在数秒内把软目标撕成碎条。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common tool used for urban construction and industrial demolitions, the dual saw is a more powerful variation on the chainsaw that typically uses twin high-speed ferro-carbide circular blades or a scissoring set of oblong vibro-blades instead of a monoblade, chain-fed cutter. Designed with hard objects in mind, such as industrial steels and pavement, the dual saw—by its very design—happens to be fairly effective against armored units as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双锯是城市建筑与工业拆除中常用的工具，是链锯的更强力变体，通常采用双高速碳化铁圆锯片，或一副剪刀式的长方形振动刀片，而非单片链式刀具。它是为硬物（如工业钢材与路面）设计的，而正因这种设计，双锯对付装甲单位也相当有效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hydraulic-assisted impact hammer scaled for IndustrialMech frames. Delivers measured, repeatable strike force suitable for foundation work, demolition, and deep rock fracturing. Built to run shift after shift without maintenance windows.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一种按工业机甲骨架比例设计、带液压助力的冲击锤。可输出精确可控、可重复的打击力，适用于地基施工、拆除作业以及深层岩石破碎。其设计可承受连续轮班作业，无需安排维护间歇。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mining 'Mechs use arm-mounted Drills to excavate tunnels and extract ore. In an emergency, these heavy-duty drills can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons the Mining Drill suffers a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 采矿机甲使用安装在手臂上的钻头挖掘隧道、开采矿石。紧急情况下，这些重型钻头也能用来近战攻击机甲。与所有工业武器一样，采矿钻头在命中判定上带有轻微的固有惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rivet guns, popularized by Sheridan Constructs' SC-M \"Powerjoin\" series, drive white-hot rivets at high speed through construction materials. Ineffective against BattleMech armor, they can pierce personal body armor and cause serious foreign-object damage to stripped armor sections. Against a 'Mech that has lost all armor in a location, the rivets can punch through to damage internal components directly. Desperate pilots have used them for crowd control, capable of horribly maiming or killing unprotected personnel by the dozens.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铆钉枪由谢里丹构造的SC-M"强力连接"系列普及，能以高速把白热铆钉钉入建材中。它对战斗机甲装甲无效，却能穿透个人护甲，并对已剥去装甲的部位造成严重异物损伤。对某个部位装甲已全失的机甲，铆钉能直接穿透杀伤内部组件。绝望的飞行员曾用它控制人群，能残忍地致残或杀死成打的无防护人员。
里韦托 XL 超级2000 豪华版

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rock-cutters, used in mining and demolition, feature tempered alloy chains studded with diamond-hard cutting heads, resembling an oversized chainsaw. Built to cut through rock and ferrocrete, it generates notable heat from its motors. Though capable of harming armored units, its bulk makes it clumsy to wield, so it rarely appears in combat outside Solaris circuits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于采矿与拆毁的切石机配有用淬火合金制成、嵌满金刚硬质切削头的链条，形似一台超大型链锯。它专为切穿岩石与铁凝土而造，电机运转时会产生显著热量。虽然能伤害装甲单位，但其笨重难以驾驭，因此除索拉里斯巡回赛外很少出现在战斗中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Industrial-scale welders existed since the 20th century, but vehicular use only became viable with IndustrialMech technology. Modern spot welders are advanced adaptations, drawing power from the carrying unit rather than fuel cells to generate heat for melting alloys. Energy use and waste heat match a military-grade small laser, requiring power amplifiers and heat sinks. In combat, the high-heat arc can serve as a potent physical attack, damaging targets more like a contact laser than a standard punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工业级焊机自20世纪便已存在，但直到工业机甲技术出现，车载应用才变得可行。现代点焊机是先进的改良产物，由承载机体而非燃料电池供电，以产生熔化合金所需的热量。其能耗与废热相当于军用级小型激光器，因此需要动力放大器和散热器。战斗中，高温电弧可作为强力的物理攻击手段，其伤害方式更接近接触式激光而非普通拳击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Sprayer is simply a hose and pump system that sprays liquids at a target. Normally only used on IndustrialMechs, it has limited useage in combat beyond being a very short range crowd control system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 喷洒器不过是一套软管与泵系统，向目标喷洒液体。它通常只用于工业机甲，在战斗中除了作为极短程的人群控制手段之外用途有限。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wrecking Ball is a piece of construction equipment that is rarely seen on the battlefield. Instead the Wrecking Ball is usually found on IndustrialMechs and support vehicles that are used for demolition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破坏球是一种建筑施工设备，在战场上极少见. 相反，破坏球通常被安装在用于拆除作业的工业机甲和支援车辆上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Chemical Laser seems to have been designed to push out an intense blast with a very short duration enabling it to punch through Armor similar to a Gauss Rifle. Uses Chem Large Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种化学激光器似乎被设计为发射一次持续时间极短的高强度冲击，使其能像磁轨炮一样击穿装甲。 < 使用化学大型弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laser fires 1 Shot with 40 Damage, No Falloff
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 激光器发射1发，伤害40，无衰减

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Binary Lasers (nicknamed 'Blazers') fused two Large Laser cores together, allowing them to be fired together. While this increased penetration and range the beam cohesion suffered. Alternately the cores could be discharged separately, functioning much like individual Large Lasers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 二元激光器（绰号"聚焦激光"）把两个大型激光核心熔接在一起，使其能同时发射。虽然这提升了穿透力与射程，光束的凝聚性却受到了影响。两个核心也可以分别放电，其功能与单独的大型激光器大致相同
激光器以标准模式开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The light blazer is a compact, overdriven energy weapon that sacrifices stability for aggression. Unlike the standard blazer, or Binary Laser, which channels twin beams into a single devastating strike, the light variant delivers quicker, more volatile bursts. It runs hotter and shorter-ranged, favoring relentless close assault over the Binary Laser’s disciplined, annihilating precision.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型聚焦激光是一种紧凑、超频的能量武器，牺牲稳定性换取攻击性。与标准聚焦激光（即二元激光器）把双束光汇成一次毁灭性打击不同，轻型版本发射更快、更不稳定的脉冲。它更热、射程更短，偏重不间断的近距强攻，而非二元激光那种克制的、湮灭式的精准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Lyran Alliance, the Bombast Laser was designed to be the ultimate word in laser weapons. During the design process, its engineers had to reduce the weight of the weapon. This sacrifice came from the power supply, which gave the weapon a long charge-time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轰鸣激光由莱兰联盟研制，意在成为激光武器的终极答案。在设计过程中，工程师不得不降低武器重量，这份牺牲来自供电系统，使该武器需要较长的充能时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The improved lasers used by the early Clans included the standard large laser and the large pulse laser. In both cases, engineering and machining refinements rendered these weapons lighter than their forebears, without sacrificing performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 早期部族使用的改进型激光包括标准大型激光和大型脉冲激光。两者都通过工程与加工上的改良，在不牺牲性能的前提下变得比其前身更轻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'PAAARTYCANNON' is barely more then 4 Chemical Lasers jury rigged together with a Randomized Focusing Lense to make it change Colours During firing... Someone scratched 'Sta-sta-Staaying Aliive' on it... Uses Chem Medium Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这门"派——对——炮"不过是把4门化学激光器胡乱拼在一起，再加一枚随机聚焦透镜，让它在开火时改变颜色……有人在上面刻了"活—活—活下去"…… < 使用化学中型弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chemical Lasers are not exactly a new invention but a rediscovering of Pre FTL Terra Laser Weapons that relied on a Chemical Process to create the required Energy output for a successful Shot. Uses Chem Large Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 化学激光算不上什么新发明，而是对前超光速时代地球激光武器的重新发掘——那些武器依靠化学过程来产生成功开火所需的能量输出。 使用化学大型激光弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Advanced laser technologies were among the first to be mastered by the Clans, but during Operation KLONDIKE testing was still underway on the new systems. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Star Adder developed the Heavy Lasers to deal more damage, but with an increased heat output. In addition, interference with a BattleMech's sensors means that a Heavy Large Laser is penalized with a +1 to-hit modifier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星蝰氏族研发重型激光器以造成更大伤害，但发热量也更高。此外，对战斗机甲传感器的干扰意味着重型大型激光器会受到+1命中修正的惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hyperlaser fires in Standard Mode. 12% Chance to Misfire. Mitigated by Jam Reduction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超级激光器以标准模式开火。12%走火几率。受卡壳降低影响。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The RISC Hyper Laser is a experimental heavy laser derived from the Clan's Improved Heavy Laser family. Hyper Lasers are the ultimate development in the heavy lasers technology, but it was constructed by the RISC engineers, instead of the Clans. Thanks to the pushing the limits in laser shielding and plasma lasing chemistry, the Hyper Laser is a very destructive and extreme range weapon, but the thermal and physical stress of immense scale make this weapon very prone to explosive malfunction. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: RISC超级激光器是一种实验性重型激光器，源自氏族改进型重型激光器系列。超级激光器是重型激光技术的终极发展，但它是由RISC工程师而非氏族建造的。得益于在激光屏蔽与等离子激射化学上的极限推进，超级激光器是一种破坏力极强、射程极远的武器，但巨大规模带来的热应力与物理应力使这件武器极易发生爆炸性故障。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the Star Adders introduced their Heavy Lasers, the other Clans started projects to duplicate or improve on them. Clan Goliath Scorpion was the first clan to introduce an effective Improved Heavy Laser, but it still possessed several tradeoffs that some warriors wouldn't accept. Most notable of these, it could explode if it suffered critical damage, much like a Gauss Rifle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星蝰部族推出重型激光之后，其他部族纷纷启动项目进行仿制或改进。歌利亚蝎部族是第一个推出实用型改进重型激光的部族，但它仍存在若干让部分战士无法接受的取舍。其中最突出的一点是，它在遭受关键损伤时可能会爆炸，就像高斯步枪一样。
改进型大型重激光(氏族)
改进型大型重激光(氏族)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Large Lasers exhibit a powerful combination of damage, range, and compactness but generate a substantial amount of heat. Like all Lasers, Large Lasers enjoy a baseline accuracy bonus over other weapons.  The Tronel is an older model, and as such generates 15% more heat than a standard Large Laser would.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大型激光在伤害、射程和紧凑性方面表现出强大的结合，但会产生大量的热量. 与所有激光一样，大型激光拥有比其他武器更高的基础命中加成. Tronel是较老的型号，因此产生的热量比标准大型激光多 15%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Medium Lasers are lightweight with respectable damage. Because of this, at least one can be found mounted on most units that cross the battlefield. Unlike standard Medium Lasers, the Argra 27C suffered from a glitch when syncing with targeting computers causing it to be less accurate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中型激光重量轻且伤害可观. 因此，在战场上穿梭的大多数单位上至少都能看到一门中型激光. 与标准中型激光不同，Argra 27C在与火控计算机同步时存在一个故障，导致其精度较低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The improved lasers used by the early Clans included the standard large laser and the large pulse laser. In both cases, engineering and machining refinements rendered these weapons lighter than their forebears, without sacrificing performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 早期部族使用的改进型激光包括标准大型激光和大型脉冲激光。两者都通过工程与加工上的改良，在不牺牲性能的前提下变得比其前身更轻。
改进型大型脉冲激光(早氏)
激光器发射4发。产生集束效果

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Impressed with the performance of then-newfangled pulse laser weaponry, engineers applied the paradigm of more bigger is more better. Coming in at 20 tons, this monstrously overengineered though aptly named Huge Pulse Laser pushes an enormous amount of energy through its modulation chambers. Functionally identical, the advantage is having the ability to melt most opponents in one salvo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当时新奇的脉冲激光武器性能令人印象深刻，工程师们便套用了“越大越多越好”的范式。这门重达20吨、被过度设计得离谱却名副其实的巨型脉冲激光，把巨量能量推过其调制腔。功能上并无不同，其优势在于有能力在一次齐射中融掉大多数对手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An improvement upon standard Large Lasers, Large Pulse Lasers use pulses of light instead of a sustained beam. This results in better accuracy and damage output but with greatly increased heat and weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为标准大型激光的改进型，大型脉冲激光使用光脉冲而非持续光束. 这带来了更高的命中率和伤害输出，但热量和重量也大幅增加.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An improvement upon standard Large Lasers, Large Pulse Lasers use pulses of light instead of a single beam. This results in better accuracy and damage output but with greatly increased heat and weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基于标准大型激光改进的大型脉冲激光用光脉冲代替了单一光束. 这带来了更高的精度和伤害输出，但热量和重量大幅增加.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Micro Pulse Laser was designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar (alongside the ER Micro Laser) primarily for use on their ProtoMechs. This Array Combines 3 Micro Pulse Laser. It Can fire as a Concentrated Burst, easily melting any armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 微型脉冲激光由烟虎氏族(与增程微型激光一同)设计，主要用于他们的原型机甲. 此阵列将3门微型脉冲激光组合为一体. 它能够以集束爆发方式开火，轻松熔化任何装甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The technicians of Clan Wolf were interested in creating an improved pulse laser with extended range. Unlike their Inner Sphere counterparts, who simply pumped more energy into a standard pulse laser, the Wolf techs combined the best features of their Pulse and Extended range lasers to create the ER Pulse Laser family.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼氏族的技术人员对制造一种射程更远的改进型脉冲激光器很感兴趣. 与内天体同行们简单地给标准脉冲激光注入更多能量不同，狼氏的技术人员将他们的脉冲激光和增程激光的优点结合起来，创造了增程脉冲激光系列.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Re-engineered Lasers were developed by trying to mate a Pulse laser with a Heavy Laser. Though unsuccessful in that effort the weapons created had one odd benefit: They totally ignored specialty anti-laser armors, inflicting their full damage on a unit equipped with such armor. The twin pulses fired by a Re-engineered Laser hit so close together on a target that they bore straight through.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重构激光是尝试将脉冲激光与重激光结合时诞生的产物. 尽管该目标未能实现，但由此产生的武器却有一个奇特优势: 它们能完全无视特种反激光装甲，对装备此类装甲的单位造成全额伤害. 重构激光发射的双脉冲在目标上落点极为接近，足以直接贯穿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser is the largest Variable Speed Pulse Lasers in use. Weighing almost as much as a Heavy PPC, the Large VSP Laser can inflict nearly as much damage on a target, and has a better chance of hitting the target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大型变速脉冲激光是正在使用的变速脉冲激光中最大的一种. 其重量几乎与重型PPC相当，大型VSP激光能对目标造成几乎同等的伤害，并且命中目标的几率更高.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser is, as its name suggests, the mid-sized version of the Variable Speed Pulse Lasers in use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中型变速脉冲激光，顾名思义，是正在使用的变速脉冲激光的中等尺寸版本.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Small Variable Speed Pulse Laser is, as its name suggests, the smallest of the Variable Speed Lasers in use. Commonly fitted in place of a small pulse laser, this weapon is mostly seen on light 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小型可变速度脉冲激光器，正如其名，是现役可变速度激光器中最小的一种。它常被装在小型脉冲激光器的位置上，多见于轻型机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: X-Pulse Lasers are an attempt by Federated Commonwealth technicians to increase the range of Pulse Lasers to compete with the longer ranges of standard models. X-Pulse lasers are not a new weapon per se, but an upgrade to Pulse Lasers that pushes extra energy through the system in order to extend the range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: X脉冲激光是联邦共同体同盟技术人员为提升脉冲激光器射程，使其能与标准型号的更长射程相抗衡而做出的尝试. X脉冲激光本身并非新武器，而是对脉冲激光的升级，通过在系统中注入额外能量来延长射程.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is 3 Plasma Cannons with a single rapid feeding mechanism that fails to properly create the plasma and mostly just lobs hot plastic at whatever is infront of it.... I know Pirates are known to imbibe but you gotta stop bringing me this stuff Boss! Uses Plasma Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是3门等离子炮配一套快速供弹机构，但它无法正确生成等离子，多半只是把热塑料甩向眼前的东西……我知道海盗好这口，但老板你得别再给我带这种东西了！ 使用等离子弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple lift hoist normally used to move loads around. Not very impressive as a weapon by itself, but a skilled pilot can use it to gain battlefield advantages.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种通常用于搬运货物的简易起重装置。作为武器本身并不起眼，但技艺娴熟的飞行员能用它在战场上取得优势。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HotLoaded LRM have no Minimum Range, -1 Accuracy, -10% Damage, 15% Jam Chance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 热装填 LRM 没有最小射程，-1 精度，-10% 伤害，15% 卡壳几率。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The LRM10 rack of Long-Range Missiles occupies a supporting fire role when mounted on most units, with fairly low damage balanced by low heat and ammunition consumption. Like all LRMs, LRM10s are capable of indirect fire over obstacles and terrain. LRM can fill a variety of roles using specialized ammunition. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle Hot-Loading. (HL) missiles have no minimum range but can Misfire, damaging the launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LRM10 远程导弹挂架装在大多数单位上时承担支援射击角色，伤害偏低，但以低热量与低弹药消耗作平衡。与所有 LRM 一样，LRM10 能越过障碍与地形进行间接射击。LRM 可通过特种弹药胜任多种角色。 战斗中左键点击"命中几率"可切换热装填。（HL）导弹没有最小射程，但可能失灵并损坏发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: LRM Fires at shorter ranges without Minimum Range Penaltys
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LRM 可在更近距离发射且无最小射程惩罚

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Long Range Missiles were developed by the Federated Commonwealth in response to the superior performance of Clan weaponry. These new LRMs use a more sophisticated arming mechanism to increase their viability at close range. The result has been a much smaller blind spot compared to traditional LRMs while still retaining the same long-range functionality. Uses LRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增程远程导弹是联邦共和国为应对部族武器的优越性能而开发的。这种新型 LRM 采用更精密的解除保险机制，以提高近距离下的可用性。相比传统 LRM，其盲区大幅缩小，同时仍保有相同的远程功能。 使用 LRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extended LRM (ELRM) system was designed by engineers in the Federated Commonwealth. The ELRM pairs a standard LRM to a booster system that gives the missile more fuel, and thus, more range. Offsetting the range advantage is the fact that the minimum range of the weapon is increased by over 50%, combined with a reduced ammunition capacity and a heavier, bulkier launcher. Uses LRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增程 LRM（ELRM）系统由联邦联邦的工程师设计。它为标准 LRM 配上助推系统，使导弹携带更多燃料，从而射程更远。抵消这一优势的是：武器最小射程增加超过 50%，同时弹药容量减少、发射器更重更笨。 使用 LRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Streak LRM marries the Streak guidance system with a standard LRM launcher. Though successful, the Streak LRM launcher weighs twice as much as the standard Clan LRM launcher (as much as a standard Inner Sphere launcher). The Streak LRM cannot make use of any alternate ammunition types or enhanced guidance systems. Since the Streak LRM requires line of sight to lock on to a target it also lost the ability to make indirect fire attacks. Uses Streak LRM Ammo.

Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle Hot-Loading. (HL) missiles have no minimum range but can Misfire, damaging the launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为重型单位常见的次要武器，LRM20 远程导弹挂架能在单位接近时造成可观伤害，但极为耗弹。与所有 LRM 一样，LRM20 能越过障碍与地形进行间接射击。LRM 可通过特种弹药胜任多种角色。 战斗中左键点击"命中几率"可切换热装填。（HL）导弹没有最小射程，但可能失灵并损坏发射器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HotLoaded LRM have no Minimum Range, -1 Accuracy, -10% Damage, 15% Jam Chance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 热装填 LRM 没有最小射程，-1 精度，-10% 伤害，15% 卡壳几率。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced Long Range Missiles were developed by the Federated Commonwealth in response to the superior performance of Clan weaponry. These new LRMs use a more sophisticated arming mechanism to increase their viability at close range. The result has been a much smaller blind spot compared to traditional LRMs while still retaining the same long-range functionality. Uses LRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增程远程导弹是联邦共和国为应对部族武器的优越性能而开发的。这种新型 LRM 采用更精密的解除保险机制，以提高近距离下的可用性。相比传统 LRM，其盲区大幅缩小，同时仍保有相同的远程功能。 使用 LRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extended LRM (ELRM) system was designed by engineers in the Federated Commonwealth. The ELRM pairs a standard LRM to a booster system that gives the missile more fuel, and thus, more range. Offsetting the range advantage is the fact that the minimum range of the weapon is increased by over 50%, combined with a reduced ammunition capacity and a heavier, bulkier launcher. Uses LRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增程 LRM（ELRM）系统由联邦联邦的工程师设计。它为标准 LRM 配上助推系统，使导弹携带更多燃料，从而射程更远。抵消这一优势的是：武器最小射程增加超过 50%，同时弹药容量减少、发射器更重更笨。 使用 LRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HotLoaded LRM have no Minimum Range but a 50% Chance to Misfire. Mitigated by Jam Reduction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 热装填 LRM 没有最小射程，但有 50% 失灵几率。可通过降低卡壳来缓解。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Streak LRM marries the Streak guidance system with a standard LRM launcher. Developed by Clan Coyote technicians as part of Khan Sullivan Koga's revitalization plan, the Streak LRM combines the original Streak's ammunition conservation with LRM range. Though successful, the Streak LRM launcher weighs twice as much as the standard Clan LRM launcher (as much as a standard Inner Sphere launcher). The Streak LRM cannot make use of any alternate ammunition types or enhanced guidance systems. Since the Streak LRM requires line of sight to lock on to a target it also lost the ability to make indirect fire attacks. Uses Streak LRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连续 LRM 把连续制导系统与标准 LRM 发射器结合。它由郊狼氏族技师作为可汗沙利文·科加振兴计划的一部分开发，把原版连续系统的弹药节约性与 LRM 的射程合二为一。虽然成功，但连续 LRM 发射器的重量是标准氏族 LRM 发射器的两倍（相当于内天体标准发射器）。连续 LRM 无法使用任何替代弹种或增强制导系统。由于连续 LRM 需要视线才能锁定目标，它也失去了间接射击能力。 使用连续 LRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Buzzsaw is a circular saw used during construction and manufacturing by IndustrialMechs. It saw some limited use in Solaris arenas for an easy way to deal direct physical damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Buzzsaw 是一种圆盘锯，工业机甲在建筑与制造作业中会用到它。它在 Solaris 竞技场中也有有限的应用，作为一种直接造成物理伤害的简便手段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一件物理武器，命中判定等同于普通武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mining 'Mechs use arm-mounted Drills to excavate tunnels and extract ore. In an emergency, these heavy-duty drills can be used against 'Mechs in melee combat. Like all Industrial weapons the Mining Drill suffers a small inherent penalty to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 采矿机甲使用安装在手臂上的钻头挖掘隧道、开采矿石。紧急情况下，这些重型钻头也能用来近战攻击机甲。与所有工业武器一样，采矿钻头在命中判定上带有轻微的固有惩罚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Sprayer is simply a hose and pump system that sprays liquids at a target. Only useable on IndustrialMechs, it has limited useage in combat beyond being a very short range crowd control system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 喷洒器不过是一套软管加泵送系统，用于向目标喷射液体。它只能安装在工业机甲上，在战斗中用途有限，仅能充当超近距离的人群控制手段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wrecking Ball is a piece of construction equipment that is rarely seen on the battlefield. Though it has been used by the arena fighters on Solaris, the lack of range and interference with other equipment mean it's not popular with the regular armies of the Inner Sphere. Instead the Wrecking Ball is usually found on IndustrialMechs and support vehicles that are used for demolition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破坏球是一种工程设备，在战场上极为罕见。虽然索拉里斯的竞技场斗士曾使用过它，但射程不足且会干扰其他装备，使它在内层星域的常规军队中并不受欢迎。破坏球通常出现在用于拆迁的工业机甲和支援车辆上。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗装甲级中型增程激光.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Two linked Clan-tech Battle Armor-grade Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两门联动的氏族科技战斗装甲级中型脉冲激光器。
战斗装甲中型脉冲激光器（C）x2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hatchet is a melee attack weapon equipped on BattleMechs. While most 'Mechs are equipped with ranged weaponry, melee weaponry is also both feasible and useful due to increased damage potential (over a punch) and a lack of heat buildup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斧是装备在战斗机甲上的近战武器。虽然大多数机甲装备的是远程武器，但近战武器同样可行且有用，因为它相比拳击具有更高的伤害潜力，且不会积热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a physical weapon and hits like a normal weapon.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the weapon used by infantry for centuries, the Mech Mortar fires a small shell in a high arc that falls onto the target. Though the Mech Mortar was created by the Terran Hegemony, by 2835 the Succession Wars had relegated it to history. With the reintroduction of the Anti-Missile System, engineers revived the Mech Mortar concept. The munitions used by the mortars, though often possessing limited guidance packages, weren't destroyed by AMS systems in tests. Mortar shells also proved very adaptable, accepting several types of payloads. Uses Mortar Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲迫击炮基于步兵使用了数世纪的武器，以高弧线发射小型炮弹落向目标。虽然机甲迫击炮由地球霸权创造，到 2835 年继承战争已把它扫入历史。随着反导系统的重新引入，工程师们复活了机甲迫击炮的概念。迫击炮所用弹药虽通常制导组件有限，但在测试中不会被 AMS 拦截。迫击炮弹还被证明适应性极强，可接受多种载荷。 使用迫击炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medium-Range Missile Launcher was designed by scientists at Luthien Armor Works. MRMs are dead-fire missiles that are fired more like lasers than missiles. In order to pack as many missiles as possible into one salvo, scientists removed guidance systems and made the whole package smaller. Though this was seen as a step backwards in technological development, the inexpensive and deadly MRMs have spread throughout the Draconis Combine and to many mercenary units. Uses MRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中程导弹发射器由鲁西恩装甲工厂的科学家设计。MRM 是无制导导弹，发射方式更像激光而非导弹。为在一次齐射中塞入尽可能多的导弹，科学家拆除了制导系统并缩小了整个组件。尽管这被视为技术发展的倒退，廉价而致命的 MRM 仍传遍德拉科尼斯联合体与众多佣兵部队。 使用 MRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This launcher fires a single NARC beacon that attaches itself to the enemy and emits a homing signal for all friendly missiles. Uses NARC ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种发射器发射单个NARC信标，它会附着在敌人身上，为所有友方导弹发出寻的信号。 < 使用NARC弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Plasma Cannon accelerates and superheats a cartridge of 'plastic foam' into an excited state and release it as plasma, creating a tremendous kinetic and thermal impact. Unlike the Capellan version, the Clan Scientists focused exclusively on heat generation, making the Plasma Cannon cause nearly twice as much heat damage on the target. VOLATILE! Uses Plasma Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这门等离子炮将一筒"塑料泡沫"加速并过热至激发态，以等离子形式释放，造成巨大的动能与热能冲击。与卡佩兰版本不同，氏族科学家完全专注于发热，使这门等离子炮对目标造成近两倍的热量伤害。易爆！ 使用等离子弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The plasma rifle was developed by the Capellan Confederation. Based upon their man-portable version, the Confederation created what is essentially a massive flamer. Plasma weapons use the power of the fusion engine or power amplifiers to power an electromagnetic accelerator to a stream, pulse, or toroid of plasma (i.e. very hot, energetic, and excited matter). The plasma is created by using a lasing process to flash cartridges of plastic foam into white-hot projectiles that cause thermal, as well as physical, damage. Because this foam ammo is inert, it will not explode even if destroyed.Uses Plasma Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等离子步枪由卡佩兰联邦研发。联邦以其单兵便携版本为基础，造出了本质上是一具巨型火焰喷射器的武器。等离子武器利用聚变引擎或动力放大器的能量驱动电磁加速器，将等离子（即极高温、高能、激发态的物质）以流、脉冲或环面形式发射出去。等离子通过激光过程将塑料泡沫弹匣瞬间汽化，形成白热射弹，造成热能与物理伤害。由于这种泡沫弹药是惰性的，即使被摧毁也不会爆炸。使用等离子弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Anti-Personnel Pod (A-Pod) is a piece of equipment designed specifically for 'Mechs. When detonated, effectively fill an area 15 meters in diameter with deadly shrapnel. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 反人员炸弹（A-Pod）是一种专为机甲设计的设备。引爆后可在直径15米的范围内布满致命破片。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M-Pod is based on the A-Pod and B-Pod, but uses larger explosives and a more directional blast to damage hard targets. Designed by engineers in the Solaris games, the M-Pod is essentially a modified canister of LB-X autocannon ammunition. When activated it sprays targets with a mixture of shrapnel and 'Mech sized shotgun pellets. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M-Pod 以 A-Pod 和 B-Pod 为基础，但装填了更大的炸药，并采用更具方向性的爆炸来摧毁坚固目标。M-Pod 由 Solaris 竞技赛的工程师设计，本质上是一个经过改装的 LB-X 自动炮弹药罐。启动后，它会向目标喷射出一片由弹片和机甲尺寸霰弹组成的弹雨。易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Disabled FI removes Minimum Range but has a 25% Chance to Misfire. Mitigated by Jam Reduction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 禁用FI可移除最小射程，但有 25% 概率走火. 受卡壳减免影响.
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Particle Projector Cannons ''PPCs'' fire streams of energized lightning at their target that deal substantial damage and stability impact. However, this comes with intense heat generation and bulkiness. PPCs also generate a mild EM field that degrades the firing capability of their target. Left Click on Chance to Hit during battle to toggle the Field Inhibitor. (FIOFF) Has no minimum range penalty but can Misfire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粒子投射炮（"PPC"）向目标发射高能闪电束，造成可观伤害与稳定冲击。但这伴随着剧烈产热与笨重体积。PPC 还会产生微弱电磁场，削弱目标的射击能力。 战斗中左键点击"命中几率"可切换场抑制器。（FIOFF）无最小射程惩罚，但可能失灵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Researched by the Draconis Combine, the Heavy PPC is a larger, more potent version of the Particle Projector Cannon, capable of delivering a devastating blow to both the enemy and their sensors. Left Click on Chance to Hit during battle to toggle the Field Inhibitor. (FIOFF) Has no minimum range penalty but can Misfire.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Extended Range Heavy PPC was created after some Clan engineers got their hands on a shipment of stolen Heavy PPCs. By applying the improved minimized components from a standard Clan ER PPC they managed to increase the Heavy PPCs range considerably while making it smaller and lighter. However, due to the components originally not meant for the large energy load of a Heavy PPC, the weapon ended up somewhat prone to misfiring.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增程重型PPC是在一些氏族工程师弄到一批被窃的重型PPC之后创造的。通过把标准氏族增程PPC上改进过的微型化组件应用过来，他们成功大幅提升了重型PPC的射程，同时让它更小更轻。然而，由于这些组件原本并非为重型PPC的大能量载荷而设计，该武器最终有些容易走火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early prototype of the Particle Projector Cannon (PPC). Its performance is very similar to the later mass produced versions, but it suffers from considerably worse heat build-up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粒子加农炮（PPC）的早期原型机. 其性能与后期量产版本非常相似，但存在热量积聚严重得多的问题.
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。
PPC[原型]: 增加目标的ECM干扰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snub-Nose PPC is to a Particle Projector Cannon as a sawed-off shotgun is to a shotgun. This version of the PPC is slightly lighter than a standard PPC, but its energy discharge trails off considerably faster, leading to shorter range and reduced damage capacity over range. An interesting side benefit is the dramatically increased short range, longer than almost any other weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短管PPC之于标准PPC，恰如短管霰弹枪之于标准霰弹枪. 此型粒子炮略轻于标准型，但其能量释放衰减速度远快于后者，导致射程更短且远距离伤害下降. 其有趣的附带优势在于近程威力大幅提升，近程射程之长几乎超过任何其他武器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Particle Projector Cannons ''PPCs'' fire streams of energized lightning at their target that deal substantial damage and stability impact. However, this comes with intense heat generation and bulkiness. PPCs also generate a mild EM field that degrades the firing capability of their target. Left Click on Chance to Hit during battle to toggle the Field Inhibitor. (FIOFF) Has no minimum range penalty but can Misfire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粒子投射炮（"PPC"）向目标发射高能闪电束，造成可观伤害与稳定冲击。但这伴随着剧烈产热与笨重体积。PPC 还会产生微弱电磁场，削弱目标的射击能力。 战斗中左键点击"命中几率"可切换场抑制器。（FIOFF）无最小射程惩罚，但可能失灵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Clan Coyote in 3068 as a way to integrate the Advanced Tactical Missile System on ProtoMechs. While many sacrifices had to be made to fit the weapons system on Protomechs, it can use any type of ATM and IATM ammo but it only carries a single reload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由郊狼氏族于3068年设计，用以在原型机甲上整合高级战术导弹系统。虽然为了在原型机甲上装上该武器系统必须做出许多牺牲，它能使用任何类型的ATM与iATM弹药，但只携带一次再装填。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech sized chainsaw welded to a ProtoMech
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一具机甲尺寸的链锯，焊在原型机甲上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mech's Systems have been scrambled.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲的系统已被干扰瘫痪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When a ProtoMech using EDP armor performs a physical attack it can enable the discharge of the armor's capacitors, resulting in the attack acting as a taser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当使用EDP装甲的原型机甲进行物理攻击时，它可以触发装甲电容的放电，使该攻击起到电击枪的作用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Someone welded two proto ac/2s together chopped off half the barrels hard wired it into the FCS systems, made it think it is a Ultra Autocannon and made it accept lbx ammo. Just another pirate having his way with this equipment boss. Only surprising thing is this doesn't seem like its just going to blow up but we wont be able to mount it to any 'Mechs or Proto's. Uses LBX2 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有人把两门原型AC/2焊在一起，砍掉一半炮管，硬接进火控系统，让它以为自己是一门超速自动炮，还让它接受LBX弹药。又一个海盗在这装备上胡乱折腾，老大。唯一令人惊讶的是这玩意儿看起来不会直接炸掉，但我们没法把它装到任何机甲或原型机甲上。 使用LBX2弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Railgun is a massive weapon adapted from WarShips to be used on BattleMechs. Clan technology has allowed such a massive weapon to fit a relative small space. This powerful weapon decimates enemy 'Mechs with a single, well-placed shot, but only a few 'Mechs can mount one. Uses Railgun Ammo. CASE PROTECTED.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁轨炮是一种从战舰改装到战斗机甲上使用的巨型武器。氏族科技让如此庞大的武器得以装入相对狭小的空间。这件强力武器只需一次精准的命中就能摧毁敌方机甲，但只有少数机甲能装得下一门。 使用磁轨炮弹药。 CASE保护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Railgun is a massive weapon adapted from WarShips to be used on BattleMechs. By refining the support structure and power circuitry needed ComStar created the Light Railgun, which has slightly lower performance but is considerably smaller and can fit in more 'Mechs. Uses Railgun Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁轨炮是一种从战舰改装到战斗机甲上使用的巨型武器。通过精简所需的支撑结构与电力电路，康星造出了轻型磁轨炮，性能略低，但体积小得多，能装进更多机甲。 使用磁轨炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Railgun is a massive weapon adapted from WarShips to be used on BattleMechs. This Original SLDF Era Railgun is heavier and has upgraded capacitors to not explode when destroyed, but still is prohibitively heavy and large and can only fit on the largest BattleMechs. Uses Railgun Gauss Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轨道炮是一种从战舰改装用于战斗机甲的庞然巨物。这门原版SLDF时代的轨道炮更重，并升级了电容器以免在损毁时爆炸，但它依然重得过分、大得过分，只能装在最大的战斗机甲上。 使用轨道炮高斯弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Railgun is a massive weapon adapted from WarShips to be used on BattleMechs. This somehow got barely made functional again with a broken barrel and additional chargers.... Can Toggle Between Standard Mode or Overcharging the Capacitor, exchanging Reliability and Firing Rate for Range and Damage Uses Railgun Gauss Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 磁轨炮是一种从战舰改装到战斗机甲上使用的巨型武器。这一门不知怎么地在炮管破损、还加了额外充电器的情况下被勉强修复到能用的地步…… < 可在标准模式与电容过充之间切换，以可靠性及射速换取射程与伤害 使用磁轨炮磁轨弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Heavy Rifle is the largest Rifle in the family. The precursor to the modern Autocannon, the Rifle is based on the main guns used by tanks on pre-spaceflight Terra. Uses Heavy Rifle Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型步枪是步枪家族中最大的一型。作为现代自动炮的前身，步枪基于前太空时代地球上坦克使用的主炮。 < 使用重型步枪弹药。
武器使用重型步枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This isn't quite your run of the mill Heavy Rifle. Its bore diameter matches Thunderbolt 10 missiles, and it has an adapted feed system to handle them in addition to normal shells. It's better quality than a lot of weird periphery junk, even though it looks hand made. Its designer has stenciled the word ''Shillelagh'' onto the barrel, and was thoughtful enough to etch the specs for the custom zero-spin sabots the missiles need onto the inside of the top cover. Can toggle between missile and rifle mode. Firing missiles has a 12% jam chance, mitigated by Gunnery Uses Heavy Rifle Ammo. Uses TBOLT10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这可不完全是普通的超重型步枪。它的口径与雷霆10导弹匹配，并配有改装过的供弹系统，除正常炮弹之外也能处理它们。尽管看着像手工打造，它的质量比许多古怪的外缘破烂要好。其设计师在炮管上印上了"橡木棍"这个词，还体贴地把这些导弹所需的定制零旋转弹托规格蚀刻在顶盖内侧。 < 可在导弹模式与步枪模式之间切换。发射导弹有12%卡壳几率，受射击技能影响 < 使用重型步枪弹药。 < 使用TBOLT10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Light Rifle is the smallest of the ''Rifle'' family. The precursor to the modern Autocannon, the Rifle is based on the main guns used by tanks on pre-spaceflight Terra. Uses Light Rifle Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型步枪是"步枪"家族中最小的一型。作为现代自动炮的前身，步枪基于前太空时代地球上坦克使用的主炮。 < 使用轻型步枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Medium Rifle is the middleweight of the 'Rifle' family. The precursor to the modern Autocannon, the Rifle was based on the main guns used by tanks on pre-spaceflight Terra. Uses Medium Rifle Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中型步枪是"步枪"家族中的中量级选手。作为现代自动炮的前身，步枪基于前太空时代地球上坦克使用的主炮。 < 使用中型步枪弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This 'Rifle' is little more than a crude tube with a firing mechanism added to it. Whatever works out there, I guess. Uses Potato Rifle Ammo. VOLATILE!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get a taste of true rotary firepower without the burdensome weight and bulk of traditional Rotary Autocannons. Try Quicsell's line of slim and sleek Rotary Rifles. Perfect for your budget firepower needs. Uses Heavy Rifle Ammo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Automatic Recoilless Pistol firing Gyrojet HEAP 'Bullets'. Battle Armor Weapons can only be mounted on Powered Armor Units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一把自动无后坐力手枪，发射旋喷高爆穿甲"子弹"。 战斗装甲武器只能安装在动力装甲单位上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A tiny rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM2s deal little damage but also cost almost nothing in the way of weight, space, heat, or ammunition consumption. As for all SRMs, SRM2 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SRM-2是一种小型短程火箭，造成的伤害小，但几乎没有重量、空间、热量或弹药消耗上的代价. 相对于其他所有的短程火箭，SRM-2每一击都可以造成超出平均水准的稳定性伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing more powerful launch mechanisms, the early Clan weapons-makers increased the SRMs’ effective range by one-third, even though launchers themselves remained about the same weight and size as their original counterparts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 早期的部族武器制造者采用威力更强的发射装置，把 SRM 的有效射程提高了三分之一，而发射器本身的重量和体积与原版型号基本相当。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A tiny rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM2s deal little damage but also cost almost nothing in the way of weight, space, heat, or ammunition consumption. As for all SRMs, SRM2 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons. Uses SRM [CLAN] Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最小的短程火箭挂架，SRM2造成的伤害不大，重量、空间、热量与弹药消耗也几乎可以忽略。与所有SRM一样，SRM2每次命中造成的稳定性冲击高于其他武器。 使用SRM[部族]弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Improved One Shot version of the SRM2. Lighter than a proper SRM2 by removing its feed tubes, with the ammunition stored directely in the feed tubes instead. This of course reloading is not possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SRM2的改良型一次性发射版本. 通过移除供弹管并直接将弹药储存在管内，使其比标准SRM2更轻. 当然，这样一来便无法重新装填.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A tiny rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM2s deal little damage but also cost almost nothing in the way of weight, space, heat, or ammunition consumption. As for all SRMs, SRM2 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SRM-2是一种小型短程火箭，造成的伤害小，但几乎没有重量、空间、热量或弹药消耗上的代价. 相对于其他所有的短程火箭，SRM-2每一击都可以造成超出平均水准的稳定性伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Streak SRM-2 launcher is a prototype SRM that uses an advanced active guidance system to track targets, but at the cost of 50% increased weight and heat generation. Uses Streak SRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连发SRM-2发射器是一种原型SRM，使用先进的主动制导系统追踪目标，代价是重量与发热量增加50%。 使用连发SRM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the final years of the Star League-in-Exile, SLDF researchers and weapons manufacturers attempted to increase the size of the Streak SRM launchers to include four- and six-missile racks. While they had some limited success, the true breakthroughs would not come until the beginning of the Golden Century, when Clan scientists conquered problems with the Streak targeting and guidance systems in the larger rack sizes. Experimental versions of Streak SRM-4 and -6 racks were available in limited quantities during and immediately after Operation KLONDIKE. Uses Streak SRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在流亡星际联盟的最后岁月里，SLDF 的研究人员与武器制造商试图扩大连发 SRM 发射器的尺寸，加入四联和六联发射架。虽然他们取得了有限的一些成果，但真正的突破要等到黄金世纪之初，部族科学家攻克了更大发射架尺寸下的连发瞄准与制导系统难题。在 KLONDIKE 行动期间以及刚结束之后，连发 SRM-4 和 SRM-6 的实验版本曾以小批量形式供应。 使用连发 SRM 弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Streak SRM-2 launcher is a prototype SRM that uses an advanced active guidance system to track targets, but at the cost of increased weight and heat generation. Uses Clan Streak SRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连发SRM-2发射器是一种原型SRM，使用先进的主动制导系统追踪目标，代价是重量与发热量增加。 使用氏族连发SRM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Streak SRM-2 launcher is a prototype SRM that uses an advanced active guidance system to track targets, but at the cost of increased weight and heat generation. Improved One-Shot, can only fire once.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连发 SRM-2 发射器是一种原型 SRM，采用先进的主动制导系统追踪目标，但代价是重量和热量增加。 改进型单次发射，只能开火一次。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SRM4 是中档短程火箭架，伤害不错，缺点相对较少——除其固有的短射程和弹药需求外。与所有 SRM 一样，相比其他武器，SRM4 每发造成高于平均的稳定性冲击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The midtier rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM4s deal good damage for comparatively few negatives other than their inherently short range and need for ammunition. As for all SRMs, SRM4 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons. Uses SRM [CLAN] Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为中档的短程火箭架，SRM4除射程天生较短以及需要弹药之外，以相对较少的负面代价造成不错的伤害。与所有SRM一样，SRM4每发命中造成的稳定度冲击高于其他武器的平均水平。 使用SRM[氏族]弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The midtier rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM4s deal good damage for comparatively few negatives other than their inherently short range and need for ammunition. As for all SRMs, SRM4 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons. This is a one-shot version that only allows firing the internally stored four missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中量级短程火箭发射架，SRM4能在相对较少的负面特性下造成可观的伤害，唯一的短板是其本身射程偏短且需依赖弹药供给. 与所有SRM一样，SRM4的每次命中对目标稳定性的冲击高于其他武器的平均水平. 这是一次性版本，仅能发射内置的四枚导弹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Improved One Shot version of the SRM-4. Lighter than a proper SRM-4 by removing its feed tubes, with the ammunition stored directly in the feed tubes instead. Due to this reloading is not possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SRM-4的改良型一次性发射版本. 通过移除供弹管并直接将弹药储存在管内，使其比标准SRM-4更轻. 因此无法重新装填.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mid-tier rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM4s deal good damage for comparatively few negatives other than their inherently short range and need for ammunition. As for all SRMs, SRM4 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为中档短程火箭挂架，SRM4造成的伤害不错，负面因素相对较少，只有其固有的短射程与对弹药的依赖。与所有SRM一样，SRM4每次命中造成的稳定性冲击高于其他武器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Streak SRM-4 launcher is a prototype SRM that uses an advanced active guidance system to track targets, but at the cost of 50% increased weight and heat generation. Uses Streak SRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连发SRM-4发射器是一种原型SRM，使用先进的主动制导系统追踪目标，代价是重量与发热量增加50%。 使用连发SRM弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the final years of the Star League-in-Exile, SLDF researchers and weapons manufacturers attempted to increase the size of the Streak SRM launchers to include four- and six-missile racks. While they had some limited success, the true breakthroughs would not come until the beginning of the Golden Century, when Clan scientists conquered problems with the Streak targeting and guidance systems in the larger rack sizes. Experimental versions of Streak SRM-4 and -6 racks were available in limited quantities during and immediately after Operation KLONDIKE. Uses Streak SRM Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在流亡星际联盟的最后岁月里，SLDF 的研究人员与武器制造商试图扩大连发 SRM 发射器的尺寸，加入四联和六联发射架。虽然他们取得了有限的一些成果，但真正的突破要等到黄金世纪之初，部族科学家攻克了更大发射架尺寸下的连发瞄准与制导系统难题。在 KLONDIKE 行动期间以及刚结束之后，连发 SRM-4 和 SRM-6 的实验版本曾以小批量形式供应。 使用连发 SRM 弹药。
