Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is nothing but several tons of explosive strapped together. Detonating them will also breach the unit's engine core.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这不过是将几吨炸药捆绑在一起。引爆它们也会击穿单位的引擎核心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is nothing but several tons of explosives and incendiary chemicals strapped together. Detonating them will also breach the unit's engine core.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这不过是将几吨炸药与燃烧化学物质捆绑在一起。引爆它们也会击穿单位的引擎核心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit is coated with burning chemicals. It will gain 15 heat on its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位被燃烧的化学物质覆盖，下次行动时将增加 15 点热量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well... Its a dirty nuke with a big red button
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯……它就是一枚脏弹，配一个大红按钮

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another recreation of Star League tech, this Target Acquisition Gear combines several active scanning systems to act like a Mech-sized laser pointer and share targeting information with the Lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 另一项星际联盟科技复原成果，这款目标捕获装置(TAG)结合了多个主动扫描系统，功能如同机甲大小的激光指示器，并能与小队共享目标信息.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target is marked for guided munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已被标记用于制导弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This target was TAG'ed. +1 to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标已被 TAG 标记。命中 +1。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Visual indicator of the TAG effect
TAG: Enable TAG-activated guided ammunition accuracy bonuses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: TAG: 启用TAG激活的制导弹药命中加成
TAG: 增加目标视觉特征

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the Truce of Tukayyid the Scientist Caste of Clan Wolf investigated enhancing the TAG technology, eventually settling on reducing its weight. The result weighed half that of the standard version, but also had a 40% reduction in range compared it, an effective range on-par with the standard medium laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Tukayyid停战协议签署后，狼氏族的科学家阶层开始研究如何改进TAG技术，最终决定减轻其重量. 成果的重量仅为标准版本的一半，但射程也相应减少了 40%，其有效射程与标准中型激光相当.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target is marked for guided munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已被标记用于制导弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This target was TAG'ed. +1 to hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标已被 TAG 标记。命中 +1。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Visual indicator of the TAG effect
Light TAG: Enable TAG-activated guided ammunition accuracy bonuses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型TAG: 启用由TAG激活的制导弹药精度加成

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Light TAG: Increased Target Visual Signature
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻型TAG: 目标视觉特征增加

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BattleMech Taser uses a specially modified metal harpoon that sends a massive electrical pulse down a wire connected to the firing unit. This electrical pulse is designed to overload the target's electrical system and hopefully cause the target unit to shut down. This allows the Taser carrying unit to capture the target rather than destroying it. Uses Taser Ammo. VOLATILE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗机甲电击枪使用一根特别改装的金属鱼叉，沿一条连接发射单位的导线传送巨大的电脉冲。这种电脉冲旨在使目标的电力系统过载，并有望让目标单位停机。这使携带电击枪的单位能够俘获目标而非摧毁它。 使用电击枪弹药。 易爆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mech's Systems have been scrambled.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲的系统已被干扰瘫痪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt launcher is an offshoot of standard LRM technology. Instead of firing groups of missiles, the Thunderbolt launcher fires a single missile. Uses TBOLT10 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆发射器是标准LRM技术的一个分支。它不发射成组导弹，而是发射单枚导弹。 < 使用TBOLT10弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt Missile was developed for the arenas of Solaris. Unlike most missile systems, the Thunderbolt was a single missile that smashed into its target. Though it was effective in the arenas, it didn't see widespread use in the field because the single missile was very vulnerable to Anti-Missile Systems. The missile launcher, though small, was awkward to mount and would only fit on the left or right torso of a 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆导弹是为索拉里斯的竞技场开发的。与大多数导弹系统不同，雷霆是一枚撞向目标的单一导弹。虽然它在竞技场中有效，却未在战场上广泛使用，因为这枚单独导弹极易被反导系统拦截。其发射器虽小却难以安装，只能装在机甲的左或右躯干上。

The missile launcher, though small, was awkward to mount and would only fit on the left or right torso of a 'Mech.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt launcher is an offshoot of standard LRM technology. Instead of firing groups of missiles, the Thunderbolt launcher fires a single missile. Uses TBOLT15 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆发射器是标准LRM技术的一个分支。它不发射成组导弹，而是发射单枚导弹。 < 使用TBOLT15弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt launcher is an offshoot of standard LRM technology. Instead of firing groups of missiles, the Thunderbolt launcher fires a single missile. Uses TBOLT20 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆发射器是标准LRM技术的一个分支。它不发射成组导弹，而是发射单枚导弹。 < 使用TBOLT20弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt launcher is an offshoot of standard LRM technology. Instead of firing groups of missiles, the Thunderbolt launcher fires a single missile. Uses TBOLT5 Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆发射器是标准LRM技术的一个分支。它不发射成组导弹，而是发射单枚导弹。 < 使用TBOLT5弹药。
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tight Stream Electro Magnetic Pulse Cannon is a directed energy weapon based on the Taser system, but doesn't require the cabling and capacitors. The unit mounting the TSEMP Cannon suffers from sensor and electronic system interference every time it fires the TSEMP. The capacitors used to charge the Cannon also require time to recharge between shots, so an operator will have to wait ten seconds between shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 紧流电磁脉冲炮是一种基于电击枪系统的定向能武器，但不需要电缆与电容器。搭载TSEMP炮的单位每次开火都会遭受传感器与电子系统干扰。用于给该炮充电的电容器在两次射击之间也需要时间回充，因此操作员每两发之间必须等待十秒。
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tight Stream Electro Magnetic Pulse Cannon is a directed energy weapon based on the Taser system, but doesn't require the cabling and capacitors. The unit mounting the TSEMP Cannon suffers from sensor and electronic system interference every time it fires the TSEMP. This version only supports a single shot before it is fried.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 紧束流电磁脉冲炮是一种基于电击枪系统的定向能武器，但不需要线缆与电容器。搭载TSEMP炮的单位每次开火时都会遭受传感器与电子系统干扰。这一版本只能支持单次射击，随后就会被烧毁。
电磁干扰降低传感器效能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Repeating Tight Stream Electro Magnetic Pulse Cannon is a directed energy weapon and upgrade to the TSEMP Cannon. Trading superior reliability for some efficiency allows this TSEMP to fire more often.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连发紧束流电磁脉冲炮是一种定向能武器，是TSEMP炮的升级版。它以优越的可靠性换取部分效率，使这门TSEMP能更频繁地开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Flamer weapons are unique in that they deal little physical damage but instead expel superheated plasma, applying substantial heat to their target. When done properly, this can hamper enemy return fire or even cause the targeted unit to shut down from overheating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火焰喷射器武器独特之处在于它们造成的物理伤害很少，而是喷出过热等离子，给目标施加大量热量。运用得当可削弱敌方还击，甚至让目标单位因过热而停机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The LRM10 rack of Long-Range Missiles occupies a supporting fire role when mounted on most units, with fairly low damage balanced by low heat and ammunition consumption. Like all LRMs, LRM10s are capable of indirect fire over obstacles and terrain. LRM can fill a variety of roles using specialized ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LRM10 远程导弹发射架在多数单位上承担支援射击角色，伤害相当低，但热量与弹药消耗也低。与所有 LRM 一样，LRM10 能越过障碍与地形进行间接射击。LRM 可借助特种弹药胜任多种角色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A flexible weapon, AC/5s strike a balance between long range, power, and performance. These weapons are commonly found on medium 'Mechs as their primary source of reliable damage. Like all Autocannon weaponry, AC/5s suffer from recoil effects from continuous fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一种灵活的武器，AC/5在射程、威力与性能之间取得平衡。这些武器常见于中型机甲，作为其可靠的伤害来源。与所有自动炮武器一样，AC/5会因持续射击而受后坐力影响。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The midtier rack of Short-Range Missiles, SRM4s deal good damage for comparatively few negatives other than their inherently short range and need for ammunition. As for all SRMs, SRM4 shots deal above-average stability impact per hit compared to other weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SRM4 是中档短程火箭架，伤害不错，缺点相对较少——除其固有的短射程和弹药需求外。与所有 SRM 一样，相比其他武器，SRM4 每发造成高于平均的稳定性冲击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simplified internal Bomb Bay system, can't handle missiles. All stats of this Weapon are derived from loaded Munitions. Requires Weapons Bay Hardpoint and Bomb type [Bay] Munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种简化的内置炸弹舱系统，无法处理导弹。 < 该武器的所有数值均取决于所装填的弹药。 < 需要武器舱硬点与炸弹类型[弹药舱]弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An automated Bomb and Missile carousel capable of swapping through a multitude of Munitions and dropping them through bay doors in the belly of the unit. All stats of this Weapon are derived from loaded Munitions. Requires Weapons Bay Hardpoint and [Bay] Munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一套自动化炸弹与导弹转盘，能在多种弹药之间切换，并通过单位腹部的舱门投下它们。 < 该武器的所有数值均取决于所装填的弹药。 < 需要武器舱硬点与[弹药舱]弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simplified internal Missile Bay system, can't handle Bombs. All stats of this Weapon are derived from loaded Munitions. Requires Weapons Bay Hardpoint and Missile type [Bay] Munitions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简化型内置导弹舱系统，无法挂载炸弹。 此武器的所有属性均取自所装填的弹药。 < 需要武器舱挂载点与导弹类[舱]弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the weapon used by infantry for centuries, the Grenade Launcher fires a small shell in a high arc that falls onto the target. Uses Mortar Ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 榴弹发射器以步兵使用了几个世纪的武器为基础，能把小型炮弹以高抛弹道射向目标。 使用迫击炮弹药。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A single Anti-Air Arrow (AAA) Missile set for air launch by flying units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一枚防空箭（AAA）导弹，设定为由飞行单位空中发射。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Air to Ground Missiles (AGM) are guided missiles designed to be launched from aircraft at targets on the ground or at sea. They provide heavier punch and greater standoff distance that unguided rocket pods.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空对地导弹(AGM)是设计用于从飞机上发射、攻击地面或海上目标的制导导弹. 与无制导火箭弹舱相比，它们提供更强的打击威力和更大的防区外距离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arrow IV is a stand-alone, missile based, artillery system, designed to augment conventional systems such as the Long Tom and the Sniper. It was first introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2600 and became a staple of the Star League Defense Force. Although the technology to create Arrow IVs was lost during the Star League's collapse, it was recovered by Capellan Confederation engineers in 3044 working off of surviving examples and the Helm Memory Core.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 箭IV是一种独立的导弹式火炮系统，用于增强长汤姆、狙击炮这类常规系统。它由地球霸权于2600年首次推出，随后成为星际联盟国防军的常备装备。虽然制造箭IV的技术在星际联盟崩溃期间失传，但卡佩兰联邦的工程师在3044年依据幸存样品和地狱记忆核心将其重新掌握。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not quite as potent as the air-to-air Arrow missiles introduced by the Lyrans and the Wolves, this much smaller air-to-air missile version had its debut with the allied aerospace forces of the Duchy of Tamarind and Duchess Alys Rousset-Marik’s resistance movement. Built smaller and leaner, these so-called light air-to-air (LAA) missiles can be carried by smaller fighters and create far less drag during atmospheric operations.
